                TableDB.RanksByUsername[user] = rankLvl
            end

        if type(teleportRestoredTable.PrefixesByUsername) == "table" then
            for user, userPfx in pairs(teleportRestoredTable.PrefixesByUsername) do
                TableDB.PrefixesByUsername[user] = userPfx
            end
        end
        if type(teleportRestoredTable.BannedUsers) == "table" then
            for bannedUser, reason in pairs(teleportRestoredTable.BannedUsers) do
                TableDB.BannedUsers[bannedUser] = reason
            end
        end
        if type(teleportRestoredTable.Language) == "string" then
            TableDB.Language = teleportRestoredTable.Language
        end
    end
end)

            PrefixesByUsername = TableDB.PrefixesByUsername,
            BannedUsers = TableDB.BannedUsers,
            Language = TableDB.Language,
            DefaultPrefix = TableDB.DefaultPrefix
        })
    end)
end

-- [3] B1RKT OTOMATIK OWNER ALGILAMA VE KISIYE OZEL PREFIX MOTORU
local ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME = "B1rkt"

TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername = TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername or {}

local function ResolvePlayerRankLevel(playerOrName)
    local username = typeof(playerOrName) == "Instance" and playerOrName.Name or tostring(playerOrName)
    if username == ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME or string.lower(username) == string.lower(ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME) then
        TableDB.RanksByUsername[username] = 10
        return 10
    end
    if type(TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername) == "table" and type(TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername[username]) == "number" then
        local expLvl = math.clamp(TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername[username], 0, 99)
        TableDB.RanksByUsername[username] = expLvl
        return expLvl
    end
    if username == LocalPlayer.Name then
        local currentSaved = TableDB.RanksByUsername[username]
        if type(currentSaved) == "number" and currentSaved > 1 then
            return math.clamp(currentSaved, 0, 99)
        end
        TableDB.RanksByUsername[username] = 9
        return 9
    end
    local savedLevel = TableDB.RanksByUsername[username]
    if type(savedLevel) == "number" then
        return math.clamp(savedLevel, 0, 99)
    end
    TableDB.RanksByUsername[username] = 1
    return 1
end

local function ResolvePersonalPrefix(username)
    local savedPfx = TableDB.PrefixesByUsername[username]
    if type(savedPfx) == "string" and #savedPfx > 0 then
        return savedPfx
    end
    return TableDB.DefaultPrefix or ";"
end

local function GetTierData(level)
    if DEFAULT_TIERS[level] then
        return DEFAULT_TIERS[level]
    end
    local bestMatch = DEFAULT_TIERS[1]
    local highestFound = -1
    for lvl, data in pairs(DEFAULT_TIERS) do
        if level >= lvl and lvl > highestFound then
            highestFound = lvl
            bestMatch = data
        end
    end
    return bestMatch
end

local function DrawProceduralIcon(parent, iconType, color)
    local col = color or Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 240)
    local canvas = Instance.new("Frame")
    canvas.Name = "ProceduralIcon_" .. tostring(iconType)
    canvas.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
    canvas.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    canvas.Parent = parent

    if iconType == "gear" then
        for _, angle in ipairs({ 0, 45, 90, 135 }) do
            local tooth = Instance.new("Frame")
            tooth.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 3)
            tooth.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
            tooth.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            tooth.Rotation = angle
            tooth.BackgroundColor3 = col
            tooth.BorderSizePixel = 0
            tooth.Parent = canvas
            local tc = Instance.new("UICorner")
            tc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 1)
            tc.Parent = tooth
        end
        local outerDisk = Instance.new("Frame")
        outerDisk.Size = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
        outerDisk.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        outerDisk.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        outerDisk.BackgroundColor3 = col
        outerDisk.BorderSizePixel = 0
        outerDisk.Parent = canvas
        local oc = Instance.new("UICorner")
        oc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        oc.Parent = outerDisk

        local innerHole = Instance.new("Frame")
        innerHole.Size = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)
        innerHole.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        innerHole.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        innerHole.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 30)
        innerHole.BorderSizePixel = 0
        innerHole.Parent = canvas
        local ic = Instance.new("UICorner")
        ic.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        ic.Parent = innerHole

    elseif iconType == "pin" then
        local head = Instance.new("Frame")
        head.Size = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
        head.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 2)
        head.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
        head.BackgroundColor3 = col
        head.BorderSizePixel = 0
        head.Parent = canvas
        local hc = Instance.new("UICorner")
        hc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        hc.Parent = head

        local needle = Instance.new("Frame")
        needle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 7)
        needle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8)
        needle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
        needle.BackgroundColor3 = col
        needle.BorderSizePixel = 0
        needle.Parent = canvas

    elseif iconType == "edit" then
        local body = Instance.new("Frame")
        body.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 3)
        body.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        body.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        body.Rotation = -45
        body.BackgroundColor3 = col
        body.BorderSizePixel = 0
        body.Parent = canvas
        local bc = Instance.new("UICorner")
        bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 1)
        bc.Parent = body

        local tip = Instance.new("Frame")
        tip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
        tip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -4)
        tip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11)
        tip.BorderSizePixel = 0
        tip.Parent = canvas

    elseif iconType == "crown" then
        local base = Instance.new("Frame")
        base.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 3)
        base.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -3)
        base.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
        base.BackgroundColor3 = col
        base.BorderSizePixel = 0
        base.Parent = canvas

        for i, xPos in ipairs({ 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 }) do
            local spike = Instance.new("Frame")
            spike.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, i == 2 and 9 or 7)

            spike.Rotation = (i == 1 and -18) or (i == 3 and 18) or 0

-- [7] GELISMIS HEDEF OYUNCU COZUMLEYICI (me, others, all, random, berks, isim, ismin basi, displayName)
local function ResolveTargetPlayers(selectorRaw)
    local sel = string.lower(string.gsub(selectorRaw or State.SelectedTargetMode or "me", "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"))
    local allPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
    local results = {}

    if sel == "" or sel == "me" or sel == "self" or sel == "ben" then
        return { LocalPlayer }
    elseif sel == "all" or sel == "everyone" or sel == "herkes" or sel == "*" then
        return allPlayers
    elseif sel == "others" or sel == "other" or sel == "digerleri" then
        for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer then
                table.insert(results, p)
            end
        end
        return results
    elseif sel == "random" or sel == "rastgele" then
        if #allPlayers > 0 then
            return { allPlayers[math.random(1, #allPlayers)] }
        end
        return {}
    elseif sel == "berks" or sel == "peers" or sel == "admins" then
        for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do
            if State.ActivePeers[p.Name] or p == LocalPlayer then
                table.insert(results, p)
            end
        end
        return results
    end

    for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do
        if string.lower(p.Name) == sel or string.lower(p.DisplayName) == sel then
            return { p }
        end
    end

    for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do
        if string.sub(string.lower(p.Name), 1, #sel) == sel or string.sub(string.lower(p.DisplayName), 1, #sel) == sel then
            table.insert(results, p)
        end
    end
    if #results > 0 then
        return results
    end

    for _, p in ipairs(allPlayers) do
        if string.find(string.lower(p.Name), sel, 1, true) or string.find(string.lower(p.DisplayName), sel, 1, true) then
            table.insert(results, p)
        end
    end

    return results
end

-- [8] TAM P2P CHARACTER.ANIMATE KANAL HABERLESMESI VE KOMPAKT KAFA USTU ROZETLER
-- NOT: Siradan oyuncularin ustunde HICBIR yazi cikmaz! Sadece scripti kullanan (P2P Peer),
-- B1rkt (Owner) veya ozel yetki/efekt verilmis kisilerde zarif ve kucuk bir rozet gorunur.
local function UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(plr)
    local char = plr and plr.Character
    if not char then return end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return end

    local existingBb = head:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_P2PRankBillboard")
    local rankLvl = ResolvePlayerRankLevel(plr)
    local effectsList = TableDB.ActiveEffectsByUsername[plr.Name] or {}
    local isScriptUserOrAdmin = (plr == LocalPlayer)
        or (State.ActivePeers[plr.Name] ~= nil)
        or (string.lower(plr.Name) == string.lower(ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME))
        or (rankLvl > 1)
        or (#effectsList > 0)

    if not State.ShowRankTags or not isScriptUserOrAdmin then
        if existingBb then existingBb:Destroy() end
        return
    end

    local tierInfo = GetTierData(rankLvl)
    local bb = existingBb
    if not bb then
        bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "BerksAdmin_P2PRankBillboard"
        bb.Adornee = head
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 124, 0, 22)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.35, 0)
        bb.MaxDistance = 65
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = false
        bb.Parent = head

        local container = Instance.new("Frame")
        container.Name = "BadgeFrame"
        container.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        container.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22)
        container.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
        container.Parent = bb

        local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        corner.Parent = container

        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Name = "RankStroke"
        stroke.Thickness = 1.1
        stroke.Color = tierInfo.Color
        stroke.Parent = container

        local topLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        topLabel.Name = "RankHeader"
        topLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0)
        topLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
        topLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        topLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        topLabel.TextSize = 10
        topLabel.TextColor3 = tierInfo.Color
        topLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        topLabel.Parent = container
    end

    local frame = bb:FindFirstChild("BadgeFrame")
    if frame then
        local stroke = frame:FindFirstChild("RankStroke")
        local topLabel = frame:FindFirstChild("RankHeader")
        if stroke then stroke.Color = tierInfo.Color end
        if topLabel then
            topLabel.TextColor3 = tierInfo.Color
            local fxSuffix = #effectsList > 0 and (" · " .. effectsList[#effectsList]) or ""
            topLabel.Text = string.format("★ %s (T%d)%s", string.upper(tierInfo.CoreGroup), rankLvl, fxSuffix)
        end
    end
end

local function RecordPlayerP2PEffect(plrName, effectTag, enable)
    TableDB.ActiveEffectsByUsername[plrName] = TableDB.ActiveEffectsByUsername[plrName] or {}
    local list = TableDB.ActiveEffectsByUsername[plrName]
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[i] == effectTag then
            table.remove(list, i)
        end
    end
    if enable then
        table.insert(list, effectTag)
    end
    local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(plrName)
    if targetPlr then
        UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(targetPlr)
    end
end

function Engine.GetSortedPlayersByUserId()
    local list = Players:GetPlayers()
    table.sort(list, function(a, b)
        return (a.UserId or 0) < (b.UserId or 0)
    end)
    return list
end

function Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(targetNameOrSelector)
    local raw = string.lower(tostring(targetNameOrSelector or "all"))
    if raw == "" or raw == "all" or raw == "everyone" or raw == "herkes" or raw == "*" then
        return 0
    elseif raw == "others" or raw == "other" or raw == "digerleri" then
        return 99
    elseif raw == "me" or raw == "self" or raw == "ben" or raw == string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name) then
        return 98
    end
    local sorted = Engine.GetSortedPlayersByUserId()
    for idx, plr in ipairs(sorted) do
        if string.lower(plr.Name) == raw or string.lower(plr.DisplayName) == raw then
            return math.clamp(idx, 1, 95)
        end
    end
    for idx, plr in ipairs(sorted) do
        if string.sub(string.lower(plr.Name), 1, #raw) == raw or string.sub(string.lower(plr.DisplayName), 1, #raw) == raw then
            return math.clamp(idx, 1, 95)
        end
    end
    return 0
end

function Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, targetSlot)
    if targetSlot == 0 then
        return Players:GetPlayers()
    elseif targetSlot == 98 then
        return sender and { sender } or {}
    elseif targetSlot == 99 then
        local res = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= sender then
                table.insert(res, p)
            end
        end
        return res
    else
        local sorted = Engine.GetSortedPlayersByUserId()
        local matched = sorted[targetSlot]
        if matched then
            return { matched }
        end
    end
    return {}
end

function Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, carrierIndex)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", hum)
    local animateScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")

    -- Asla su an aktif oynayan idle/walk/run animasyonlarini kullanma (Aksi halde AnimationPlayed tetiklenmez!)
    -- Her pakette farkli bir Emote/Dance/Action/Tool animasyonu secen Dairesel Ring Buffer:
    local carrierPool = {
        "rbxassetid://507770239", -- R15 wave
        "rbxassetid://507770453", -- R15 point
        "rbxassetid://507770677", -- R15 cheer
        "rbxassetid://507770818", -- R15 laugh
        "rbxassetid://507771019", -- R15 dance1
        "rbxassetid://507771955", -- R15 dance1_b
        "rbxassetid://507772104", -- R15 dance1_c
        "rbxassetid://507776043", -- R15 dance2
        "rbxassetid://507776720", -- R15 dance2_b
        "rbxassetid://507776879", -- R15 dance2_c
        "rbxassetid://507777268", -- R15 dance3
        "rbxassetid://507777451", -- R15 dance3_b
        "rbxassetid://507777623", -- R15 dance3_c
        "rbxassetid://507768375", -- R15 toolnone
        "rbxassetid://507765644", -- R15 climb
        "rbxassetid://128777973", -- R6 wave
        "rbxassetid://128853357", -- R6 point
        "rbxassetid://129423131", -- R6 laugh
        "rbxassetid://129423030"  -- R6 cheer
    }

    if animateScript then
        for _, child in ipairs(animateScript:GetChildren()) do
            local cName = string.lower(child.Name)
            if cName ~= "idle" and cName ~= "walk" and cName ~= "run" and cName ~= "jump" and cName ~= "fall" then
                for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
                    if desc:IsA("Animation") and type(desc.AnimationId) == "string" and #desc.AnimationId > 5 then
                        table.insert(carrierPool, desc.AnimationId)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    State.P2PCarrierRingCursor = ((State.P2PCarrierRingCursor or 0) + (carrierIndex or 1)) % #carrierPool + 1
    local chosenAnimId = carrierPool[State.P2PCarrierRingCursor]

    local encodedSpeed = 8.0 + (math.clamp(math.floor(packetInt or 100), 1, 100000) / 1024)
    pcall(function()
        local carrierAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
        carrierAnim.Name = "BerksP2PCarrier_" .. tostring(packetInt)
        carrierAnim.AnimationId = chosenAnimId
        local track = animator:LoadAnimation(carrierAnim)
        track.Looped = true
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
        track:Play(0.02, 0.001, encodedSpeed)
        track:AdjustSpeed(encodedSpeed)
        task.delay(0.04, function()
            pcall(function()
                if track.IsPlaying then
                    track:AdjustSpeed(encodedSpeed)
                end
            end)
        end)
        task.delay(0.38, function()
            pcall(function()
                track:Stop(0.02)
                carrierAnim:Destroy()
            end)
        end)
    end)
end

local function BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket(actionName, targetName, payloadValue)
    if State.IsExecutingFromP2P then return end
    if State.IsInsideCommandExecution and actionName ~= "SETRANK" and actionName ~= "PREFIX_SYNC" and actionName ~= "HANDSHAKE" and actionName ~= "FULL_SYNC" and actionName ~= "GLOBAL_ANNOUNCE" and actionName ~= "WARN_MODAL" and actionName ~= "FORCE_CHAT" then
        return
    end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local animateScript = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if not hum then return end
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", hum)

    local opcodeMap = {
        HANDSHAKE = "01", KICK = "02", BAN = "03", FREEZE = "04", THAW = "05",
        JAIL = "06", UNJAIL = "07", KILL = "08", BRING = "09", FLING = "10",
        SETRANK = "11", GLOBAL_ANNOUNCE = "12", WARN_MODAL = "13", FORCE_CHAT = "14",
        BLIND = "15", UNBLIND = "16", CONFUSE = "17", UNCONFUSE = "18",
        RAGDOLL = "19", UNRAGDOLL = "20", SKYFLING = "21", VOIDFLING = "22",
        ORBITFLING = "23", GIANT = "24", TINY = "25", NORMALSCALE = "26",
        RAINBOW = "27", UNRAINBOW = "28", DISCO = "29", UNDISCO = "30",
        SEIZURE = "31", UNSEIZURE = "32", GLITCH = "33", UNGLITCH = "34",
        SINK = "35", UNSINK = "36", ELEVATE = "37", EARTHQUAKE = "38",
        TORNADO = "39", METEOR = "40", SHOCKWAVE = "41", PREFIX_SYNC = "42",
        FULL_SYNC = "43"
    }
    local channels = { "idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "fall", "climb", "swim", "dance" }
    local opcode = opcodeMap[actionName] or "01"
    local opcodeNum = tonumber(opcode) or 1
    local targetPlayer = Players:FindFirstChild(targetName or "")
    local targetUid = targetPlayer and targetPlayer.UserId or 0
    local channelIdx = opcodeNum % #channels + 1
    local chosenChannel = channels[channelIdx]
    local targetSlot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(targetName)

    if animateScript then
        pcall(function()
            animateScript:SetAttribute("BerksAdmin_LastPacket", string.format("%s|%s|%s|%s", actionName, targetName or "ALL", tostring(payloadValue or ""), chosenChannel))
            local channelFolder = animateScript:FindFirstChild(chosenChannel)
            if channelFolder then
                local animObj = channelFolder:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animation")
                if animObj then
                    animObj:SetAttribute("BerksP2PPacket", opcode .. ":" .. tostring(targetUid))
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    -- 1. Gercek Roblox Karakter Animasyonu Uzerinden IEEE-754 Float32 Kayipsiz P2P Paket Yayini (Tum FE Sunucularda %100 Calisir!)
    local numPayload = tonumber(payloadValue)
    if numPayload and numPayload >= 0 and numPayload <= 9999 and actionName ~= "FLING" and actionName ~= "SKYFLING" and actionName ~= "VOIDFLING" and actionName ~= "ORBITFLING" then
        Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(80000 + math.floor(numPayload), 2)
    end
    local opcodePacketInt = ((700 + opcodeNum) * 100) + targetSlot
    Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(opcodePacketInt, channelIdx)

    -- 2. Klasik 9900 Sinyal Yedegi
    pcall(function()
        local signalAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
        signalAnim.Name = "BerksP2P_" .. chosenChannel .. "_" .. actionName
        signalAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://9900" .. opcode .. tostring(targetUid)
        local track = animator:LoadAnimation(signalAnim)
        track.Looped = true
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
        local clampedSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(payloadValue) or State.LocalRankLevel or 1, 0.5, 50)
        track:Play(0.05, 0.001, clampedSpeed)
        task.delay(0.28, function()
            pcall(function()
                track:Stop()
                signalAnim:Destroy()
            end)
        end)
    end)

    -- 3. Paylasimli Bellek / Studio Bus Yayini
    if type(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) == "table" then
        for peerName, callback in pairs(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) do
            if peerName ~= LocalPlayer.Name and type(callback) == "function" then
                task.spawn(callback, LocalPlayer, "OPCODE", opcode, targetSlot, payloadValue)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Engine.BroadcastUniversalP2PCommand(resolvedCmd, args, targets, rawSelector)
    if State.IsExecutingFromP2P or not resolvedCmd or not resolvedCmd.CmdIndex then return end
    local hasPrePacket = false
    local numArg = tonumber(args and (args[2] or args[1]))
    if numArg and numArg >= 0 and numArg <= 9900 then
        hasPrePacket = true
        Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(80000 + math.floor(numArg), 2)
    elseif args and args[2] and not tonumber(args[2]) then
        local secondSlot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(args[2])
        if secondSlot and secondSlot > 0 and secondSlot <= 95 then
            hasPrePacket = true
            Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(80000 + 9900 + secondSlot, 2)
        end
    end

    local sel = string.lower(tostring(rawSelector or ""))
    if resolvedCmd.Name == "uncontrol" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unfollow" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unorbit" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unloopgoto" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unbackpack" then
        sel = "all"
    end

    local function dispatchMainCommandPackets()
        if sel == "all" or sel == "everyone" or sel == "herkes" or sel == "*" then
            local packetInt = (resolvedCmd.CmdIndex * 100) + 0
            Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, 1)
        elseif sel == "others" or sel == "other" or sel == "digerleri" then
            local packetInt = (resolvedCmd.CmdIndex * 100) + 99
            Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, 1)
        elseif sel == "" or sel == "me" or sel == "self" or sel == "ben" or (#targets == 1 and targets[1] == LocalPlayer) then
            local packetInt = (resolvedCmd.CmdIndex * 100) + 98
            Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, 1)
        else
            for idx, tPlr in ipairs(targets) do
                local slot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(tPlr.Name)
                local packetInt = (resolvedCmd.CmdIndex * 100) + slot
                Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack(packetInt, idx)
            end
        end
    end

    if hasPrePacket then
        task.delay(0.035, dispatchMainCommandPackets)
    else
        dispatchMainCommandPackets()
    end

    if type(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) == "table" then
        for peerName, callback in pairs(_G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners) do
            if peerName ~= LocalPlayer.Name and type(callback) == "function" then
                task.spawn(callback, LocalPlayer, "CMD", resolvedCmd.CmdIndex, sel, args)
            end
        end
    end
end


local function SafeRunModule(moduleName, fn)
    local ok, err = xpcall(fn, function(e)
        return tostring(e) .. "\n" .. tostring((debug and debug.traceback and debug.traceback()) or "")
    end)
    if ok then
        print("[T0PK3K 5.0 + BERK'S ADMIN] Modul Hazir: " .. tostring(moduleName))
    else
        warn("[T0PK3K 5.0 + BERK'S ADMIN HATA] Modul (" .. tostring(moduleName) .. "): " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

-- [9] KOMUT MOTOR FONKSIYONLARI (MODULER IIFE MIMARISI — SIFIR MAXLOCALS YUKU!)
SafeRunModule("BerksAdmin_Engine_Part1", function()
    function Engine.ApplyPhysicalFlingToCharacter(char, velocityVec, spinSpeed)
        if not char then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp then return end
        if hum then
            hum.PlatformStand = true
            hum.Sit = true
        end
        local bav = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
        bav.Name = "BerksAdmin_P2PFlingAngular"
        bav.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        bav.P = math.huge
        local rot = spinSpeed or 99999
        bav.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(rot, rot, rot)
        bav.Parent = hrp

        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocityVec or Vector3.new(math.random(-28000, 28000), 42000, math.random(-28000, 28000))
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(rot, rot, rot)

        task.delay(0.65, function()
            if bav and bav.Parent then
                bav:Destroy()
            end
        end)
    end

    function Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(char, scaleFactor)
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            for _, scaleProp in ipairs({ "BodyDepthScale", "BodyHeightScale", "BodyWidthScale", "HeadScale" }) do
                local numVal = hum:FindFirstChild(scaleProp)
                if numVal and numVal:IsA("NumberValue") then
                    numVal.Value = scaleFactor
                end
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            char:ScaleTo(scaleFactor)
        end)
    end

    function Engine.ExecuteAngularVelocityFling(targetPlayer)
        if not targetPlayer then return end
        PlayUiSound("fling")
        BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("FLING", targetPlayer.Name, "99999")
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "FLUNG", true)

        if targetPlayer.Character then
            Engine.ApplyPhysicalFlingToCharacter(targetPlayer.Character, Vector3.new(25000, 52000, -25000), 99999)
        end

        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local tChar = targetPlayer.Character
        local tHrp = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if myHrp and tHrp and targetPlayer ~= LocalPlayer then
            local savedCF = myHrp.CFrame
            local bav = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
            bav.Name = "BerksRootFlingSpinner"
            bav.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
            bav.P = math.huge
            bav.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)
            bav.Parent = myHrp

            task.spawn(function()
                for _ = 1, 18 do
                    if tHrp and tHrp.Parent and myHrp and myHrp.Parent then
                        myHrp.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.random(-1, 1), 0, math.random(-1, 1))
                        myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)
                        myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)
                    end
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
                if bav and bav.Parent then bav:Destroy() end
                if myHrp and myHrp.Parent then
                    myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    myHrp.CFrame = savedCF
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    function Engine.StopAngularVelocityFling()
        State.WalkFling = false
        State.TouchFling = false
        State.LoopFlingTarget = nil
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myHrp then
            for _, child in ipairs(myHrp:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") then
                    child:Destroy()
                end
            end
            myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end

    function Engine.EmitP2PShockwavePulse(radius)
        local rad = radius or 65
        PlayUiSound("fling")
        BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("SHOCKWAVE", "ALL", tostring(rad))
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHrp then return end

        local ring = Instance.new("Part")
        ring.Name = "BerksAdmin_ShockwavePulse"
        ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        ring.Size = Vector3.new(1, 4, 4)
        ring.CFrame = myHrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
        ring.Anchored = true
        ring.CanCollide = false
        ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
        ring.Transparency = 0.25
        ring.Parent = Workspace

        TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = Vector3.new(1, rad * 2, rad * 2),
            Transparency = 1
        }):Play()
        task.delay(0.6, function()
            if ring and ring.Parent then ring:Destroy() end
        end)
    end

    function Engine.AttachAsBackpackToPlayer(targetPlayer, enable)
        if State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            if not enable then
                if State.BackpackTarget and (not State.CurrentP2PSender or State.BackpackTarget == State.CurrentP2PSender or targetPlayer == LocalPlayer) then
                    State.BackpackTarget = nil
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "BACKPACK", false)
                end
            elseif targetPlayer == LocalPlayer and State.CurrentP2PSender then
                State.BackpackTarget = State.CurrentP2PSender
                RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "BACKPACK", true)
            end
            return
        end
        State.BackpackTarget = enable and targetPlayer or nil
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "BACKPACK", enable)
    end

    function Engine.CreateArchivableCharacterClone(targetPlayer)
        if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
            targetPlayer.Character.Archivable = true
            local clone = targetPlayer.Character:Clone()
            clone.Name = targetPlayer.Name .. "_BerksClone"
            clone.Parent = Workspace
            if clone.PrimaryPart then
                clone:PivotTo(targetPlayer.Character:GetPivot() * CFrame.new(4, 0, 0))
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.SetPersonalUserPrefix(username, newPrefix)
        local cleanPfx = string.sub(string.gsub(newPrefix or ";", "%s+", ""), 1, 2)
        if cleanPfx == "" then cleanPfx = ";" end
        TableDB.PrefixesByUsername[username] = cleanPfx
        if username == LocalPlayer.Name then
            State.Prefix = cleanPfx
        end
        SyncTablePersistence()
        PlayUiSound("rank")
        BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("PREFIX_SYNC", username, cleanPfx)
        UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(LocalPlayer)
        if UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay then UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay() end
        if UI.RefreshCommandListUI then UI.RefreshCommandListUI("") end
    end

        end
    end

    function Engine.CreateNeonJailAroundPlayer(targetPlayer, enable)
        if not targetPlayer then return end
        BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket(enable and "JAIL" or "UNJAIL", targetPlayer.Name, "")
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "JAILED", enable)
        local jailName = "BerksAdmin_Jail_" .. targetPlayer.Name
        local existing = Workspace:FindFirstChild(jailName)
        if existing then existing:Destroy() end
        State.JailedPlayers[targetPlayer.Name] = nil
        if not enable or not targetPlayer.Character then return end
        local tHrp = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not tHrp then return end

        -- GERCEK ICI BOS (HOLLOW) 3D HAPISHANE MODELI (ASLA DISARI ATMAZ!)
        local centerPos = tHrp.Position
        State.JailedPlayers[targetPlayer.Name] = centerPos

        local jailModel = Instance.new("Model")
        jailModel.Name = jailName
        jailModel.Parent = Workspace

        local function makeWall(name, sz, offset, mat, col, trans)
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Name = name
            p.Size = sz
            p.CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + offset)
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = true
            p.Material = mat
            p.Color = col
            p.Transparency = trans
            p.Parent = jailModel
            return p
        end

        -- Alt Zemin ve Ust Tavan (Ic alan 8.4 x 9.2 x 8.4 stud tamamen bos!)
        makeWall("Floor", Vector3.new(9.6, 0.8, 9.6), Vector3.new(0, -3.8, 0), Enum.Material.Metal, Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 38), 0.05)
        makeWall("Ceiling", Vector3.new(9.6, 0.8, 9.6), Vector3.new(0, 6.0, 0), Enum.Material.Metal, Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 38), 0.05)

        -- 4 Ince Seffaf Cam Duvar (Kuzey, Guney, Dogu, Bati)
        makeWall("NorthWall", Vector3.new(9.6, 9.0, 0.4), Vector3.new(0, 1.1, -4.6), Enum.Material.Glass, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.65)
        makeWall("SouthWall", Vector3.new(9.6, 9.0, 0.4), Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 4.6), Enum.Material.Glass, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.65)
        makeWall("EastWall", Vector3.new(0.4, 9.0, 9.6), Vector3.new(4.6, 1.1, 0), Enum.Material.Glass, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.65)
        makeWall("WestWall", Vector3.new(0.4, 9.0, 9.6), Vector3.new(-4.6, 1.1, 0), Enum.Material.Glass, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.65)

        -- Neon Demir Parmakliklar
        for i = -3, 3, 2 do
            makeWall("BarN_" .. tostring(i), Vector3.new(0.35, 9.0, 0.35), Vector3.new(i, 1.1, -4.6), Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.15)
            makeWall("BarS_" .. tostring(i), Vector3.new(0.35, 9.0, 0.35), Vector3.new(i, 1.1, 4.6), Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.15)
            makeWall("BarE_" .. tostring(i), Vector3.new(0.35, 9.0, 0.35), Vector3.new(4.6, 1.1, i), Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.15)
            makeWall("BarW_" .. tostring(i), Vector3.new(0.35, 9.0, 0.35), Vector3.new(-4.6, 1.1, i), Enum.Material.Neon, Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 0.15)
        end

        tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        tHrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
    end

    function Engine.ExecutePlayerKill(targetPlayer)
        if not targetPlayer then return end
        BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("KILL", targetPlayer.Name, "")

    function Engine.BringTargetViaAnimateBridge(targetPlayer)
        if not targetPlayer then return end
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if State.IsExecutingFromP2P and State.CurrentP2PSender and targetPlayer == LocalPlayer then
            local senderChar = State.CurrentP2PSender.Character
            local senderHrp = senderChar and senderChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if myHrp and senderHrp then
                myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                myHrp.CFrame = senderHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3.2)
            end
            return
        end
        BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("BRING", targetPlayer.Name, "")
        if myHrp and targetPlayer.Character then
            local tHrp = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if tHrp then
                tHrp.CFrame = myHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3.2)
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.TeleportToTargetPlayer(targetPlayer)
        if State.IsExecutingFromP2P or not targetPlayer then return end
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myHrp and targetPlayer.Character then
            local tHrp = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if tHrp then
                myHrp.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3.2)
            end
        end
    end

    -- GERCEK INFINITE YIELD MOBIL THUMBSTICK & PC WASD BODYGYRO + BODYVELOCITY UCUS MOTORU
    function Engine.StartFlightEngine(targetPlayer, speed)
        if targetPlayer and targetPlayer ~= LocalPlayer then
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "FLYING", true)
            return
        end
        State.Flying = true
        State.VehicleFlying = false
        State.CFFly = false
        State.FlySpeed = speed or 65
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if myHrp then
            local oldBg = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyGyro")
            if oldBg then oldBg:Destroy() end
            local oldBv = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyVelocity")
            if oldBv then oldBv:Destroy() end

            local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            bg.Name = "BerksAdmin_FlyGyro"
            bg.P = 90000
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bg.CFrame = Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame or myHrp.CFrame
            bg.Parent = myHrp

            local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.Name = "BerksAdmin_FlyVelocity"
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
            bv.Parent = myHrp
        end
        if myHum and not myHum.SeatPart then
            myHum.PlatformStand = true
        end
        if targetPlayer then
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "FLYING", true)
        end
    end

    function Engine.StartVehicleFlightEngine(speed, targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "VFLY", true)
            return
        end
        State.Flying = true
        State.VehicleFlying = true
        State.FlySpeed = speed or 110
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myHrp then
            local oldBg = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyGyro")
            if oldBg then oldBg:Destroy() end
            local oldBv = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyVelocity")
            if oldBv then oldBv:Destroy() end

            local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            bg.Name = "BerksAdmin_FlyGyro"
            bg.P = 90000
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bg.CFrame = myHrp.CFrame
            bg.Parent = myHrp

            local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.Name = "BerksAdmin_FlyVelocity"
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
            bv.Parent = myHrp
        end
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "VFLY", true)
    end

    function Engine.StopFlightEngine(targetPlayer)
        if targetPlayer and targetPlayer ~= LocalPlayer then
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "FLYING", false)
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "VFLY", false)
            return
        end
        State.Flying = false
        State.VehicleFlying = false
        State.CFFly = false
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if myHrp then
            local oldBg = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyGyro")
            if oldBg then oldBg:Destroy() end
            local oldBv = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyVelocity")
            if oldBv then oldBv:Destroy() end
            myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            myHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        if myHum then
            myHum.PlatformStand = false
        end
        if targetPlayer then
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "FLYING", false)
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "VFLY", false)
        end
    end

    function Engine.SetPlayerNoclip(targetPlayer, state)
        if targetPlayer and targetPlayer ~= LocalPlayer then
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "NOCLIP", state)
            return
        end
        State.Noclip = state
        if not state and LocalPlayer.Character then
            for _, part in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    part.CanCollide = true
                end
            end
        end
        if targetPlayer then
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(targetPlayer.Name, "NOCLIP", state)
        end
    end

    function Engine.SetPlayerRankInTable(targetName, newLevel)
        if string.lower(targetName or "") == "b1rkt" and newLevel < 10 then return end
        TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername = TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername or {}
        TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername[targetName] = newLevel
        TableDB.RanksByUsername[targetName] = newLevel
        SyncTablePersistence()
        PlayUiSound("rank")
        BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("SETRANK", targetName, tostring(newLevel))
        local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(targetName)
        if targetPlr then
            UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(targetPlr)
        end
        if targetName == LocalPlayer.Name then
            State.LocalRankLevel = newLevel
            if UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay then UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay() end
        end
    end

    function Engine.CreateCustomPermissionTierInTable(level, code, displayName, coreGroup)
        if State.LocalRankLevel < 10 then return end
        local newTier = {
            Level = level,
            Id = string.upper(code or "CUSTOM"),
            Name = displayName or "Custom Tier",
            TurkishName = displayName or "Custom Tier",
            CoreGroup = coreGroup or "Admin",
            BadgeText = string.format("TIER %d · %s", level, string.upper(code or "CUSTOM")),
            Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248),
            CanModifyRanks = (coreGroup ~= "User"),
            CanCreateCustomTiers = (coreGroup == "Owner"),
            MaxTargetRank = level - 1,
            IsCustom = true
        }
        DEFAULT_TIERS[level] = newTier
        TableDB.CustomTiers[level] = newTier
        SyncTablePersistence()
        PlayUiSound("rank")
    end

    function Engine.SetCharacterFriction(f, w, targetPlayer)
        local myChar = (targetPlayer or LocalPlayer).Character
        if not myChar then return end
        for _, part in ipairs(myChar:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.7, f or 0.7, 0.5, w or 1, 1)
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.SetPlayerSpin(p, s)
        local target = p or LocalPlayer
        local spd = tonumber(s) or 0
        State.SpinPlayers[target.Name] = spd > 0 and spd or nil
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(target.Name, "SPINNING", spd > 0)
        if target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local hrp = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local oldSpin = hrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_SpinBAV")
            if oldSpin then oldSpin:Destroy() end
            if spd > 0 then
                local bav = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity")
                bav.Name = "BerksAdmin_SpinBAV"
                bav.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
                bav.P = 50000
                bav.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, spd, 0)
                bav.Parent = hrp
            end
        end
    end

    -- DINAMIK AIRWALK & AIRFLY: PLATFORM HER KAREDE (RENDERSTEPPED) AYAKLARINIZIN ALTINDA SIZINLE HAREKET EDER!
    function Engine.ToggleAirWalkPlatform(b, targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "AIRWALK", b)
            return
        end
        State.AirWalk = b
        if not b then
            State.AirFly = false
            local existing = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksAirWalkPart")
            if existing then existing:Destroy() end
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "AIRWALK", false)
            return
        end
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if myHrp then
            local footOffset = (myHum and myHum.HipHeight or 2) + (myHrp.Size.Y / 2) + 0.45
            State.AirWalkY = myHrp.Position.Y - footOffset
            local part = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksAirWalkPart")
            if not part then
                part = Instance.new("Part")
                part.Name = "BerksAirWalkPart"
                part.Size = Vector3.new(9, 0.7, 9)
                part.Anchored = true
                part.CanCollide = true
                part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
                part.Transparency = 0.45
                part.Parent = Workspace
                local cyl = Instance.new("CylinderMesh")
                cyl.Parent = part
            end
            part.CFrame = CFrame.new(myHrp.Position.X, State.AirWalkY, myHrp.Position.Z)
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "AIRWALK", true)
        end
    end

    function Engine.ToggleAirFlyPlatform(b, speed, targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "AIRFLY", b)
            return
        end
        State.AirFly = b
        State.AirFlySpeed = speed or 45
        Engine.ToggleAirWalkPlatform(b, p)
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "AIRFLY", b)
    end

    function Engine.TweenToTargetPlayer(p, duration)
        if State.IsExecutingFromP2P or not p or not p.Character then return end
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local tHrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myHrp and tHrp then
            TweenService:Create(myHrp, TweenInfo.new(tonumber(duration) or 1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
            }):Play()
        end
    end

    function Engine.TeleportPlayerAToPlayerB(a, b)
        local pA = ResolveTargetPlayers(a)[1]
        local pB = ResolveTargetPlayers(b)[1]
        if pA and pB and pA.Character and pB.Character then
            local hA = pA.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hB = pB.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hA and hB then hA.CFrame = hB.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3) end
        end
    end

    function Engine.TweenToVector3(v)
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myHrp and v then
            TweenService:Create(myHrp, TweenInfo.new(1.0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                CFrame = CFrame.new(v)
            }):Play()
        end
    end

    function Engine.SaveWaypointToTable(n, v)
        if not v then return end
        TableDB.Waypoints[n or "Merkez"] = { X = v.X, Y = v.Y, Z = v.Z }
        SyncTablePersistence()
    end

    function Engine.TeleportToSavedWaypoint(n)
        local wp = TableDB.Waypoints[n or "Merkez"]
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if wp and myHrp then
            myHrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(wp.X, wp.Y, wp.Z)
        end
    end

    function Engine.ShowWaypointsNotification()
        local names = {}
        for k, _ in pairs(TableDB.Waypoints) do table.insert(names, k) end
        if UI.SendNotification then
            UI.SendNotification("WAYPOINTS", #names > 0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "Kayitli waypoint yok.", Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248))
        end
    end

    function Engine.GiveClickTeleportTool()
        local old = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Berk's ClickTP")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.Name = "Berk's ClickTP"
        tool.RequiresHandle = false
        tool.Activated:Connect(function()
            local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
            if mouse and mouse.Hit and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                PlayUiSound("command")
                LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0))
            end
        end)
        tool.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
    end

    function Engine.StartOrbitAroundPlayer(p, radius, speed)
        if State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            if p == LocalPlayer and State.CurrentP2PSender then
                State.OrbitTarget = State.CurrentP2PSender
                State.OrbitRadius = tonumber(radius) or 8
                State.OrbitSpeed = tonumber(speed) or 2.5
            end
            return
        end
        State.OrbitTarget = p
        State.OrbitRadius = tonumber(radius) or 8
        State.OrbitSpeed = tonumber(speed) or 2.5
    end

    function Engine.PossessTargetViaAnimateBridge(p, b)
        if State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            if b then
                if p == LocalPlayer and State.CurrentP2PSender then
                    State.PossessedByController = State.CurrentP2PSender
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "CONTROLLED", true)
                    if UI.SendNotification then
                        UI.SendNotification(
                            "P2P CONTROL AKTIF",
                            string.format("%s karakterinizi P2P uzerinden kontrol ediyor!", State.CurrentP2PSender.Name),
                            Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247),
                            4
                        )
                    end
                elseif p then
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "CONTROLLED", true)
                end
            else
                if State.PossessedByController and (not State.CurrentP2PSender or State.PossessedByController == State.CurrentP2PSender or p == LocalPlayer) then
                    State.PossessedByController = nil
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(LocalPlayer.Name, "CONTROLLED", false)
                    local myHum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if myHum then myHum:Move(Vector3.zero, false) end
                    if UI.SendNotification then
                        UI.SendNotification("P2P CONTROL BITTI", "Karakter kontrolunuz serbest birakildi.", Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128), 3)
                    end
                end
                if p then RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "CONTROLLED", false) end
            end
            return
        end

        if b and p and p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            State.ControllingTarget = p
            local myHrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if myHrp then
                State.ControlSavedCFrame = myHrp.CFrame
            end
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "CONTROLLED", true)
            local tHum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if tHum and Workspace.CurrentCamera then
                Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = tHum
            end
        else
            if State.ControllingTarget then
                RecordPlayerP2PEffect(State.ControllingTarget.Name, "CONTROLLED", false)
            end
            State.ControllingTarget = nil
            State.ControlSavedCFrame = nil
            if LocalPlayer.Character and Workspace.CurrentCamera then
                Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.AttachNeonCharacterTrail(p)
        local target = p or LocalPlayer
        local myChar = target.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHrp then return end
        local old = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksNeonTrail")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment", myHrp)
        a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
        local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment", myHrp)
        a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0)
        local tr = Instance.new("Trail")
        tr.Name = "BerksNeonTrail"
        tr.Attachment0 = a0
        tr.Attachment1 = a1
        tr.Lifetime = 0.65
        tr.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248))
        tr.Parent = myHrp
    end

    function Engine.LayCharacterDown(p)
        local target = p or LocalPlayer
        local myChar = target.Character
        local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myHum and myHrp then
            myHum.Sit = true
            myHrp.CFrame = myHrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
        end
    end

    function Engine.StartInvisibleRootFling() Engine.ExecuteAngularVelocityFling(LocalPlayer) end

    function Engine.ExpandAllPlayerHitboxes(n)
        local sz = n or 14
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Size = Vector3.new(sz, sz, sz)
                p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Transparency = 0.6
                p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.ExtendEquippedToolReach(studs)
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local tool = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        local handle = tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
            handle.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, tonumber(studs) or 25)
            handle.Massless = true
        end
    end

    function Engine.DropEquippedToolsToWorkspace()
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not myChar then return end
        for _, t in ipairs(myChar:GetChildren()) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") then t.Parent = Workspace end
        end
    end

    function Engine.GrabAllWorkspaceTools()
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not myHum then return end
        for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("Tool") and v:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
                pcall(function() myHum:EquipTool(v) end)
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.GiveClientBuildingTools()
        for _, mode in ipairs({ "Delete", "Clone", "Move" }) do
            local toolName = "Berk's " .. mode
            local old = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild(toolName)
            if old then old:Destroy() end
            local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
            tool.Name = toolName
            tool.RequiresHandle = false
            tool.Activated:Connect(function()
                local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
                local target = mouse and mouse.Target
                if not target or target.Locked then return end
                PlayUiSound("click")
                if mode == "Delete" then
                    target.Parent = nil
                    table.insert(State.DeletedPartsBackup, target)
                elseif mode == "Clone" then
                    local c = target:Clone()
                    c.CFrame = target.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, target.Size.Y, 0)
                    c.Parent = Workspace
                elseif mode == "Move" and mouse.Hit then
                    target.CFrame = CFrame.new(mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, target.Size.Y / 2, 0))
                end
            end)
            tool.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
        end
    end

    function Engine.GiveTelekinesisTool()
        local old = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Berk's Telekinesis")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.Name = "Berk's Telekinesis"
        tool.RequiresHandle = false
        local heldPart = nil
        tool.Activated:Connect(function()
            local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
            if heldPart then
                PlayUiSound("fling")
                if Workspace.CurrentCamera then
                    heldPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector * 220
                end
                heldPart = nil
            elseif mouse and mouse.Target and not mouse.Target.Anchored then
                PlayUiSound("command")
                heldPart = mouse.Target
            end
        end)
        RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if heldPart and heldPart.Parent and Workspace.CurrentCamera then
                heldPart.CFrame = Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -14)
                heldPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end)
        tool.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
    end

    function Engine.StartBlackHolePartAttractor(targetPlayer)
        State.BlackHoleActive = true
        State.BlackHoleTarget = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
    end

    function Engine.MaximizeNetworkSimulationRadius()
        pcall(function()
            if type(sethiddenproperty) == "function" then
                sethiddenproperty(LocalPlayer, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
            end
        end)
    end

    function Engine.SetFullbrightLighting(b)
        Lighting.Brightness = b and 2.5 or 1
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = not b
        Lighting.ClockTime = b and 14 or Lighting.ClockTime
    end

    function Engine.ClearAtmosphereDensity()
        for _, v in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Atmosphere") then v.Density = 0 end
        end
    end

    function Engine.RestoreBackupLighting()
        Lighting.Brightness = 1
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
    end

    function Engine.ApplyLowGraphicsFPSBoost()
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic end
        end
    end

    function Engine.DeleteWorkspacePartsByName(n)
        if not n then return end
        for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and string.find(string.lower(v.Name), string.lower(n), 1, true) then
                v.Parent = nil
                table.insert(State.DeletedPartsBackup, v)
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.RestoreDeletedWorkspaceParts()
        for _, v in ipairs(State.DeletedPartsBackup) do
            pcall(function() v.Parent = Workspace end)
        end
        State.DeletedPartsBackup = {}
    end

end)
