    -- ====================================================================================
    -- [9.2] HD ADMIN EFSANEVI 3D KOMUT MOTORLARI (Fart, Poop, Kidnap/Clown, Anvil, UFO...)
    -- ====================================================================================
    function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminFart(targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        PlayUiSound("fart")
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "FARTED", true)
        local char = p.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end

        -- Yesil/Kahverengi Gaz Bulutu Kureleri
        for i = 1, 7 do
            local cloud = Instance.new("Part")
            cloud.Name = "BerksFartCloud"
            cloud.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            cloud.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)
            cloud.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.random(-2, 2), -1, 2.5 + i * 0.6)
            cloud.Anchored = true
            cloud.CanCollide = false
            cloud.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            cloud.Color = (i % 2 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(101, 163, 13) or Color3.fromRGB(133, 77, 14)
            cloud.Transparency = 0.25
            cloud.Parent = Workspace

            TweenService:Create(cloud, TweenInfo.new(0.95, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Size = Vector3.new(8.5, 8.5, 8.5),
                Transparency = 1,
                CFrame = cloud.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 4.5)
            }):Play()
            task.delay(1.0, function()
                if cloud and cloud.Parent then cloud:Destroy() end
            end)
        end

        -- Karakteri yukari ve ileri firlat
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 35 + Vector3.new(0, 62, 0)
        task.delay(2.5, function()
            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "FARTED", false)
        end)
    end

    -- ====================================================================================
    -- [9.2.1] HD ADMIN POOP KULESI: ALTIMIZDA SUREKLI KAKA CIKAR, STACKLENIR, COK YUKARI CIKARIZ VE EN SONUNDA PATLARIZ!
    -- ====================================================================================
    function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminPoop(targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        PlayUiSound("fart")
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "POOP_TOWER", true)
        local char = p.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp then return end

        local oldTower = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_PoopTower_" .. p.Name)
        if oldTower then oldTower:Destroy() end

        local poopTowerModel = Instance.new("Model")
        poopTowerModel.Name = "BerksAdmin_PoopTower_" .. p.Name
        poopTowerModel.Parent = Workspace

        local originPos = hrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0)
        local totalLayers = 38
        local layerStepHeight = 1.75

        -- Kaka ses kaynagi (Her katmanda artan basinc sesi!)
        local poopSound = Instance.new("Sound")
        poopSound.Name = "BerksPoopLoopSfx"
        poopSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://4809574295"
        poopSound.Volume = 1.6
        poopSound.Parent = hrp

        task.spawn(function()
            for layerIdx = 1, totalLayers do
                if not hrp or not hrp.Parent or not poopTowerModel.Parent then
                    break
                end

                -- Her katmanda kaka/gaz sesi cal ve perdeyi (Pitch) yukselt
                pcall(function()
                    poopSound.PlaybackSpeed = 0.8 + (layerIdx / totalLayers) * 0.95
                    poopSound:Play()
                end)

                local curHeight = (layerIdx - 1) * layerStepHeight
                local layerRadius = math.clamp(4.2 - (layerIdx * 0.04), 1.8, 4.2)
                local wobbleX = math.sin(layerIdx * 0.7) * 0.35
                local wobbleZ = math.cos(layerIdx * 0.7) * 0.35
                local layerPos = originPos + Vector3.new(wobbleX, curHeight, wobbleZ)

                -- Ana kivrimli 3D kaka halkasi (Silindir + Kure kombinasyonu)
                local mainTurd = Instance.new("Part")
                mainTurd.Name = "PoopStackLayer_" .. tostring(layerIdx)
                mainTurd.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
                mainTurd.Size = Vector3.new(1.9, layerRadius, layerRadius)
                mainTurd.CFrame = CFrame.new(layerPos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
                mainTurd.Anchored = true
                mainTurd.CanCollide = true
                mainTurd.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
                mainTurd.Color = (layerIdx % 2 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(92, 54, 24) or Color3.fromRGB(110, 66, 30)
                mainTurd.Parent = poopTowerModel

                local sideBlob = Instance.new("Part")
                sideBlob.Name = "PoopCoilBlob_" .. tostring(layerIdx)
                sideBlob.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                sideBlob.Size = Vector3.new(layerRadius * 0.85, 2.1, layerRadius * 0.85)
                sideBlob.Position = layerPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0)
                sideBlob.Anchored = true
                sideBlob.CanCollide = false
                sideBlob.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
                sideBlob.Color = Color3.fromRGB(82, 46, 18)
                sideBlob.Parent = poopTowerModel

                -- Her 4 katmanda bir yesil duman / sinek efekti
                if layerIdx % 4 == 1 then
                    local stink = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                    stink.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(101, 163, 13), Color3.fromRGB(77, 124, 15))
                    stink.Size = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.8),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 2.6)
                    })
                    stink.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)
                    })
                    stink.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.5)
                    stink.Rate = 18
                    stink.Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 7)
                    stink.Parent = sideBlob
                end

                -- Diger oyuncular kuleye dokunursa kayip dussun
                if layerIdx <= 6 then
                    mainTurd.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                        local hitChar = hit and hit.Parent
                        if hitChar and hitChar ~= char then
                            local hitHum = hitChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            local hitHrp = hitChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if hitHum and hitHrp and not hitHum.Sit then
                                PlayUiSound("slip")
                                hitHum.Sit = true
                                hitHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-35, 35), 48, math.random(-35, 35))
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end

                -- Oyuncuyu kaka kulesinin en tepesinde surekli gokyuzune cikar!
                local playerTopPos = originPos + Vector3.new(wobbleX, curHeight + 3.6, wobbleZ)
                local curRot = hrp.CFrame - hrp.CFrame.Position
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(playerTopPos) * curRot
                if hum then
                    hum.Sit = (layerIdx % 2 == 0)
                end

                task.wait(0.18)
            end

            -- ZIRVEYE ULASILDI (~70 STUD YUKSEKLIK)! KISA TITREME VE ARDINDAN DEV PATLAMA!
            local topPeakPos = hrp and hrp.Position or (originPos + Vector3.new(0, totalLayers * layerStepHeight, 0))
            for shake = 1, 12 do
                if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                    hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(topPeakPos + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10) * 0.12, 0.5, math.random(-10, 10) * 0.12))
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
                task.wait(0.05)
            end

            -- EN SONUNDA DEV PATLAMA!
            PlayUiSound("explosion")
            PlayUiSound("fart")

            local exp = Instance.new("Explosion")
            exp.Position = topPeakPos
            exp.BlastRadius = 38
            exp.BlastPressure = 850000
            exp.Parent = Workspace

            -- 3D Patlama Kuresi ve Etrafa Sacilan 28 Adet 3D Kaka Parcasi
            local blastBall = Instance.new("Part")
            blastBall.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            blastBall.Size = Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)
            blastBall.Position = topPeakPos
            blastBall.Anchored = true
            blastBall.CanCollide = false
            blastBall.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            blastBall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(161, 98, 7)
            blastBall.Parent = Workspace

            TweenService:Create(blastBall, TweenInfo.new(0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Size = Vector3.new(58, 58, 58),
                Transparency = 1
            }):Play()
            task.delay(0.9, function()
                if blastBall and blastBall.Parent then blastBall:Destroy() end
            end)

            for chunkIdx = 1, 26 do
                local chunk = Instance.new("Part")
                chunk.Name = "PoopExplosionChunk_" .. tostring(chunkIdx)
                chunk.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                chunk.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 2.2)
                chunk.Position = topPeakPos + Vector3.new(math.random(-3, 3), math.random(-2, 4), math.random(-3, 3))
                chunk.Anchored = false
                chunk.CanCollide = true
                chunk.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
                chunk.Color = Color3.fromRGB(92, 54, 24)
                chunk.Parent = poopTowerModel
                chunk.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-95, 95), math.random(45, 125), math.random(-95, 95))
            end

            if hum and hum.Parent then
                hum.Sit = false
                hum.Health = 0
            end
            if char and char.Parent then
                pcall(function() char:BreakJoints() end)
            end

            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "POOP_TOWER", false)
            task.delay(6, function()
                if poopSound and poopSound.Parent then poopSound:Destroy() end
                if poopTowerModel and poopTowerModel.Parent then poopTowerModel:Destroy() end
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- ====================================================================================
    -- [9.2.2] GERCEK 3D PALYACO MODELI INSA EDICI + DEV KARAVAN + SIRK MUZIGI + 10 SANIYE SONRA PATLAMA (FLING YOK!)
    -- ====================================================================================
    function Engine.Build3DClownNPCModel(parentModel, clownName, suitColor, wigColor)
        local clown = Instance.new("Model")
        clown.Name = clownName or "Berks3DClown"
        clown.Parent = parentModel

        local partsList = {}
        local function addClownPart(pName, shape, sz, relCF, col, mat)
            local pt = Instance.new("Part")
            pt.Name = pName
            pt.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
            pt.Size = sz
            pt.Anchored = true
            pt.CanCollide = false
            pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            pt.Color = col
            pt.Parent = clown
            table.insert(partsList, { Part = pt, Offset = relCF })
            return pt
        end

        -- 1. Govde (Torso) + 3 Renkli Ponpon Dugme
        addClownPart("Torso", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(2.2, 2.4, 1.2), CFrame.new(0, 0, 0), suitColor or Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addClownPart("Button1", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 0.45), CFrame.new(0, 0.6, -0.62), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon)
        addClownPart("Button2", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 0.45), CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.62), Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), Enum.Material.Neon)
        addClownPart("Button3", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 0.45), CFrame.new(0, -0.6, -0.62), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon)

        -- 2. Yaka Firfiri (Clown Ruffle Collar)
        addClownPart("Collar", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.35, 2.6, 2.6), CFrame.new(0, 1.25, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(254, 240, 138), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

        -- 3. Beyaz Palyaco Kafasi + Parlak Kirmizi Palyaco Burnu + Gozler + Korkunc Gulumseme
        addClownPart("Head", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.85, 1.85, 1.85), CFrame.new(0, 2.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addClownPart("RedClownNose", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.68, 0.68, 0.68), CFrame.new(0, 2.2, -0.95), Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), Enum.Material.Neon)
        addClownPart("LeftEye", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.32, 0.32, 0.32), CFrame.new(-0.38, 2.45, -0.82), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon)
        addClownPart("RightEye", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.32, 0.32, 0.32), CFrame.new(0.38, 2.45, -0.82), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon)
        addClownPart("SmileMouth", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.95, 0.24, 0.25), CFrame.new(0, 1.78, -0.82), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Neon)

        -- 4. 5 Parcali Bonus Palyaco Perugu (Afro Wig) + Sirk Sapkasi
        local wCol = wigColor or Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22)
        addClownPart("WigTop", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.5, 1.2, 1.5), CFrame.new(0, 3.1, 0.1), wCol, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addClownPart("WigLeft", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.3, 1.3, 1.3), CFrame.new(-0.95, 2.45, 0), Color3.fromRGB(236, 72, 153), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addClownPart("WigRight", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.3, 1.3, 1.3), CFrame.new(0.95, 2.45, 0), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addClownPart("WigBack", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.4, 1.4, 1.2), CFrame.new(0, 2.4, 0.75), Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addClownPart("ClownHat", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(1.2, 0.9, 0.9), CFrame.new(0, 3.75, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon)

        -- 5. Kollar, Bacaklar ve Dev Kirmizi Palyaco Ayakkabilari
        addClownPart("LeftArm", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.9, 2.2, 0.9), CFrame.new(-1.55, 0.1, -0.3) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(35), 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addClownPart("RightArm", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.9, 2.2, 0.9), CFrame.new(1.55, 0.1, -0.3) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(35), 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addClownPart("LeftLeg", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.95, 2.2, 0.95), CFrame.new(-0.55, -2.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addClownPart("RightLeg", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.95, 2.2, 0.95), CFrame.new(0.55, -2.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addClownPart("LeftShoe", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.2, 0.75, 1.9), CFrame.new(-0.55, -3.25, -0.35), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        addClownPart("RightShoe", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(1.2, 0.75, 1.9), CFrame.new(0.55, -3.25, -0.35), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

        local function setClownCFrame(rootCF)
            for _, item in ipairs(partsList) do
                if item.Part and item.Part.Parent then
                    item.Part.CFrame = rootCF * item.Offset
                end
            end
        end

        return clown, setClownCFrame, partsList
    end

    function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminClownKidnap(targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local char = p.Character
        local tHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local tHum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not tHrp then return end

        -- ASLA FLING YOK! Sadece dev karavan + 3D palyacolar + klasik palyaco muzigi + 10 saniye kacirma + 10. saniyede patlama!
        PlayUiSound("horn")
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "KIDNAPPED_10S", true)

        local oldVan = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_ClownCaravan_" .. p.Name)
        if oldVan then oldVan:Destroy() end

        local vanModel = Instance.new("Model")
        vanModel.Name = "BerksAdmin_ClownCaravan_" .. p.Name
        vanModel.Parent = Workspace

        -- Dev Karavan Parcalari Listesi (14 stud genislik, 10.5 stud yukseklik, 26 stud uzunluk!)
        local vanParts = {}
        local function addVanPart(name, shape, sz, relCF, col, mat, trans)
            local pt = Instance.new("Part")
            pt.Name = name
            pt.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
            pt.Size = sz
            pt.Anchored = true
            pt.CanCollide = false
            pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            pt.Color = col
            pt.Transparency = trans or 0
            pt.Parent = vanModel
            local entry = { Part = pt, Offset = relCF }
            table.insert(vanParts, entry)
            return pt, entry
        end

        -- 1. Karavan Alt Taban, Tavan, Yan Duvarlar ve Renkli Sirk Kusaklari
        local mainFloor = addVanPart("CaravanFloor", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(13.6, 1.0, 26.0), CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
        addVanPart("CaravanRoof", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(13.8, 0.8, 22.0), CFrame.new(0, 10.4, 1.5), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
        addVanPart("RoofSignTop", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(8.5, 1.6, 1.2), CFrame.new(0, 11.5, -6.0), Color3.fromRGB(244, 63, 94), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)

        -- Sol ve Sag Karavan Duvarlari + Cam Pencereler + Neon Sirk Seritleri
        addVanPart("LeftWallLower", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.7, 5.2, 22.0), CFrame.new(-6.5, 4.2, 1.5), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
        addVanPart("RightWallLower", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.7, 5.2, 22.0), CFrame.new(6.5, 4.2, 1.5), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
        addVanPart("LeftWindowGlass", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.4, 3.4, 21.6), CFrame.new(-6.5, 8.4, 1.5), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.55)
        addVanPart("RightWindowGlass", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.4, 3.4, 21.6), CFrame.new(6.5, 8.4, 1.5), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.55)
        addVanPart("LeftCircusStripe", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.85, 1.3, 22.2), CFrame.new(-6.5, 4.5, 1.5), Color3.fromRGB(244, 63, 94), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)
        addVanPart("RightCircusStripe", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.85, 1.3, 22.2), CFrame.new(6.5, 4.5, 1.5), Color3.fromRGB(244, 63, 94), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)
        addVanPart("LeftYellowStripe", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.88, 0.5, 22.2), CFrame.new(-6.5, 3.3, 1.5), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)
        addVanPart("RightYellowStripe", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(0.88, 0.5, 22.2), CFrame.new(6.5, 3.3, 1.5), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)

        -- On Kaput, On Cam (Windshield), Tampon, Izgara ve Farlar
        addVanPart("FrontEngineHood", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(13.6, 4.6, 4.5), CFrame.new(0, 3.9, -11.0), Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
        addVanPart("FrontWindshield", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(12.8, 4.2, 0.5), CFrame.new(0, 8.1, -9.2), Color3.fromRGB(125, 211, 252), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.45)
        addVanPart("FrontBumper", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(14.2, 1.2, 1.2), CFrame.new(0, 1.8, -13.3), Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
        addVanPart("RearBumper", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(14.2, 1.2, 1.2), CFrame.new(0, 1.8, 13.0), Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
        addVanPart("FrontGrille", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(7.5, 2.4, 0.4), CFrame.new(0, 3.8, -13.3), Color3.fromRGB(71, 85, 105), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)

        local hlLeft = addVanPart("HeadlightLeft", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.5, 1.8, 1.8), CFrame.new(-4.8, 4.2, -13.3) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Color3.fromRGB(254, 240, 138), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)
        local hlRight = addVanPart("HeadlightRight", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.5, 1.8, 1.8), CFrame.new(4.8, 4.2, -13.3) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Color3.fromRGB(254, 240, 138), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)
        local spotL = Instance.new("SpotLight", hlLeft)
        spotL.Brightness = 4
        spotL.Range = 45
        local spotR = Instance.new("SpotLight", hlRight)
        spotR.Brightness = 4
        spotR.Range = 45

        -- Direksiyon, Sofor Koltugu ve Arka Kafes Koltuklari
        addVanPart("DriverSeatBench", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(4.2, 1.2, 3.2), CFrame.new(-3.2, 2.4, -5.5), Color3.fromRGB(185, 28, 28), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
        addVanPart("PassengerSeatBench", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(4.2, 1.2, 3.2), CFrame.new(3.2, 2.4, -5.5), Color3.fromRGB(185, 28, 28), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
        addVanPart("SteeringWheel", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(0.4, 2.2, 2.2), CFrame.new(-3.2, 4.8, -7.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(25), math.rad(90), 0), Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)

        -- 4 Adet Dev 3D Tekerlek + Sari Sirk Jantlari
        local wheelPositions = {
            CFrame.new(-6.8, 1.8, -8.5),
            CFrame.new(6.8, 1.8, -8.5),
            CFrame.new(-6.8, 1.8, 8.5),
            CFrame.new(6.8, 1.8, 8.5)
        }
        for wIdx, wCF in ipairs(wheelPositions) do
            addVanPart("Tire_" .. tostring(wIdx), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(1.6, 3.8, 3.8), wCF, Color3.fromRGB(17, 24, 39), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
            addVanPart("Hubcap_" .. tostring(wIdx), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(1.75, 2.1, 2.1), wCF, Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)
        end

        -- 2 Adet Acilir-Kapanir Arka Kapi (RearDoorLeft & RearDoorRight)
        local _, leftDoorEntry = addVanPart("RearDoorLeft", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(6.4, 8.6, 0.6), CFrame.new(-3.2, 5.8, 12.4), Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
        local _, rightDoorEntry = addVanPart("RearDoorRight", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(6.4, 8.6, 0.6), CFrame.new(3.2, 5.8, 12.4), Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)

        -- Karavan Ustu Canli Geri Sayim Tabelasi (10 Saniye Sayaci!)
        local timerBg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        timerBg.Name = "BerksKidnapCountdownGui"
        timerBg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 42)
        timerBg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 14.5, 0)
        timerBg.AlwaysOnTop = true
        timerBg.Adornee = mainFloor
        timerBg.Parent = mainFloor

        local timerFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        timerFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        timerFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25)
        timerFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
        timerFrame.Parent = timerBg
        local tfCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", timerFrame)
        tfCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local tfStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", timerFrame)
        tfStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(244, 63, 94)
        tfStroke.Thickness = 2

        local timerText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        timerText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0)
        timerText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 0)
        timerText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        timerText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        timerText.TextSize = 13
        timerText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(254, 240, 138)
        timerText.Text = "PALYACO KARAVANI GELIYOR!"
        timerText.Parent = timerFrame

        -- KARAVANIN ICINDE 3 ADET GERCEK 3D PALYACO MODELI!
        local _, updateDriverClown = Engine.Build3DClownNPCModel(vanModel, "DriverClown", Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247), Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22))
        local _, updateGrabberLeft = Engine.Build3DClownNPCModel(vanModel, "GrabberClownLeft", Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128))
        local _, updateGrabberRight = Engine.Build3DClownNPCModel(vanModel, "GrabberClownRight", Color3.fromRGB(59, 130, 246), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21))

        -- ARKADA ROBLOX KLASIK PALYACO / SIRK MUZIGI (Looped = true)
        local circusMusic = Instance.new("Sound")
        circusMusic.Name = "BerksClassicClownMusic"
        circusMusic.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1846458016"
        circusMusic.Volume = 2.0
        circusMusic.Looped = true
        circusMusic.Parent = mainFloor
        pcall(function() circusMusic:Play() end)

        local backupCircus = Instance.new("Sound")
        backupCircus.Name = "BerksBackupCircusMusic"
        backupCircus.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1837849285"
        backupCircus.Volume = 1.5
        backupCircus.Looped = true
        backupCircus.Parent = SoundService
        pcall(function() backupCircus:Play() end)

        local function setCaravanCFrame(rootCF, doorOpenAlpha, grabberOutDist)
            local openAng = math.rad((doorOpenAlpha or 0) * 85)
            leftDoorEntry.Offset = CFrame.new(-3.2 - (doorOpenAlpha or 0) * 2.5, 5.8, 12.4 + (doorOpenAlpha or 0) * 2.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, -openAng, 0)
            rightDoorEntry.Offset = CFrame.new(3.2 + (doorOpenAlpha or 0) * 2.5, 5.8, 12.4 + (doorOpenAlpha or 0) * 2.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, openAng, 0)

            for _, item in ipairs(vanParts) do
                if item.Part and item.Part.Parent then
                    item.Part.CFrame = rootCF * item.Offset
                end
            end

            -- 1. Sofor Palyaco direksiyon basinda
            updateDriverClown(rootCF * CFrame.new(-3.2, 5.2, -5.2))
            -- 2. ve 3. Palyacolar karavanin arkasinda (kapi acilinca disari cikip oyuncuyu iceri cekerler!)
            local zGrab = 6.0 + (grabberOutDist or 0)
            updateGrabberLeft(rootCF * CFrame.new(-2.4, 5.2, zGrab))
            updateGrabberRight(rootCF * CFrame.new(2.4, 5.2, zGrab))
        end

        local baseTargetCF = tHrp.CFrame
        local approachStartCF = baseTargetCF * CFrame.new(0, 0, 52)
        local stopBehindPlayerCF = baseTargetCF * CFrame.new(0, 0, -14.5)

        task.spawn(function()
            -- ASAMA 1 (1.2 Saniye): Dev Karavan arkadan korna ve palyaco muzigiyle yaklasir
            for step = 1, 36 do
                if not vanModel.Parent then return end
                local alpha = step / 36
                local curCF = approachStartCF:Lerp(stopBehindPlayerCF, alpha)
                setCaravanCFrame(curCF, 0, 0)
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end

            PlayUiSound("horn")
            timerText.Text = "PALYACOLAR SENI YAKALADI!"

            -- ASAMA 2 (1.1 Saniye): Arka kapilar acilir, 2 Palyaco disari cikip oyuncuyu yakalar ve karavanin icine ceker!
            for step = 1, 32 do
                if not vanModel.Parent then return end
                local alpha = step / 32
                local doorAlpha = math.sin(alpha * math.pi)
                local grabDist = math.sin(alpha * math.pi) * 8.5
                setCaravanCFrame(stopBehindPlayerCF, doorAlpha, grabDist)

                if tHrp and tHrp.Parent then
                    if tHum then tHum.Sit = true end
                    tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    tHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    local pullTargetCF = stopBehindPlayerCF * CFrame.new(0, 4.2, 2.5)
                    tHrp.CFrame = baseTargetCF:Lerp(pullTargetCF, alpha)
                end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end

            -- Kapilar kilitlenir!
            PlayUiSound("anvil")

            -- ASAMA 3 (TAM 10 SANIYE SURUS!): Oyuncu karavanin icinde palyacolarla birlikte kacirilir (ASLA FLING YOK!)
            local driveStartTime = tick()
            local driveDuration = 10.0
            local driveStartCF = stopBehindPlayerCF

            while (tick() - driveStartTime) < driveDuration do
                if not vanModel.Parent then break end
                local elapsed = tick() - driveStartTime
                local remaining = math.max(0, math.ceil(driveDuration - elapsed))
                timerText.Text = string.format("KACIRILDIN! PATLAMAYA: %d SANIYE!", remaining)

                -- Karavan ileri dogru hafif yaylanarak (suspension bounce) ilerler
                local forwardDist = elapsed * 28.0
                local bounceY = math.sin(elapsed * 14) * 0.35
                local swayX = math.sin(elapsed * 3.5) * 2.2
                local currentVanCF = driveStartCF * CFrame.new(swayX, bounceY, -forwardDist)

                setCaravanCFrame(currentVanCF, 0, 0)

                -- Oyuncuyu karavanin tam ortasinda, 3 palyaconun arasinda tut (Fling yok!)
                if tHrp and tHrp.Parent then
                    if tHum then tHum.Sit = true end
                    tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    tHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    tHrp.CFrame = currentVanCF * CFrame.new(0, 4.2, 2.0)
                end

                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end

            -- ASAMA 4 (10. SANIYE DOLDU!): KARAVAN VE OYUNCU DEV BIR PATLAMAYLA HAVAYA UCARAK PATLAR!
            local finalBlastPos = (tHrp and tHrp.Position) or mainFloor.Position
            pcall(function()
                circusMusic:Stop()
                circusMusic:Destroy()
                backupCircus:Stop()
                backupCircus:Destroy()
            end)

            PlayUiSound("explosion")
            PlayUiSound("anvil")

            local exp = Instance.new("Explosion")
            exp.Position = finalBlastPos
            exp.BlastRadius = 48
            exp.BlastPressure = 950000
            exp.Parent = Workspace

            -- 3 Katmanli 3D Ates Topu ve Sok Dalgasi
            for idx, col in ipairs({ Color3.fromRGB(254, 240, 138), Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22), Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68) }) do
                local fb = Instance.new("Part")
                fb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                fb.Size = Vector3.new(6, 6, 6)
                fb.Position = finalBlastPos
                fb.Anchored = true
                fb.CanCollide = false
                fb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                fb.Color = col
                fb.Parent = Workspace
                TweenService:Create(fb, TweenInfo.new(0.65 + idx * 0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    Size = Vector3.new(45 + idx * 18, 45 + idx * 18, 45 + idx * 18),
                    Transparency = 1
                }):Play()
                task.delay(1.3, function()
                    if fb and fb.Parent then fb:Destroy() end
                end)
            end

            -- Karavan parcalarini serbest birakip patlamayla etrafa sac!
            for _, item in ipairs(vanParts) do
                if item.Part and item.Part.Parent then
                    item.Part.Anchored = false
                    item.Part.CanCollide = true
                    local fire = Instance.new("Fire", item.Part)
                    fire.Size = 8
                    item.Part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-110, 110), math.random(55, 140), math.random(-110, 110))
                end
            end

            -- Oyuncuyu 10. saniyede patlat!
            if tHum and tHum.Parent then
                tHum.Sit = false
                tHum.Health = 0
            end
            if char and char.Parent then
                pcall(function() char:BreakJoints() end)
            end

            RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "KIDNAPPED_10S", false)
            task.delay(4.5, function()
                if vanModel and vanModel.Parent then vanModel:Destroy() end
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- HD ADMIN DEMIR ORS DUSURME (ANVIL - GERCEK 4 PARCALI 3D DEMIRCI ORSU MODELI)
    function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminAnvilDrop(targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local char = p.Character
        local tHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not tHrp then return end

        local targetPos = tHrp.Position
        local anvilModel = Instance.new("Model")
        anvilModel.Name = "BerksAdmin_3DAnvil"
        anvilModel.Parent = Workspace

        local base = Instance.new("Part")
        base.Name = "AnvilBase"
        base.Size = Vector3.new(5.2, 1.4, 7.4)
        base.Anchored = true
        base.CanCollide = false
        base.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        base.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 33, 40)
        base.Parent = anvilModel

        local waist = Instance.new("Part")
        waist.Size = Vector3.new(3.2, 1.8, 4.6)
        waist.Anchored = true
        waist.CanCollide = false
        waist.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        waist.Color = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 52)
        waist.Parent = anvilModel

        local topFace = Instance.new("Part")
        topFace.Size = Vector3.new(5.6, 1.6, 8.8)
        topFace.Anchored = true
        topFace.CanCollide = false
        topFace.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        topFace.Color = Color3.fromRGB(24, 27, 34)
        topFace.Parent = anvilModel

        local horn = Instance.new("WedgePart")
        horn.Size = Vector3.new(3.6, 1.4, 3.8)
        horn.Anchored = true
        horn.CanCollide = false
        horn.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        horn.Color = Color3.fromRGB(24, 27, 34)
        horn.Parent = anvilModel

        task.spawn(function()
            for step = 1, 18 do
                local y = 52 - (step / 18) * 51.5
                local curPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(0, y, 0)
                base.Position = curPos
                waist.Position = curPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                topFace.Position = curPos + Vector3.new(0, 3.0, 0)
                horn.CFrame = CFrame.new(curPos + Vector3.new(0, 3.0, -6.2))
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            PlayUiSound("anvil")
            Engine.MorphHDAdminBodyProportions(p, 2.4, 0.2, 2.4)
            Engine.SetPlayerRagdollState(p, true)
            task.delay(3.0, function()
                if anvilModel and anvilModel.Parent then anvilModel:Destroy() end
                Engine.SetPlayerRagdollState(p, false)
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- HD ADMIN SURATA KREMALI TURTA FIRLATMA (PIE)
    function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminPieThrow(targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local char = p.Character
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local tHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not head or not tHrp then return end

        local pie = Instance.new("Part")
        pie.Name = "BerksAdmin_CreamPie"
        pie.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        pie.Size = Vector3.new(0.8, 3.2, 3.2)
        pie.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -14) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
        pie.Anchored = true
        pie.CanCollide = false
        pie.Color = Color3.fromRGB(254, 249, 195)
        pie.Parent = Workspace

        TweenService:Create(pie, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
            CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.8) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
        }):Play()

        task.delay(0.29, function()
            PlayUiSound("slip")
            tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = -tHrp.CFrame.LookVector * 42 + Vector3.new(0, 24, 0)
            task.delay(3.0, function()
                if pie and pie.Parent then pie:Destroy() end
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- HD ADMIN UFO ILE UZAYA KACIRMA (UFO ABDUCTION)
    function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminUFOAbduct(targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local char = p.Character
        local tHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local tHum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not tHrp then return end

        PlayUiSound("laser")
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "UFO_ABDUCTED", true)
        local basePos = tHrp.Position

        local ufoModel = Instance.new("Model")
        ufoModel.Name = "BerksAdmin_UFO"
        ufoModel.Parent = Workspace

        local saucer = Instance.new("Part")
        saucer.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        saucer.Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 18, 18)
        saucer.CFrame = CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(0, 34, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
        saucer.Anchored = true
        saucer.CanCollide = false
        saucer.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        saucer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184)
        saucer.Parent = ufoModel

        local dome = Instance.new("Part")
        dome.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        dome.Size = Vector3.new(9, 7, 9)
        dome.Position = basePos + Vector3.new(0, 35.5, 0)
        dome.Anchored = true
        dome.CanCollide = false
        dome.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
        dome.Color = Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128)
        dome.Transparency = 0.35
        dome.Parent = ufoModel

        local beam = Instance.new("Part")
        beam.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        beam.Size = Vector3.new(34, 8.0, 8.0)
        beam.CFrame = CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(0, 17, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
        beam.Anchored = true
        beam.CanCollide = false
        beam.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        beam.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 212, 191)
        beam.Transparency = 0.55
        beam.Parent = ufoModel

        task.spawn(function()
            for step = 1, 60 do
                if tHrp and tHrp.Parent then
                    tHrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(basePos + Vector3.new(0, (step / 60) * 32, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(step * 10), 0)
                    tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            PlayUiSound("explosion")
            if tHum then tHum.Health = 0 end
            if ufoModel and ufoModel.Parent then ufoModel:Destroy() end
        end)
    end

    -- HD ADMIN BUHARLI TREN CARPMASI (TRAIN / THOMAS - DETAYLI 3D LOKOMOTIF)
    function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminTrainHit(targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local char = p.Character
        local tHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not tHrp then return end

        PlayUiSound("horn")
        local startCF = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 65)
        local endCF = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, -75)

        local trainModel = Instance.new("Model")
        trainModel.Name = "BerksAdmin_SteamTrain"
        trainModel.Parent = Workspace

        local boiler = Instance.new("Part")
        boiler.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        boiler.Size = Vector3.new(16, 6.5, 6.5)
        boiler.Anchored = true
        boiler.CanCollide = false
        boiler.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        boiler.Color = Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235)
        boiler.Parent = trainModel

        local cab = Instance.new("Part")
        cab.Size = Vector3.new(7.4, 9.2, 7.0)
        cab.Anchored = true
        cab.CanCollide = false
        cab.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        cab.Color = Color3.fromRGB(29, 78, 216)
        cab.Parent = trainModel

        local chimney = Instance.new("Part")
        chimney.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        chimney.Size = Vector3.new(3.8, 2.0, 2.0)
        chimney.Anchored = true
        chimney.CanCollide = false
        chimney.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        chimney.Color = Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42)
        chimney.Parent = trainModel

        task.spawn(function()
            for step = 1, 28 do
                local alpha = step / 28
                local curCF = startCF:Lerp(endCF, alpha)
                boiler.CFrame = curCF * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
                cab.CFrame = curCF * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 6.5)
                chimney.CFrame = curCF * CFrame.new(0, 4.2, -5.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
                if step == 14 then
                    PlayUiSound("explosion")
                    Engine.CreateExplosionAtPlayer(p)
                    Engine.ExecuteAngularVelocityFling(p)
                end
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
            if trainModel and trainModel.Parent then trainModel:Destroy() end
        end)
    end

    -- HD ADMIN NUKLEER MANTAR BULUTU (NUKE)
    function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminNukeStrike(targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local char = p.Character
        local tHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local center = tHrp and tHrp.Position or Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)

        PlayUiSound("explosion")
        PlayUiSound("anvil")
        BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("SHOCKWAVE", "ALL", "150")

        local stem = Instance.new("Part")
        stem.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        stem.Size = Vector3.new(10, 8, 8)
        stem.CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
        stem.Anchored = true
        stem.CanCollide = false
        stem.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        stem.Color = Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22)
        stem.Parent = Workspace

        local cap = Instance.new("Part")
        cap.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        cap.Size = Vector3.new(14, 10, 14)
        cap.Position = center + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0)
        cap.Anchored = true
        cap.CanCollide = false
        cap.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        cap.Color = Color3.fromRGB(251, 191, 36)
        cap.Parent = Workspace

        TweenService:Create(stem, TweenInfo.new(1.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = Vector3.new(95, 28, 28),
            CFrame = CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 45, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
            Transparency = 1
        }):Play()

        TweenService:Create(cap, TweenInfo.new(1.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = Vector3.new(110, 65, 110),
            Position = center + Vector3.new(0, 88, 0),
            Transparency = 1
        }):Play()

        local exp = Instance.new("Explosion")
        exp.Position = center
        exp.BlastRadius = 85
        exp.BlastPressure = 950000
        exp.Parent = Workspace

        task.delay(1.9, function()
            if stem and stem.Parent then stem:Destroy() end
            if cap and cap.Parent then cap:Destroy() end
        end)
    end

    -- [9.2.3] COK DETAYLI ARASTIRILMIS HD ADMIN / HOMELANDER LASER EYES (CIFT GOZ 3D KURE + RAYCAST CIFT KATMANLI LAZER + YANIK IZI + PATLAMA!)
    -- ====================================================================================
    function Engine.ToggleHDAdminLaserEyes(targetPlayer, enable)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        State.LaserEyesPlayers[p.Name] = enable or nil
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "LASEREYES", enable)

        local char = p.Character
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")

        -- Onceki lazer parcalarini temizle
        local oldFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksLaserRig_" .. p.Name)
        if oldFolder then oldFolder:Destroy() end
        if head then
            local oldL = head:FindFirstChild("BerksEyeOrb_L")
            if oldL then oldL:Destroy() end
            local oldR = head:FindFirstChild("BerksEyeOrb_R")
            if oldR then oldR:Destroy() end
        end

        if not enable or not head then return end

        PlayUiSound("laser")

        -- 1. Karakterin sol ve sag gozune parlayan 3D Neon Goz Kureleri kaynakla (WeldConstraint)
        local function createGlowingEyeSocket(name, xOffset)
            local eyeOrb = Instance.new("Part")
            eyeOrb.Name = name
            eyeOrb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            eyeOrb.Size = Vector3.new(0.26, 0.26, 0.26)
            eyeOrb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            eyeOrb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 30)
            eyeOrb.CanCollide = false
            eyeOrb.Massless = true
            eyeOrb.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(xOffset, 0.16, -0.54)
            eyeOrb.Parent = head

            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            w.Part0 = head
            w.Part1 = eyeOrb
            w.Parent = eyeOrb

            local pl = Instance.new("PointLight")
            pl.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40)
            pl.Brightness = 3.5
            pl.Range = 12
            pl.Parent = eyeOrb

            return eyeOrb
        end

        createGlowingEyeSocket("BerksEyeOrb_L", -0.26)
        createGlowingEyeSocket("BerksEyeOrb_R", 0.26)

        -- 2. Lazer Isinlari ve Carpma Kuresi Klasoru (RenderStepped icinde her karede Raycast ile guncellenir!)
        local rigFolder = Instance.new("Model")
        rigFolder.Name = "BerksLaserRig_" .. p.Name
        rigFolder.Parent = Workspace
    end

    -- HD ADMIN 3D JETPACK (CIFT SILINDIR ROKET TUPU + MERKEZ GOVDE + ALEV PARTIKULLERI)
    function Engine.ToggleHDAdminJetpack(targetPlayer, enable)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        State.JetpackPlayers[p.Name] = enable or nil
        State.FlyJump = enable
        RecordPlayerP2PEffect(p.Name, "JETPACK", enable)
        local char = p.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        local old = char:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_Jetpack")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        if enable then
            PlayUiSound("coil")
            local jpModel = Instance.new("Model")
            jpModel.Name = "BerksAdmin_Jetpack"
            jpModel.Parent = char

            local function weldJpPart(sz, shape, offsetCF, col, mat)
                local pt = Instance.new("Part")
                pt.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
                pt.Size = sz
                pt.Color = col
                pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Metal
                pt.CanCollide = false
                pt.Massless = true
                pt.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * offsetCF
                pt.Parent = jpModel
                local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                w.Part0 = hrp
                w.Part1 = pt
                w.Parent = pt
                return pt
            end

            weldJpPart(Vector3.new(1.8, 2.0, 0.7), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 0.85), Color3.fromRGB(51, 65, 85), Enum.Material.Metal)
            local leftTank = weldJpPart(Vector3.new(2.8, 0.95, 0.95), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(-0.75, 0.2, 1.1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(226, 232, 240), Enum.Material.Metal)
            local rightTank = weldJpPart(Vector3.new(2.8, 0.95, 0.95), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(0.75, 0.2, 1.1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(226, 232, 240), Enum.Material.Metal)
            weldJpPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 1.0, 1.0), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(-0.75, 0.2, 1.1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Neon)
            weldJpPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 1.0, 1.0), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(0.75, 0.2, 1.1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Neon)

            for _, tank in ipairs({ leftTank, rightTank }) do
                local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
                fire.Heat = -18
                fire.Size = 4
                fire.Parent = tank
            end
        end
    end

    -- HD ADMIN KAFA BOYUTU (BIGHEAD / SMALLHEAD / HEADSIZE)
    function Engine.SetHDAdminHeadScale(targetPlayer, scale)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local s = math.clamp(tonumber(scale) or 1, 0.2, 8)
        local char = p.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum:FindFirstChild("HeadScale") then
            hum.HeadScale.Value = s
        elseif char:FindFirstChild("Head") then
            char.Head.Size = Vector3.new(2 * s, 1 * s, 1 * s)
        end
    end

    -- HD ADMIN VUCUT ORANLARI (FAT / THIN / TALL / SHORT / SQUASH)
    function Engine.MorphHDAdminBodyProportions(targetPlayer, widthScale, heightScale, depthScale)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local char = p.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            if hum:FindFirstChild("BodyWidthScale") then hum.BodyWidthScale.Value = widthScale or 1 end
            if hum:FindFirstChild("BodyHeightScale") then hum.BodyHeightScale.Value = heightScale or 1 end
            if hum:FindFirstChild("BodyDepthScale") then hum.BodyDepthScale.Value = depthScale or 1 end
        end
    end

    -- ====================================================================================
    -- [9.3] GERCEK COK PARCALI 3D ESYA VE SILAH MODELLERI (Speed/Gravity/Fusion/Regen Coil, Sword, Hyperlaser, BanHammer, Subspace, RPG, SlapHand, Trowel, Paintball, Lightsaber, PortalGun, Grapple)
    -- ====================================================================================
    function Engine.GiveHDAdminClassicGear(gearType, targetPlayer)
        local target = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local g = string.lower(tostring(gearType or "sword"))
        PlayUiSound("coil")

        local toolName = "Berk's " .. string.upper(g)
        if target == LocalPlayer then
            local oldTool = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild(toolName)
            if oldTool then oldTool:Destroy() end
            if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild(toolName) then
                LocalPlayer.Character[toolName]:Destroy()
            end
        end

        local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.Name = toolName
        tool.RequiresHandle = true
        tool.CanBeDropped = true

        local handle = Instance.new("Part")
        handle.Name = "Handle"
        handle.CanCollide = false
        handle.Massless = true
        handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 1.2, 0.6)
        handle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
        handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(51, 65, 85)
        handle.Parent = tool

        -- Yardimci: Handle uzerine 3D alt-parca (Sub-Part) kaynaklama (WeldConstraint)
        local function weld3DGearPart(pName, shape, sz, offsetCF, col, mat, trans)
            local pt = Instance.new("Part")
            pt.Name = pName
            pt.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
            pt.Size = sz
            pt.CanCollide = false
            pt.Massless = true
            pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Metal
            pt.Color = col
            pt.Transparency = trans or 0
            pt.CFrame = handle.CFrame * offsetCF
            pt.Parent = tool

            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            w.Part0 = handle
            w.Part1 = pt
            w.Parent = pt
            return pt
        end

        -- 1. GERCEK 3D SPIRAL YAY (COIL) MODELLERI (SpeedCoil, GravityCoil, FusionCoil, RegenCoil)
        if g == "speedcoil" or g == "gravitycoil" or g == "fusioncoil" or g == "regencoil" then
            handle.Transparency = 1
            local coilColor = (g == "speedcoil" and Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68))
                or (g == "gravitycoil" and Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248))
                or (g == "fusioncoil" and Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247))
                or Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94)

            -- Orijinal Roblox Coil Mesh + Gercek 10 Halkali 3D Helisel Yay Modeli (Kolun etrafina sarilir!)
            local meshPart = weld3DGearPart("ClassicCoilMeshHolder", Enum.PartType.Block, Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 2.0), CFrame.new(0, 0, 0), coilColor, Enum.Material.Neon, 0.15)
            local spMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
            spMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
            spMesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://16606212"
            spMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1.05, 1.05, 1.05)
            spMesh.Parent = meshPart

            -- 10 Adet 3D Spiral Halka + Ic Enerji Cubugu (Mesh yuklenmese bile %100 3D Yay gorunumu!)
            weld3DGearPart("CoilEnergyCore", Enum.PartType.Cylinder, Vector3.new(2.2, 0.35, 0.35), CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), coilColor, Enum.Material.Neon, 0.25)
            for ringIdx = 1, 9 do
                local yOff = -1.0 + (ringIdx - 1) * 0.25
                local tilt = (ringIdx % 2 == 0) and 16 or -16
                weld3DGearPart(
                    "HelixRing_" .. tostring(ringIdx),
                    Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
                    Vector3.new(0.18, 1.55, 1.55),
                    CFrame.new(0, yOff, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(tilt), 0, math.rad(90)),
                    coilColor,
                    Enum.Material.Neon,
                    0
                )
            end
            weld3DGearPart("CoilCapTop", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 0.42), CFrame.new(0.75, 1.05, 0), Color3.fromRGB(226, 232, 240), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
            weld3DGearPart("CoilCapBottom", Enum.PartType.Ball, Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 0.42), CFrame.new(-0.75, -1.05, 0), Color3.fromRGB(226, 232, 240), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)

            local pl = Instance.new("PointLight", handle)
            pl.Color = coilColor
            pl.Brightness = 2.5
            pl.Range = 10

            local regenConn = nil
            tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
                PlayUiSound("coil")
                if g == "gravitycoil" or g == "fusioncoil" then
                    Workspace.Gravity = 50
                end
                if (g == "speedcoil" or g == "fusioncoil") and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                    LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").WalkSpeed = 64
                end
                if g == "regencoil" then
                    regenConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
                        local h = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if h and h.Health < h.MaxHealth then
                            h.Health = math.min(h.MaxHealth, h.Health + 25 * (dt or 0.016))
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)

            tool.Unequipped:Connect(function()
                if g == "gravitycoil" or g == "fusioncoil" then
                    Workspace.Gravity = 196.2
                end
                if (g == "speedcoil" or g == "fusioncoil") and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                    LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").WalkSpeed = 16
                end
                if regenConn then
                    regenConn:Disconnect()
                    regenConn = nil
                end
            end)

        -- 2. GERCEK 3D LINKED SWORD MODELI (Kabza Topuzu, Sap, Altin Siperlik, Celik Namlu, Keskin Uc)
        elseif g == "sword" then
            handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 1.1, 0.35)
