    -- ====================================================================================
    -- [9.4] 3D ARACLAR (CAR / HELI / TANK), 3D KOZMETIKLER (WINGS / CROWN / HALO / HORNS / AURA / PET / THRONE / TITAN), 3D YAPILAR VE FELAKETLER
    -- ====================================================================================
    function Engine.Spawn3DAdminVehicle(targetPlayer, vehicleType, enable)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local char = p.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp then return end

        local vName = "Berks3DVehicle_" .. tostring(vehicleType)
        local old = char:FindFirstChild(vName)
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        if not enable then
            if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 16 end
            if vehicleType == "heli" then Engine.StopFlightEngine(p) end
            return
        end

        PlayUiSound("horn")
        local vModel = Instance.new("Model")
        vModel.Name = vName
        vModel.Parent = char

        local function weldVehPart(sz, shape, offsetCF, col, mat, trans)
            local pt = Instance.new("Part")
            pt.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
            pt.Size = sz
            pt.Color = col
            pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Metal
            pt.Transparency = trans or 0
            pt.CanCollide = false
            pt.Massless = true
            pt.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * offsetCF
            pt.Parent = vModel
            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint", pt)
            w.Part0 = hrp
            w.Part1 = pt
            return pt
        end

        if vehicleType == "car" then
            if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 85 end
            weldVehPart(Vector3.new(6.8, 1.4, 13.5), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, -1.8, 0), Color3.fromRGB(225, 29, 72), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
            weldVehPart(Vector3.new(6.9, 0.35, 13.7), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, -2.3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)
            weldVehPart(Vector3.new(5.8, 1.8, 4.5), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -1.5), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.45)
            weldVehPart(Vector3.new(6.8, 0.3, 1.4), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, -0.3, 6.2), Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
            for _, wOff in ipairs({ CFrame.new(-3.5, -2.2, -4.2), CFrame.new(3.5, -2.2, -4.2), CFrame.new(-3.5, -2.2, 4.2), CFrame.new(3.5, -2.2, 4.2) }) do
                weldVehPart(Vector3.new(1.1, 2.4, 2.4), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, wOff, Color3.fromRGB(17, 24, 39), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
            end
        elseif vehicleType == "heli" then
            weldVehPart(Vector3.new(5.4, 4.6, 8.8), Enum.PartType.Ball, CFrame.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59), Enum.Material.Metal, 0.15)
            weldVehPart(Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 8.5), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 7.5), Color3.fromRGB(51, 65, 85), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
            weldVehPart(Vector3.new(16.0, 0.25, 1.1), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, 3.6, 0), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)
            weldVehPart(Vector3.new(1.1, 0.25, 16.0), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, 3.6, 0), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)
            Engine.StartFlightEngine(p, 95)
        elseif vehicleType == "tank" then
            if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 42 end
            weldVehPart(Vector3.new(8.6, 2.6, 14.0), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, -1.4, 0), Color3.fromRGB(54, 83, 20), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
            weldVehPart(Vector3.new(5.6, 2.2, 6.2), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, 0.8, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(63, 98, 18), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
            weldVehPart(Vector3.new(9.5, 0.9, 0.9), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(0, 0.9, -6.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
        end
    end

    function Engine.Toggle3DCharacterCosmetic(targetPlayer, cosmeticType, enable)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local char = p.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not hrp or not head then return end

        local cName = "Berks3DCosmetic_" .. tostring(cosmeticType)
        local old = char:FindFirstChild(cName)
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        if not enable then
            if cosmeticType == "titan" then Engine.SetP2PCharacterScale(p, 1.0) end
            return
        end

        PlayUiSound("coil")
        local cModel = Instance.new("Model")
        cModel.Name = cName
        cModel.Parent = char

        local function weldCosPart(anchorPart, sz, shape, offsetCF, col, mat)
            local pt = Instance.new("Part")
            pt.Shape = shape or Enum.PartType.Block
            pt.Size = sz
            pt.Color = col
            pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Neon
            pt.CanCollide = false
            pt.Massless = true
            pt.CFrame = anchorPart.CFrame * offsetCF
            pt.Parent = cModel
            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint", pt)
            w.Part0 = anchorPart
            w.Part1 = pt
            return pt
        end

        if cosmeticType == "wings" then
            for i = 1, 5 do
                weldCosPart(hrp, Vector3.new(0.25, 3.8 - i * 0.45, 0.9), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(-1.2 - i * 0.75, 0.8 - i * 0.2, 0.8) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(22 + i * 8)), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon)
                weldCosPart(hrp, Vector3.new(0.25, 3.8 - i * 0.45, 0.9), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(1.2 + i * 0.75, 0.8 - i * 0.2, 0.8) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-22 - i * 8)), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon)
            end
        elseif cosmeticType == "halo" then
            weldCosPart(head, Vector3.new(0.25, 2.4, 2.4), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(0, 1.65, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon)
        elseif cosmeticType == "horns" then
            weldCosPart(head, Vector3.new(0.45, 1.5, 0.45), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(-0.65, 1.1, -0.1) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(20), 0, math.rad(28)), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Neon)
            weldCosPart(head, Vector3.new(0.45, 1.5, 0.45), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0.65, 1.1, -0.1) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(20), 0, math.rad(-28)), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Neon)
        elseif cosmeticType == "crown" then
            weldCosPart(head, Vector3.new(0.55, 2.1, 2.1), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(0, 0.95, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Metal)
            for ang = 0, 315, 45 do
                local rad = math.rad(ang)
                weldCosPart(head, Vector3.new(0.32, 0.65, 0.32), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(math.cos(rad) * 0.9, 1.35, math.sin(rad) * 0.9), Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), Enum.Material.Neon)
            end
        elseif cosmeticType == "aura" then
            for ring = 1, 3 do
                local p = weldCosPart(hrp, Vector3.new(0.2, 4.5 + ring * 1.5, 4.5 + ring * 1.5), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(0, -2.5 + ring * 1.4, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon)
                p.Transparency = 0.45
            end
        elseif cosmeticType == "pet" then
            weldCosPart(hrp, Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), Enum.PartType.Ball, CFrame.new(2.8, 1.8, 1.2), Color3.fromRGB(45, 212, 191), Enum.Material.Neon)
            weldCosPart(hrp, Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.35), Enum.PartType.Ball, CFrame.new(2.55, 2.0, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
            weldCosPart(hrp, Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.35), Enum.PartType.Ball, CFrame.new(3.05, 2.0, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
        elseif cosmeticType == "throne" then
            weldCosPart(hrp, Vector3.new(4.2, 1.0, 4.2), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, -1.8, 0), Color3.fromRGB(185, 28, 28), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
            weldCosPart(hrp, Vector3.new(4.2, 6.2, 0.8), Enum.PartType.Block, CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 1.8), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Metal)
        elseif cosmeticType == "titan" then
            weldCosPart(hrp, Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 0.4), Enum.PartType.Cylinder, CFrame.new(0, 0.2, -0.6) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon)
            Engine.SetP2PCharacterScale(p, 2.6)
        end
    end

    function Engine.Spawn3DCloneArmy(targetPlayer)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        if not p.Character or not p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
        PlayUiSound("rank")
        p.Character.Archivable = true
        local offsets = { CFrame.new(-5, 0, 4), CFrame.new(5, 0, 4), CFrame.new(-3, 0, -5), CFrame.new(3, 0, -5) }
        for idx, off in ipairs(offsets) do
            local cl = p.Character:Clone()
            cl.Name = "BerksBuiltStructure_CloneGuard_" .. tostring(idx)
            cl.Parent = Workspace
            cl:PivotTo(p.Character:GetPivot() * off)
        end
    end

    function Engine.Build3DWorldStructure(structureType, targetPlayer)
        local s = string.lower(tostring(structureType or "house"))
        if s == "clear" then
            for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
                if string.sub(v.Name, 1, 19) == "BerksBuiltStructure" then
                    v:Destroy()
                end
            end
            return
        end

        local builderPlr = targetPlayer or State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer
        local myChar = builderPlr and builderPlr.Character or LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myHrp then return end
        PlayUiSound("command")

        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = "BerksBuiltStructure_" .. s
        model.Parent = Workspace

        local function makeStructPart(sz, cf, col, mat, trans)
            local pt = Instance.new("Part")
            pt.Size = sz
            pt.CFrame = cf
            pt.Anchored = true
            pt.CanCollide = true
            pt.Color = col
            pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            pt.Transparency = trans or 0
            pt.Parent = model
            return pt
        end

        local originCF = myHrp.CFrame
        if s == "portal" then
            local pBlue = makeStructPart(Vector3.new(6.0, 9.5, 0.8), originCF * CFrame.new(0, 2, -10), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.25)
            local pOrange = makeStructPart(Vector3.new(6.0, 9.5, 0.8), originCF * CFrame.new(0, 2, -75), Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.25)
            pBlue.CanCollide = false
            pOrange.CanCollide = false
            local cd = false
            pBlue.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                if cd then return end
                local hHrp = hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hHrp then
                    cd = true
                    PlayUiSound("laser")
                    hHrp.CFrame = pOrange.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4)
                    task.delay(0.8, function() cd = false end)
                end
            end)
            pOrange.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                if cd then return end
                local hHrp = hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hHrp then
                    cd = true
                    PlayUiSound("laser")
                    hHrp.CFrame = pBlue.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 4)
                    task.delay(0.8, function() cd = false end)
                end
            end)
        elseif s == "trampoline" then
            local pad = makeStructPart(Vector3.new(12, 1.0, 12), originCF * CFrame.new(0, -1.8, -12), Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.1)
            pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                local hHrp = hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hHrp then
                    PlayUiSound("coil")
                    hHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(hHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 185, hHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
                end
            end)
        elseif s == "house" then
            local c = originCF * CFrame.new(0, -2.5, -24)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(26, 1, 26), c, Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(26, 1, 26), c * CFrame.new(0, 14, 0), Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(26, 14, 1), c * CFrame.new(0, 7, -12.5), Color3.fromRGB(51, 65, 85), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(1, 14, 26), c * CFrame.new(-12.5, 7, 0), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.5)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(1, 14, 26), c * CFrame.new(12.5, 7, 0), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.5)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(4, 0.6, 4), c * CFrame.new(0, 13.2, 0), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon, 0)
        elseif s == "stage" then
            local c = originCF * CFrame.new(0, -2, -28)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(34, 2, 20), c, Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(34, 16, 1), c * CFrame.new(0, 9, -9.5), Color3.fromRGB(236, 72, 153), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.2)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(5, 12, 5), c * CFrame.new(-13, 7, -6), Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(5, 12, 5), c * CFrame.new(13, 7, -6), Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
        elseif s == "bridge" then
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(10, 0.8, 120), originCF * CFrame.new(0, -3.2, -62), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.3)
        elseif s == "stairs" then
            for step = 1, 35 do
                makeStructPart(Vector3.new(8, 0.8, 2.2), originCF * CFrame.new(0, -2.5 + step * 1.2, -4 - step * 2.2), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.15)
            end
        elseif s == "arena" then
            local skyCF = originCF + Vector3.new(0, 200, 0)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(75, 2, 75), skyCF, Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59), Enum.Material.Metal, 0)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(75, 4, 1), skyCF + Vector3.new(0, 3, -37), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.3)
            makeStructPart(Vector3.new(75, 4, 1), skyCF + Vector3.new(0, 3, 37), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.3)
            myHrp.CFrame = skyCF + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
        end
    end

    function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminDisaster(targetPlayer, disasterType)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local tHrp = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not tHrp then return end
        local d = string.lower(tostring(disasterType or "tsunami"))
        PlayUiSound("explosion")

        if d == "tsunami" then
            local wave = Instance.new("Part")
            wave.Size = Vector3.new(120, 45, 14)
            wave.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 18, 95)
            wave.Anchored = true
            wave.CanCollide = false
            wave.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
            wave.Color = Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233)
            wave.Transparency = 0.25
            wave.Parent = Workspace
            TweenService:Create(wave, TweenInfo.new(2.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 18, -110)
            }):Play()
            task.delay(1.0, function()
                Engine.ExecuteDirectionalP2PFling(p, Vector3.new(0, 35000, -45000))
            end)
            task.delay(2.3, function()
                if wave and wave.Parent then wave:Destroy() end
            end)
        elseif d == "volcano" then
            local cone = Instance.new("Part")
            cone.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            cone.Size = Vector3.new(26, 36, 36)
            cone.CFrame = CFrame.new(tHrp.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
            cone.Anchored = true
            cone.CanCollide = false
            cone.Material = Enum.Material.Slate
            cone.Color = Color3.fromRGB(68, 64, 60)
            cone.Parent = Workspace
            Engine.CreateExplosionAtPlayer(p)
            task.delay(4, function()
                if cone and cone.Parent then cone:Destroy() end
            end)
        elseif d == "meteorstorm" then
            task.spawn(function()
                for _ = 1, 10 do
                    Engine.SpawnP2PMeteorStrike(p)
                    task.wait(0.25)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    function Engine.ExecuteHDAdminComedyEvent(targetPlayer, eventType)
        local p = targetPlayer or LocalPlayer
        local char = p.Character
        local tHrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local tHum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not tHrp then return end
        local ev = string.lower(tostring(eventType or "bowling"))

        if ev == "bowling" or ev == "golf" then
            PlayUiSound("anvil")
            local ball = Instance.new("Part")
            ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            ball.Size = Vector3.new(7, 7, 7)
            ball.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 35)
            ball.Anchored = true
            ball.CanCollide = false
            ball.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            ball.Color = (ev == "bowling") and Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42) or Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
            ball.Parent = Workspace
            TweenService:Create(ball, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                CFrame = tHrp.CFrame
            }):Play()
            task.delay(0.45, function()
                PlayUiSound("explosion")
                tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 95, -145)
                if ball and ball.Parent then ball:Destroy() end
            end)
        elseif ev == "piano" then
            PlayUiSound("anvil")
            local pModel = Instance.new("Model")
            pModel.Name = "Berks3DGrandPiano"
            pModel.Parent = Workspace
            local body = Instance.new("Part")
            body.Size = Vector3.new(9.5, 4.2, 8.5)
            body.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 62, 0)
            body.Anchored = true
            body.CanCollide = false
            body.Color = Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42)
            body.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            body.Parent = pModel
            local keys = Instance.new("Part")
            keys.Size = Vector3.new(7.5, 0.5, 1.4)
            keys.CFrame = body.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.5, -4.2)
            keys.Anchored = true
            keys.CanCollide = false
            keys.Color = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
            keys.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            keys.Parent = pModel
            TweenService:Create(body, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { CFrame = tHrp.CFrame }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(keys, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.5, -4.2) }):Play()
            task.delay(0.46, function()
                PlayUiSound("explosion")
                Engine.MorphHDAdminBodyProportions(p, "squash")
                task.delay(3.5, function()
                    Engine.MorphHDAdminBodyProportions(p, "normal")
                    if pModel and pModel.Parent then pModel:Destroy() end
                end)
            end)
        elseif ev == "roller" then
            PlayUiSound("horn")
            local rModel = Instance.new("Model")
            rModel.Name = "Berks3DRoadRoller"
            rModel.Parent = Workspace
            local chassis = Instance.new("Part")
            chassis.Size = Vector3.new(10.5, 6.2, 16.5)
            chassis.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 68, 0)
            chassis.Anchored = true
            chassis.CanCollide = false
            chassis.Color = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
            chassis.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
            chassis.Parent = rModel
            local drum = Instance.new("Part")
            drum.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            drum.Size = Vector3.new(11.5, 5.8, 5.8)
            drum.CFrame = (tHrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 66, -6.5)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
            drum.Anchored = true
            drum.CanCollide = false
            drum.Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59)
            drum.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
            drum.Parent = rModel
            TweenService:Create(chassis, TweenInfo.new(0.48, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { CFrame = tHrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0) }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(drum, TweenInfo.new(0.48, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { CFrame = (tHrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, -0.5, -6.5)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)) }):Play()
            task.delay(0.50, function()
                PlayUiSound("explosion")
                Engine.CreateExplosionAtPlayer(p)
                Engine.MorphHDAdminBodyProportions(p, "squash")
                task.delay(3.5, function()
                    Engine.MorphHDAdminBodyProportions(p, "normal")
                    if rModel and rModel.Parent then rModel:Destroy() end
                end)
            end)
        elseif ev == "balloon" then
            PlayUiSound("coil")
            local bPart = Instance.new("Part")
            bPart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            bPart.Size = Vector3.new(4.2, 5.0, 4.2)
            bPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(244, 63, 94)
            bPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            bPart.CanCollide = false
            bPart.Massless = true
            bPart.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 6.5, 0)
            bPart.Parent = char
            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint", bPart)
            w.Part0 = tHrp
            w.Part1 = bPart
            task.spawn(function()
                for _ = 1, 45 do
                    if tHrp and tHrp.Parent then
                        tHrp.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1.1, 0)
                        tHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end
                    RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                end
                PlayUiSound("explosion")
                if bPart and bPart.Parent then bPart:Destroy() end
            end)
        elseif ev == "quicksand" then
            Engine.SetP2PSinkPlayer(p, true)
            task.delay(4.5, function() Engine.SetP2PSinkPlayer(p, false) end)
        elseif ev == "shark" then
            PlayUiSound("explosion")
            local sModel = Instance.new("Model")
            sModel.Name = "Berks3DSharkAttack"
            sModel.Parent = Workspace
            local pool = Instance.new("Part")
            pool.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            pool.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 16, 16)
            pool.CFrame = CFrame.new(tHrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
            pool.Anchored = true
            pool.CanCollide = false
            pool.Color = Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233)
            pool.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            pool.Transparency = 0.25
            pool.Parent = sModel
            local sharkBody = Instance.new("Part")
            sharkBody.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            sharkBody.Size = Vector3.new(4.5, 11.5, 4.5)
            sharkBody.CFrame = CFrame.new(tHrp.Position - Vector3.new(0, 9, 0))
            sharkBody.Anchored = true
            sharkBody.CanCollide = false
            sharkBody.Color = Color3.fromRGB(71, 85, 105)
            sharkBody.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            sharkBody.Parent = sModel
            TweenService:Create(sharkBody, TweenInfo.new(0.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                CFrame = CFrame.new(tHrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0))
            }):Play()
            task.delay(0.42, function()
                Engine.CreateExplosionAtPlayer(p)
                if tHum then tHum.Health = 0 end
                task.delay(2.2, function()
                    if sModel and sModel.Parent then sModel:Destroy() end
                end)
            end)
        end
    end

    function Engine.AssembleVoxelBlueprint(blueprintId, parentInstance, originCFrame, weldTarget)
        local bp = Engine.VoxelBlueprints and Engine.VoxelBlueprints[blueprintId]
        if not bp or not parentInstance then return nil end
        local container = Instance.new("Model")
        container.Name = "BerksVoxel_" .. tostring(blueprintId)
        container.Parent = parentInstance
        for _, node in ipairs(bp.Nodes) do
            local pt = Instance.new("Part")
            pt.Name = node.NodeName
            pt.Size = node.Size
            pt.Color = node.Color or bp.BaseColor
            pt.Material = node.Material or bp.DefaultMaterial
            pt.Transparency = node.Transparency or 0
            pt.CanCollide = false
            pt.Massless = true
            pt.Anchored = (weldTarget == nil)
            pt.CFrame = (originCFrame or CFrame.new()) * node.Offset
            pt.Parent = container
            if weldTarget then
                local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                w.Part0 = weldTarget
                w.Part1 = pt
                w.Parent = pt
            end
        end
        return container
    end

    function Engine.ToggleOverheadRankTags(enable)
        State.ShowRankTags = enable
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(p)
        end
    end

    function Engine.OpenComprehensiveBanKickMenu(mode, targetPlayer)
        local normalizedMode = (string.upper(tostring(mode or "BAN")) == "KICK") and "KICK" or "BAN"
        State.BanKickMenuMode = normalizedMode
        State.BanKickMenuOpen = true
        if UI.OpenBanKickModal then
            UI.OpenBanKickModal(normalizedMode, targetPlayer)
        end
    end

    function Engine.ToggleServerRanksAndScriptInfoModal(openState)
        if openState == nil then
            State.ServerInfoOpen = not State.ServerInfoOpen
        else
            State.ServerInfoOpen = (openState == true)
        end
        if UI.ToggleServerInfoModal then
            UI.ToggleServerInfoModal(State.ServerInfoOpen)
        end
    end

    function Engine.SetScriptLanguage(langCode)
        local raw = string.lower(tostring(langCode or "tr"))
        if raw == "en" or raw == "eng" or raw == "english" or raw == "ingilizce" then
            State.Language = "EN"
        else
            State.Language = "TR"
        end
        TableDB.Language = State.Language
        SyncTablePersistence()
        if UI.ApplyLanguageToUI then
            UI.ApplyLanguageToUI()
        end
        if UI.SendNotification then
            if State.Language == "EN" then
                UI.SendNotification("LANGUAGE UPDATED", "Interface and command descriptions switched to English (EN).", Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), 3)
            else
                UI.SendNotification("DIL GUNCELLENDI", "Arayuz ve tum komut aciklamalari Turkce (TR) diline cevrildi.", Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), 3)
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.SetupDeltaAutoExecAndTeleportPersistence(forceInstallNow)
        State.AutoExecActive = true
        TableDB.AutoExecEnabled = true
        SyncTablePersistence()

        -- 1. Delta Executor / Genel Executor autoexec klasorune scripti otomatik kaydetme (pcall ile %100 guvenli)
        local savedToDeltaAutoExec = false
        pcall(function()
            local writeFn = (type(writefile) == "function" and writefile) or (GlobalEnv and type(GlobalEnv.writefile) == "function" and GlobalEnv.writefile)
            local isFolderFn = (type(isfolder) == "function" and isfolder) or (GlobalEnv and type(GlobalEnv.isfolder) == "function" and GlobalEnv.isfolder)
            local makeFolderFn = (type(makefolder) == "function" and makefolder) or (GlobalEnv and type(GlobalEnv.makefolder) == "function" and GlobalEnv.makefolder)
            if writeFn then
                local bootstrapCode = "-- Berk's Admin FE v5.0 Delta Executor AutoExec Loader\n"
                    .. "repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded() and game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer\n"
                    .. "local env = (type(getgenv) == 'function' and getgenv()) or _G\n"
                    .. "if type(env.BerksAdmin_SourceRunner) == 'function' then pcall(env.BerksAdmin_SourceRunner) end\n"
                pcall(function()
                    if isFolderFn and makeFolderFn and not isFolderFn("autoexec") then
                        makeFolderFn("autoexec")
                    end
                    writeFn("autoexec/BerksAdmin_v5_AutoExec.lua", bootstrapCode)
                    savedToDeltaAutoExec = true
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    writeFn("BerksAdmin_v5_AutoExec.lua", bootstrapCode)
                    savedToDeltaAutoExec = true
                end)
            end
        end)

        -- 2. Oyundan cikinca / baska sunucuya gecince (Teleport) aninda yeniden calisma kancasi (queue_on_teleport)
        pcall(function()
            local qot = (type(queue_on_teleport) == "function" and queue_on_teleport)
                or (GlobalEnv and type(GlobalEnv.queue_on_teleport) == "function" and GlobalEnv.queue_on_teleport)
                or (type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.queue_on_teleport) == "function" and syn.queue_on_teleport)
                or (type(fluxus) == "table" and type(fluxus.queue_on_teleport) == "function" and fluxus.queue_on_teleport)
                or (type(delta) == "table" and type(delta.queue_on_teleport) == "function" and delta.queue_on_teleport)

            if not GlobalEnv.BerksAdmin_TeleportHooked then
                GlobalEnv.BerksAdmin_TeleportHooked = true
                LocalPlayer.OnTeleport:Connect(function()
                    SyncTablePersistence()
                    if qot and type(GlobalEnv.BerksAdmin_RawSource) == "string" and #GlobalEnv.BerksAdmin_RawSource > 0 then
                        pcall(function()
                            qot(GlobalEnv.BerksAdmin_RawSource)
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)

        if forceInstallNow and UI.SendNotification then
            if State.Language == "EN" then
                UI.SendNotification(
                    "DELTA AUTOEXEC ACTIVE",
                    savedToDeltaAutoExec
                        and "Saved to Delta autoexec folder + Teleport queue armed! Will auto-run in every game."
                        or "Teleport queue + GlobalEnv persistence armed! Script will auto-run on rejoin.",
                    Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128),
                    3.8
                )
            else
                UI.SendNotification(
                    "DELTA AUTOEXEC AKTIF",
                    savedToDeltaAutoExec
                        and "Delta autoexec klasorune yazildi + Teleport kuyrugu kuruldu! Oyuna girince aninda calisir."
                        or "Teleport kuyrugu + GlobalEnv kaliciligi aktif! Oyun degistirince aninda yeniden calisir.",
                    Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128),
                    3.8
                )
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.PlayHalloweenSplashIntro()
        if UI.TriggerHalloweenIntro then
            UI.TriggerHalloweenIntro()
        end
    end
end)

-- ========================================================================================
-- [10.4A] T0PK3K 5.0 CORE P2P ROUTER, B1RKT PERMISSION SHIELD & CLEARNIL ENGINE
-- ========================================================================================
SafeRunModule("T0PK3K_5.0_Core_P2P_Router", function()
    TableDB.B1rktAllowedUsers = TableDB.B1rktAllowedUsers or {}
    if TableDB.B1rktAllowAllToTargetMe == nil then
        TableDB.B1rktAllowAllToTargetMe = false
    end
    State.Topk3kSpawnedObjects = State.Topk3kSpawnedObjects or {}
    State.Topk3kDeletedPartsBackup = State.Topk3kDeletedPartsBackup or {}
    State.Topk3kActiveConnections = State.Topk3kActiveConnections or {}
    State.Topk3kActiveSounds = State.Topk3kActiveSounds or {}
    State.Topk3kActiveTransformations = State.Topk3kActiveTransformations or {}
    State.Topk3kActiveDisasters = State.Topk3kActiveDisasters or {}

    function Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        local folder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_P2PWorldFolder")
        if not folder then
            folder = Instance.new("Folder")
            folder.Name = "Topk3k_P2PWorldFolder"
            folder.Parent = Workspace
        end
        return folder
    end

    function Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(inst)
        if inst then
            table.insert(State.Topk3kSpawnedObjects, inst)
        end
        return inst
    end

    function Engine.RegisterTopk3kConnection(conn)
        if conn then
            table.insert(State.Topk3kActiveConnections, conn)
        end
        return conn
    end

    function Engine.IsB1rktOwner(plrOrName)
        local pName = typeof(plrOrName) == "Instance" and plrOrName.Name or tostring(plrOrName or LocalPlayer.Name)
        if string.lower(pName) == string.lower(ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME) then
            return true
        end
        if plrOrName == LocalPlayer or pName == LocalPlayer.Name then
            if string.lower(LocalPlayer.DisplayName or "") == string.lower(ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME) then
                return true
            end
            if GlobalEnv.BerksAdmin_ForceB1rktOwner == true then
                return true
            end
        end
        local plrInst = typeof(plrOrName) == "Instance" and plrOrName or Players:FindFirstChild(pName)
        if plrInst and string.lower(plrInst.DisplayName or "") == string.lower(ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME) then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    function Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(senderPlr, targetPlr)
        if not targetPlr then return true end
        if not Engine.IsB1rktOwner(targetPlr) then
            return true
        end
        if not senderPlr then
            return Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer)
        end
        if Engine.IsB1rktOwner(senderPlr) then
            return true
        end
        if TableDB.B1rktAllowAllToTargetMe == true then
            return true
        end
        local sName = typeof(senderPlr) == "Instance" and senderPlr.Name or tostring(senderPlr)
        if TableDB.B1rktAllowedUsers and TableDB.B1rktAllowedUsers[sName] == true then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    function Engine.SetB1rktPermissionForPlayer(plrName, allowed, syncP2P)
        if not plrName or plrName == "" then return end
        TableDB.B1rktAllowedUsers = TableDB.B1rktAllowedUsers or {}
        TableDB.B1rktAllowedUsers[plrName] = allowed and true or nil
        SyncTablePersistence()
        if syncP2P ~= false and Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer) then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("B1RKT_PERM", plrName, allowed and "ALLOW" or "DENY", "")
        end
        if UI.RefreshB1rktGuardList then
            pcall(UI.RefreshB1rktGuardList)
        end
    end

    function Engine.SetB1rktGlobalPermission(allowed, syncP2P)
        TableDB.B1rktAllowAllToTargetMe = allowed and true or false
        SyncTablePersistence()
        if syncP2P ~= false and Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer) then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("B1RKT_GLOBAL_PERM", "ALL", allowed and "ALLOW" or "DENY", "")
        end
        if UI.RefreshB1rktGuardList then
            pcall(UI.RefreshB1rktGuardList)
        end
    end

    function Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P(subAction, targetStr, arg1, arg2, arg3)
        if State.IsExecutingFromP2P then return end
        local payload = tostring(arg1 or "")
        if arg2 ~= nil and tostring(arg2) ~= "" then
            payload = payload .. "|" .. tostring(arg2)
        end
        if arg3 ~= nil and tostring(arg3) ~= "" then
            payload = payload .. "|" .. tostring(arg3)
        end
        BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("TOPK3K_" .. tostring(subAction), tostring(targetStr or "ALL"), payload)
    end

    function Engine.RunTopk3kCommandP2P(cmdStr)
        if not cmdStr or cmdStr == "" then return end
        local pfx = ResolvePersonalPrefix(LocalPlayer.Name)
        local clean = cmdStr
        if string.sub(clean, 1, 1) == ";" then
            clean = string.sub(clean, 2)
        elseif string.sub(clean, 1, #pfx) == pfx then
            clean = string.sub(clean, #pfx + 1)
        end
        if UI.ExecuteCommandString then
            UI.ExecuteCommandString(pfx .. clean)
        end
    end

    function Engine.FormatVec3(v)
        if typeof(v) ~= "Vector3" then return "0,5,0" end
        return string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", v.X, v.Y, v.Z)
    end

    function Engine.ParseVec3(s)
        if typeof(s) == "Vector3" then return s end
        local x, y, z = string.match(tostring(s or ""), "([%-%d%.]+),([%-%d%.]+),([%-%d%.]+)")
        if x and y and z then
            return Vector3.new(tonumber(x) or 0, tonumber(y) or 5, tonumber(z) or 0)
        end
        return nil
    end

    function Engine.FormatCol3(c)
        if typeof(c) ~= "Color3" then return "37,99,235" end
        return string.format("%d,%d,%d", math.floor(c.R * 255), math.floor(c.G * 255), math.floor(c.B * 255))
    end

    function Engine.ParseCol3(s)
        if typeof(s) == "Color3" then return s end
        local r, g, b = string.match(tostring(s or ""), "(%d+),(%d+),(%d+)")
        if r and g and b then
            return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(r) or 37, tonumber(g) or 99, tonumber(b) or 235)
        end
        return Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235)
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_ClearNil(syncP2P)
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("CLEARNIL", "ALL", "", "")
        end
        local cleanedCount = 0
        -- 1. Clean nil/dead connections
        for i = #State.Topk3kActiveConnections, 1, -1 do
            local c = State.Topk3kActiveConnections[i]
            if c then
                pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
                cleanedCount = cleanedCount + 1
            end
            table.remove(State.Topk3kActiveConnections, i)
        end
        -- 2. Clean spawned P2P objects
        for i = #State.Topk3kSpawnedObjects, 1, -1 do
            local obj = State.Topk3kSpawnedObjects[i]
            if obj then
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                cleanedCount = cleanedCount + 1
            end
            table.remove(State.Topk3kSpawnedObjects, i)
        end
        local wf = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_P2PWorldFolder")
        if wf then
            for _, child in ipairs(wf:GetChildren()) do
                pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
                cleanedCount = cleanedCount + 1
            end
        end
        -- 3. Clean orphaned P2P carrier tracks & nil instances
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr.Character then
                local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local anim = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
                if anim then
                    for _, tr in ipairs(anim:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        local aid = tr.Animation and tostring(tr.Animation.AnimationId) or ""
                        if string.find(aid, "berks_p2p") or tr.Priority == Enum.AnimationPriority.Core then
                            pcall(function() tr:Stop(0) end)
                            cleanedCount = cleanedCount + 1
                        end
                    end
                end
                for _, d in ipairs(plr.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if string.find(d.Name, "^Topk3k_") then
                        pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
                        cleanedCount = cleanedCount + 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if type(getnilinstances) == "function" then
            pcall(function()
                for _, ni in ipairs(getnilinstances()) do
                    if ni and (ni:IsA("Sound") or ni:IsA("BasePart") or string.find(ni.Name, "Topk3k") or string.find(ni.Name, "Berks")) then
                        pcall(function() ni:Destroy() end)
                        cleanedCount = cleanedCount + 1
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        pcall(function() collectgarbage("collect") end)
        if UI.ShowNotification then
            UI.ShowNotification("T0PK3K ClearNil", string.format("ClearNil tamamlandi! %d sahipsiz nesne/iz temizlendi (P2P).", cleanedCount), "success")
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_ClearExecutedScripts(syncP2P)
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("CLEAR_EXECUTED", "ALL", "", "")
        end
        State.Topk3kLoopGod = false
        State.Topk3kSemiGod = false
        State.Topk3kLevitate = false
        State.Topk3kHighJump = false
        State.Topk3kNoGrav = false
        State.Topk3kOrbActive = false
        State.Topk3kRainbowName = false
        State.Topk3kLaserEyes = false
        State.Topk3kGonerMode = false
        State.Topk3kKrystalDance = false
        State.Topk3kSpinningSky = false
        State.Topk3kFlashingDecals = false
        State.Topk3kActiveDisasters = {}
        State.Topk3kActiveTransformations = {}
        State.Flying = false
        State.Noclip = false
        State.GodMode = false
        State.Spinning = false
        State.RainbowChar = false
        State.DiscoMode = false
        State.SeizureMode = false
        Engine.Topk3k_StopAllSounds(false)
        Engine.Topk3k_ClearDecalAndSky(false)
        Engine.Topk3k_ClearNil(false)
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        if myChar then
            local hum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.WalkSpeed = 16
                hum.UseJumpPower = true
                hum.JumpPower = 50
                hum.PlatformStand = false
                hum.Sit = false
            end
        end
        Workspace.Gravity = 196.2
        if UI.ShowNotification then
            UI.ShowNotification("T0PK3K 5.0", "Tum aktif scriptler, efektler, sesler ve yapilar sifirlandi (P2P)!", "info")
        end
    end
end)

    function Engine.Topk3k_CleanAssetId(rawId, fallbackId)
        local digits = string.match(tostring(rawId or ""), "(%d+)")
        if digits and #digits > 0 then
            return digits
        end
        return tostring(fallbackId or "1365169983")
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_PlayCustomSound(assetId, pitch, volume, looped, mode, syncP2P)
        local cleanId = Engine.Topk3k_CleanAssetId(assetId, "9043345732")
        local p = tonumber(pitch) or 1.0
        local v = tonumber(volume) or 10.0
        local lp = (looped == true or tostring(looped) == "1" or tostring(looped) == "true")
        local m = tostring(mode or "NORMAL")

        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("SOUND", cleanId, tostring(p), (lp and "1" or "0") .. ":" .. m, tostring(v))
        end

        local function spawnSingleSound(parentInst, pitchMult, delaySec)
            task.spawn(function()
                if delaySec and delaySec > 0 then
                    task.wait(delaySec)
                end
                local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
                snd.Name = "Topk3k_P2PAudio_" .. cleanId
                snd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. cleanId
                snd.Volume = math.clamp(v, 0.5, 10)
                snd.PlaybackSpeed = math.clamp(p * (pitchMult or 1), 0.2, 4.0)
                snd.Looped = lp
                snd.RollOffMaxDistance = 10000
                snd.RollOffMinDistance = 100

                if m == "REVERB" or m == "RITUAL" or m == "SWARM" then
                    local rev = Instance.new("ReverbSoundEffect")
                    rev.DecayTime = 4.5
                    rev.Density = 1.0
                    rev.Diffusion = 1.0
                    rev.WetLevel = 0
                    rev.Parent = snd
                end
                if m == "BASS" or m == "DISTORT" or m == "JUMPSCARE" then
                    local dist = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
                    dist.Level = 0.78
                    dist.Parent = snd
                end
                if m == "ECHO" or m == "SWARM" then
                    local echo = Instance.new("EchoSoundEffect")
                    echo.Delay = 0.28
                    echo.Feedback = 0.6
                    echo.Parent = snd
                end

                snd.Parent = parentInst or SoundService
                table.insert(State.Topk3kActiveSounds, snd)
                pcall(function() snd:Play() end)

                if not lp then
                    snd.Ended:Connect(function()
                        pcall(function() snd:Destroy() end)
                    end)
                    task.delay(25, function()
                        if snd and snd.Parent then
                            pcall(function() snd:Destroy() end)
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end

        spawnSingleSound(SoundService, 1.0, 0)
        spawnSingleSound(Workspace, 1.0, 0)

        if m == "SWARM" then
            spawnSingleSound(SoundService, 0.78, 0.12)
            spawnSingleSound(SoundService, 1.25, 0.24)
            spawnSingleSound(Workspace, 0.62, 0.36)
        end

        if m == "JUMPSCARE" then
            Engine.Topk3k_TriggerScreenJumpscare("1365169983", 2.2)
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_ClearDecalAndSky(syncP2P)

            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("CLEAR_DECALS", "ALL", "", "")
        end
        State.Topk3kSpinningSky = false
        State.Topk3kFlashingDecals = false
        for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Sky") and child.Name == "Topk3k_P2PSkybox" then
                pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if (obj:IsA("Decal") and obj.Name == "Topk3k_SpamDecal")
                or (obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") and obj.Name == "Topk3k_SpamParticle")
                or (obj:IsA("BillboardGui") and obj.Name == "Topk3k_SpamBillboard") then
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin(customPos)
        if typeof(customPos) == "Vector3" then return customPos end
        local parsed = Engine.ParseVec3(customPos)
        if parsed then return parsed end
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myHrp then
            return myHrp.Position + (myHrp.CFrame.LookVector * 28)
        end
        return Vector3.new(0, 12, 0)
    end

    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_TriggerZombieApocalypse(count, syncP2P)
        local num = math.clamp(tonumber(count) or 6, 1, 15)
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("DISASTER", "ZOMBIES", tostring(num), "")
        end
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        local center = Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin()

        for i = 1, num do
            local zModel = Instance.new("Model")
            zModel.Name = "Topk3k_P2PZombie_" .. i
            zModel.Parent = wf
            Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(zModel)

            local spawnPos = center + Vector3.new(math.cos(i * 1.1) * (14 + i * 3), 5, math.sin(i * 1.1) * (14 + i * 3))

            local torso = Instance.new("Part")
            torso.Name = "HumanoidRootPart"
            torso.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
            torso.Color = Color3.fromRGB(92, 64, 51)
            torso.Position = spawnPos
            torso.Anchored = true
            torso.CanCollide = true
            torso.Parent = zModel

            local head = Instance.new("Part")
            head.Name = "Head"
            head.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
            head.Color = Color3.fromRGB(75, 139, 59)
            head.Anchored = true
            head.CanCollide = false
            head.Position = spawnPos + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
            head.Parent = zModel

            local lArm = Instance.new("Part")
            lArm.Size = Vector3.new(1, 2, 1)
            lArm.Color = Color3.fromRGB(75, 139, 59)
            lArm.Anchored = true
            lArm.CanCollide = false
            lArm.Parent = zModel

            local rArm = lArm:Clone()
            rArm.Parent = zModel

            local lLeg = Instance.new("Part")
            lLeg.Size = Vector3.new(1, 2, 1)
            lLeg.Color = Color3.fromRGB(92, 64, 51)
            lLeg.Anchored = true
            lLeg.CanCollide = false
            lLeg.Parent = zModel

            local rLeg = lLeg:Clone()
            rLeg.Parent = zModel

            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 26)
            bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
            bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
            bb.Parent = head
            local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            tl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
            tl.TextSize = 14
            tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128)
            tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
            tl.Text = "T0PK3K ZOMBIE #" .. i
            tl.Parent = bb

            task.spawn(function()
                local curPos = spawnPos
                local t0 = os.clock()
                while os.clock() - t0 < 30 and zModel.Parent and torso.Parent do
                    local nearestHrp = nil
                    local bestDist = 999
                    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, plr) and plr.Character then
                            local hrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            if hrp then
                                local d = (hrp.Position - curPos).Magnitude
                                if d < bestDist then
                                    bestDist = d
                                    nearestHrp = hrp
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if nearestHrp then
                        local flatTarget = Vector3.new(nearestHrp.Position.X, curPos.Y, nearestHrp.Position.Z)
                        local dir = (flatTarget - curPos)
                        if dir.Magnitude > 2.5 then
                            curPos = curPos + dir.Unit * 0.55
                        elseif nearestHrp.Parent == LocalPlayer.Character then
                            local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            if hum and not State.GodMode and not State.Topk3kLoopGod then
                                hum:TakeDamage(1.5)
                            end
                        end
                        local cf = CFrame.new(curPos, flatTarget)
                        local swing = math.sin(os.clock() * 8 + i) * 0.4
                        torso.CFrame = cf
                        head.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                        lArm.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(-1.5, 0.5, -0.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
                        rArm.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(1.5, 0.5, -0.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
                        lLeg.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(-0.5, -2, swing)
                        rLeg.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0.5, -2, -swing)
                    end
                    task.wait(0.04)
                end
                pcall(function() zModel:Destroy() end)
            end)
        end

        if UI.ShowNotification then
            UI.ShowNotification("T0PK3K ZOMBIE APOCALYPSE", string.format("%d adet 3D P2P Zombi haritaya salindi!", num), "warn")
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_UnanchorMap(syncP2P)
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("MAP_MOD", "UNANCHOR", "", "")
        end
        for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name ~= "Baseplate" and obj.Name ~= "Terrain" and not obj:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character or Workspace) then
                obj.Anchored = false
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_AnchorMap(syncP2P)
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("MAP_MOD", "ANCHOR", "", "")
        end
        for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                local isChar = false
                for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if plr.Character and obj:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character) then
                        isChar = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not isChar then
                    obj.Anchored = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_ColorSpamMap(syncP2P)
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("MAP_MOD", "COLORSPAM", "", "")
        end
        for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                obj.Color = Color3.fromHSV(math.random(), 0.85, 1)
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_NeonMaterialMap(syncP2P)
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("MAP_MOD", "NEONMAP", "", "")
        end
        for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                obj.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                obj.Color = Color3.fromHSV(math.random(), 0.9, 1)
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ========================================================================================
-- [10.4D] T0PK3K 5.0 3D YAPILAR (CASTLE, HOUSE, TOWER, ARENA, OBBY, THRONE, DISCO, PYRAMID)
--         & GERCEK ZAMANLI P2P BLOK EKLEME / SILME / ETKILESIMLI PAD MOTORU
-- ========================================================================================
SafeRunModule("T0PK3K_5.0_Structures_And_Blocks_Engine", function()
    local function MakePart(parent, name, size, cframe, color, mat, trans, canCollide)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = name or "Topk3k_Part"
        p.Size = size or Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)
        p.CFrame = cframe or CFrame.new(0, 10, 0)
        p.Color = color or Color3.fromRGB(163, 162, 165)
        p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        p.Transparency = trans or 0
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = (canCollide == nil) and true or canCollide
        p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        p.Parent = parent
        Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(p)
        return p
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_SpawnSyncedBlock(posVec, sizeVec, col3, matName, syncP2P)
        local pos = Engine.ParseVec3(posVec) or Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin()
        local sz = Engine.ParseVec3(sizeVec) or Vector3.new(8, 5, 4)
        local col = Engine.ParseCol3(col3)
        local mat = Enum.Material.Brick
        pcall(function()
            if matName and Enum.Material[matName] then
                mat = Enum.Material[matName]
            end
        end)
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("SPAWN_BLOCK", Engine.FormatVec3(pos), Engine.FormatVec3(sz), Engine.FormatCol3(col), tostring(matName or "Brick"))
        end
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        return MakePart(wf, "Topk3k_P2PBlock", sz, CFrame.new(pos), col, mat, 0, true)
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_DeleteWorkspacePart(targetOrPos, syncP2P)
        local targetPart = nil
        local pos = nil
        if typeof(targetOrPos) == "Instance" and targetOrPos:IsA("BasePart") then
            targetPart = targetOrPos
            pos = targetPart.Position
        else
            pos = Engine.ParseVec3(targetOrPos) or Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin()
            local bestDist = 35
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name ~= "Baseplate" and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and obj.Transparency < 0.99 then
                    local isPlayerChar = false
                    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if plr.Character and obj:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character) then
                            isPlayerChar = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not isPlayerChar then
                        local d = (obj.Position - pos).Magnitude
                        if d < bestDist then
                            bestDist = d
                            targetPart = obj
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if targetPart then
            local delPos = targetPart.Position
            if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
                Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("DELETE_BLOCK", Engine.FormatVec3(delPos), targetPart.Name, "")
            end
            table.insert(State.Topk3kDeletedPartsBackup, {
                Part = targetPart,
                OldTransparency = targetPart.Transparency,
                OldCanCollide = targetPart.CanCollide,
                OldCFrame = targetPart.CFrame
            })
            targetPart.Transparency = 1
            targetPart.CanCollide = false
            return true
        end
        return false
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_RestoreDeletedBlocks(syncP2P)
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("RESTORE_BLOCKS", "ALL", "", "")
        end
        local count = 0
        for i = #State.Topk3kDeletedPartsBackup, 1, -1 do
            local entry = State.Topk3kDeletedPartsBackup[i]
            if entry and entry.Part and entry.Part.Parent then
                entry.Part.Transparency = entry.OldTransparency or 0
                entry.Part.CanCollide = (entry.OldCanCollide ~= false)
                count = count + 1
            end
            table.remove(State.Topk3kDeletedPartsBackup, i)
        end
        if Engine.RestoreDeletedWorkspaceParts then
            pcall(Engine.RestoreDeletedWorkspaceParts)
        end
        if UI.ShowNotification then
            UI.ShowNotification("T0PK3K Blok Kurtarma", string.format("%d silinen blok geri getirildi (P2P)!", count), "success")
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_SpawnInteractivePad(padType, posVec, syncP2P)
        local pType = string.upper(tostring(padType or "HEAL"))
        local center = Engine.ParseVec3(posVec) or Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin()
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("SPAWN_PAD", pType, Engine.FormatVec3(center), "")
        end
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()

        if pType == "STAIRS" then
            local m = Instance.new("Model")
            m.Name = "Topk3k_Staircase"
            m.Parent = wf
            Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(m)
            for i = 1, 22 do
                MakePart(
                    m,
                    "Step_" .. i,
                    Vector3.new(10, 1.2, 3),
                    CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, (i - 1) * 1.5, -(i - 1) * 2.6)),
                    Color3.fromHSV((i / 22) % 1, 0.8, 1),
                    Enum.Material.Neon,
                    0.1,
                    true
                )
            end
            return
        elseif pType == "BRIDGE" then
            local m = Instance.new("Model")
            m.Name = "Topk3k_SkyBridge"
            m.Parent = wf
            Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(m)
            MakePart(m, "Deck", Vector3.new(12, 1.5, 110), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 0, -50)), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.25, true)
            MakePart(m, "RailL", Vector3.new(0.8, 4, 110), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(-5.6, 2.5, -50)), Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, true)
            MakePart(m, "RailR", Vector3.new(0.8, 4, 110), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(5.6, 2.5, -50)), Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, true)
            return
        end

        local padCol = Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94)
        local padLabel = "HEAL PAD (+100 HP)"
        if pType == "LAVA" then
            padCol = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
            padLabel = "LAVA KILL PAD (0 HP)"
        elseif pType == "JUMP" then
            padCol = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
            padLabel = "SUPER TRAMPOLINE PAD"
        elseif pType == "SPEED" then
            padCol = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
            padLabel = "TURBO SPEED PAD (120 WS)"
        end

        local pad = MakePart(wf, "Topk3k_Pad_" .. pType, Vector3.new(10, 1.2, 10), CFrame.new(center), padCol, Enum.Material.Neon, 0.05, true)
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 32)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.Parent = pad
        local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        tl.TextSize = 15
        tl.TextColor3 = padCol
        tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        tl.Text = padLabel
        tl.Parent = bb

        local conn = pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
            local char = hit and hit.Parent
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum and hrp then
                local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
                if pType == "HEAL" then
                    hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
                elseif pType == "LAVA" then
                    if not plr or Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, plr) then
                        if not State.GodMode and not State.Topk3kLoopGod then
                            hum.Health = 0
                        end
                    end
                elseif pType == "JUMP" then
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 165, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
                elseif pType == "SPEED" then
                    hum.WalkSpeed = 110
                end
            end
        end)
        Engine.RegisterTopk3kConnection(conn)
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_SpawnStructure(structureType, posVec, syncP2P)
        local sType = string.upper(tostring(structureType or "CASTLE"))

        end
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = "Topk3k_Structure_" .. sType
        model.Parent = wf
        Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(model)

        if sType == "CASTLE" then
            local stoneCol = Color3.fromRGB(120, 125, 135)

            -- 4 Corner Towers

                Vector3.new(-34, 16, -34),
                Vector3.new(34, 16, -34),
                Vector3.new(-34, 16, 34),
                Vector3.new(34, 16, 34)

            for idx, cOff in ipairs(corners) do
                MakePart(model, "Tower_" .. idx, Vector3.new(14, 36, 14), CFrame.new(center + cOff), stoneCol, Enum.Material.Brick, 0, true)

            end

            MakePart(model, "Spire", Vector3.new(2, 32, 2), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 112, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, false)

            MakePart(model, "ArenaFloor", Vector3.new(84, 2, 84), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(194, 155, 97), Enum.Material.Sand, 0, true)

        elseif sType == "THRONE" then
            MakePart(model, "MarbleHall", Vector3.new(44, 2, 68), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245), Enum.Material.Marble, 0, true)
            MakePart(model, "RedCarpet", Vector3.new(12, 2.2, 64), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, -1.9, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(185, 28, 28), Enum.Material.Fabric, 0, true)

    function Engine.Topk3k_SpawnVehicle(vehicleType, posVec, syncP2P)
        local vType = string.upper(tostring(vehicleType or "TANK"))

            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("VEHICLE", vType, Engine.FormatVec3(center), "")
        end
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = "Topk3k_Vehicle_" .. vType
        model.Parent = wf
        Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(model)

        if vType == "TANK" then
            MakePart(model, "Hull", Vector3.new(14, 5, 22), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(54, 83, 20), Enum.Material.Metal, 0, true)

            MakePart(model, "Turret", Vector3.new(9, 4, 10), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 6.5, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(63, 98, 18), Enum.Material.Metal, 0, true)
            MakePart(model, "Barrel", Vector3.new(2, 2, 16), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 6.8, -12)), Color3.fromRGB(39, 39, 42), Enum.Material.Metal, 0, true)
        elseif vType == "UFO" then
            local saucer = MakePart(model, "Saucer", Vector3.new(3, 22, 22), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184), Enum.Material.Metal, 0, true)
            saucer.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
            local dome = MakePart(model, "Dome", Vector3.new(11, 8, 11), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 9, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.25, true)
            dome.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        elseif vType == "SPORTCAR" then

            MakePart(model, "Cabin", Vector3.new(7.5, 2.5, 8), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 3.8, 1)), Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.Glass, 0.25, true)

            MakePart(model, "TailBoom", Vector3.new(2.5, 2.5, 14), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 5, 14)), Color3.fromRGB(30, 58, 138), Enum.Material.Metal, 0, true)

SafeRunModule("T0PK3K_5.0_Bosses_And_Character_Engine", function()
    function Engine.Topk3k_SetSemiGod(targetPlr, enable, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("SEMIGOD", p.Name, enable and "1" or "0", "")
        end
        if p == LocalPlayer then
            State.Topk3kSemiGod = enable
        end
        if p.Character then
            local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.MaxHealth = enable and 50000 or 100
                hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_SetLoopGod(targetPlr, enable, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("LOOPGOD", p.Name, enable and "1" or "0", "")
        end
        if p == LocalPlayer then
            State.Topk3kLoopGod = enable
            State.GodMode = enable
        end
        if p.Character then
            local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.MaxHealth = enable and 999999 or 100
                hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_SetLevitate(targetPlr, enable, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer

        if p.Character then

            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_SetHighJump(targetPlr, enable, syncP2P)

        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_SetNoGrav(targetPlr, enable, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("NOGRAV", p.Name, enable and "1" or "0", "")
        end
        if p == LocalPlayer then
            State.Topk3kNoGrav = enable
        end
        if p.Character then
            local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then
                local old = hrp:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_NoGravForce")
                if old then old:Destroy() end
                if enable then
                    local bf = Instance.new("BodyForce")
                    bf.Name = "Topk3k_NoGravForce"
                    bf.Force = Vector3.new(0, (hrp.AssemblyMass or 15) * Workspace.Gravity * 0.96, 0)
                    bf.Parent = hrp
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_SetNaked(targetPlr, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("NAKED", p.Name, "", "")
        end
        if p.Character then
            for _, d in ipairs(p.Character:GetChildren()) do
                if d:IsA("Shirt") or d:IsA("Pants") or d:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then

                end
            end
        end
    end

        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer

        pcall(function()
            p.Neutral = false
            p.TeamColor = BrickColor.new(bName)
        end)
        if p.Character then
            local bc = BrickColor.new(bName).Color
            local torso = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or p.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            if torso then torso.Color = bc end
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_ApplyAppearance(targetPlr, appearanceName, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        local aName = tostring(appearanceName or "ROBLOX")
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("APPEARANCE", p.Name, aName, "")
        end
        if not p.Character then return end
        local lower = string.lower(aName)
        local palette = {
            Head = Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 48),
            Torso = Color3.fromRGB(196, 40, 28),
            Arm = Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 48),
            Leg = Color3.fromRGB(13, 105, 172)
        }
        if string.find(lower, "noob") then
            palette.Torso = Color3.fromRGB(13, 105, 172)
            palette.Leg = Color3.fromRGB(75, 151, 75)
        elseif string.find(lower, "1x1") or string.find(lower, "hacker") then
            palette.Head = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 17)
            palette.Torso = Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94)
            palette.Arm = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 17)
            palette.Leg = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 17)
        elseif string.find(lower, "c00l") then
            palette.Head = Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38)
            palette.Torso = Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38)
            palette.Arm = Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38)
            palette.Leg = Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38)
        elseif string.find(lower, "b1rkt") or string.find(lower, "gold") then
            palette.Head = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
            palette.Torso = Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11)
            palette.Arm = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
            palette.Leg = Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59)
        end
        for _, bp in ipairs(p.Character:GetChildren()) do
            if bp:IsA("BasePart") then
                if bp.Name == "Head" then bp.Color = palette.Head
                elseif string.find(bp.Name, "Torso") then bp.Color = palette.Torso
                elseif string.find(bp.Name, "Arm") or string.find(bp.Name, "Hand") then bp.Color = palette.Arm
                elseif string.find(bp.Name, "Leg") or string.find(bp.Name, "Foot") then bp.Color = palette.Leg
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_ToggleOrb(targetPlr, enable, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ORB", p.Name, enable and "1" or "0", "")
        end
        if not p.Character then return end
        local old = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_AdminOrb")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        if not enable then return end

        local orb = Instance.new("Part")

        orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        orb.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 2.2)
        orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon

        orb.Anchored = true
        orb.CanCollide = false
        orb.Parent = p.Character

        local ring = Instance.new("Part")
        ring.Name = "OrbRing"
        ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.25, 4.2, 4.2)
        ring.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11)
        ring.Transparency = 0.25
        ring.Anchored = true
        ring.CanCollide = false
        ring.Parent = orb

        task.spawn(function()
            local angle = 0
            while orb.Parent and p.Character and p.Character.Parent do
                local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    angle = angle + 0.065
                    local pos = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 5.2, 3.4 + math.sin(angle * 2) * 0.8, math.sin(angle) * 5.2)
                    orb.Position = pos
                    ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(angle, angle * 0.6, math.rad(90))
                    orb.Color = Color3.fromHSV((os.clock() * 0.25) % 1, 0.8, 1)
                end
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
        end)
    end
