        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        local cleanId = Engine.Topk3k_CleanAssetId(faceAssetId, "1365169983")
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("FACEDECAL", p.Name, cleanId, "")
        end
        local head = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end
        local face = head:FindFirstChild("face") or head:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
        if not face then
            face = Instance.new("Decal")
            face.Name = "face"
            face.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
            face.Parent = head
        end
        face.Texture = "rbxassetid://" .. cleanId
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_ActivateBossForm(targetPlr, bossType, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        local bType = string.upper(tostring(bossType or "GONER"))
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("BOSSFORM", p.Name, bType, "")
        end
        local char = p.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not char or not hrp then return end

        local oldRig = char:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_BossFormRig")
        if oldRig then oldRig:Destroy() end
        if bType == "OFF" or bType == "CLEAR" then return end

        local rig = Instance.new("Model")
        rig.Name = "Topk3k_BossFormRig"
        rig.Parent = char

        local function makeRigPart(name, size, col, mat, offsetCF)
            local pt = Instance.new("Part")
            pt.Name = name
            pt.Size = size
            pt.Color = col
            pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Neon
            pt.CanCollide = false
            pt.Massless = true
            pt.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * offsetCF
            pt.Parent = rig
            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            w.Part0 = hrp
            w.Part1 = pt
            w.Parent = pt
            return pt
        end

        if head then
            local oldTag = head:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_BossTag")
            if oldTag then oldTag:Destroy() end
            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Name = "Topk3k_BossTag"
            bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 0, 44)
            bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.2, 0)
            bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
            bb.Parent = head
            local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            tl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
            tl.TextSize = 20
            tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 55)
            tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
            tl.Text = "★ T0PK3K BOSS: " .. bType .. " ★"
            tl.Parent = bb
        end

        if bType == "C00LKIDD" then
            Engine.Topk3k_ApplyAppearance(p, "c00lkidd", false)
            for i = 1, 4 do
                local panel = makeRigPart("c00lPanel_" .. i, Vector3.new(3.5, 2.2, 0.2), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(math.cos(i * 1.57) * 4.5, 1.5, math.sin(i * 1.57) * 4.5))
                local dec = Instance.new("Decal")
                dec.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
                dec.Texture = "rbxassetid://1365169983"
                dec.Parent = panel
            end
        elseif bType == "1X1X1X1" then
            Engine.Topk3k_ApplyAppearance(p, "1x1x1x1", false)
            makeRigPart("MatrixHalo1", Vector3.new(8, 0.4, 8), Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, -2.5, 0))
            makeRigPart("MatrixCrown", Vector3.new(2.6, 1.5, 2.6), Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 3.2, 0))
            makeRigPart("DaemonBlade", Vector3.new(0.6, 8, 1.4), Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(2.2, 1, -2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(35), 0, 0))
        elseif bType == "JOHNDOE" then
            Engine.Topk3k_ApplyAppearance(p, "ROBLOX", false)
            for i = 1, 6 do
                makeRigPart("GlitchCube_" .. i, Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6), (i % 2 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38) or Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(math.sin(i) * 3.2, (i - 3) * 1.1, math.cos(i) * 3.2))
            end
        elseif bType == "GONER" then
            Engine.Topk3k_ApplyAppearance(p, "1x1x1x1", false)
            makeRigPart("DarkWingL", Vector3.new(0.4, 7, 3.2), Color3.fromRGB(185, 28, 28), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(-2.8, 1.5, 1.6) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(30), math.rad(25)))
            makeRigPart("DarkWingR", Vector3.new(0.4, 7, 3.2), Color3.fromRGB(185, 28, 28), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(2.8, 1.5, 1.6) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-30), math.rad(-25)))
            makeRigPart("VoidGreatsword", Vector3.new(0.8, 10, 2.2), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(2.5, 1.5, -2.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(45), 0, 0))
            if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = 38 end
        elseif bType == "SANS" then
            makeRigPart("BlueEyeGlow", Vector3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(-0.4, 1.6, -0.6))
            makeRigPart("GasterBlasterL", Vector3.new(3, 3.5, 4.5), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(-5.5, 3.5, -1))
            makeRigPart("GasterBlasterR", Vector3.new(3, 3.5, 4.5), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(5.5, 3.5, -1))
        elseif bType == "CHARA" then
            makeRigPart("SoulHeart", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 0.5), Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 0.5, -0.8))
            makeRigPart("RealKnife", Vector3.new(0.3, 4.5, 1.0), Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(2.0, 0, -2.0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(65), 0, 0))
        elseif bType == "SLENDER" then
            for t = 1, 6 do
                local ang = (t / 6) * math.pi * 2
                makeRigPart("Tentacle_" .. t, Vector3.new(0.45, 8.5, 0.45), Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(math.cos(ang) * 1.5, 1.5, 1.2) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-25), 0, math.sin(ang) * 0.8))
            end
        elseif bType == "SERAPHIM" then
            for w = 1, 6 do
                local side = (w <= 3) and -1 or 1
                local tier = ((w - 1) % 3) + 1
                makeRigPart("GoldWing_" .. w, Vector3.new(0.35, 7.5, 2.4), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(side * 3.0, tier * 1.2, 1.4) * CFrame.Angles(0, side * 0.4, side * (0.3 * tier)))
            end
            makeRigPart("HolyHalo", Vector3.new(4, 0.35, 4), Color3.fromRGB(254, 240, 138), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 3.8, 0))
        elseif bType == "REAPER" then
            makeRigPart("ScytheShaft", Vector3.new(0.4, 12, 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 36), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(2.2, 1, -1.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(20), 0, math.rad(-15)))
            makeRigPart("ScytheBlade", Vector3.new(0.3, 1.6, 6.5), Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(2.2, 6.5, -4.2))
        elseif bType == "CHRONOS" then
            makeRigPart("ClockRing", Vector3.new(9, 9, 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 2.2, 2.2))
            makeRigPart("HourHand", Vector3.new(0.5, 4, 0.6), Color3.fromRGB(254, 240, 138), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0, 3.5, 2.0))
        elseif bType == "LASEREYES" then
            makeRigPart("LaserBeamL", Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, 45), Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(-0.35, 1.5, -23))
            makeRigPart("LaserBeamR", Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, 45), Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), Enum.Material.Neon, CFrame.new(0.35, 1.5, -23))
        elseif bType == "KRYSTALDANCE" then
            task.spawn(function()
                local t0 = os.clock()
                while rig.Parent and hrp.Parent and os.clock() - t0 < 25 do
                    hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(14), 0)
                    if hum and math.random(1, 12) == 1 then
                        hum.Jump = true
                    end
                    task.wait(0.03)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)

-- ========================================================================================
-- [10.4G] T0PK3K 5.0 P2P HASAR / CAN MOTORU & 16 OZEL P2P SILAH / GEAR / BTOOLS MOTORU
-- ========================================================================================
SafeRunModule("T0PK3K_5.0_Combat_And_Gear_Engine", function()
    function Engine.Topk3k_ShowFloatingCombatText(char, textStr, col3)
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 36)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(math.random(-2, 2), 3.5, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.Parent = head

        local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
        tl.TextSize = 22
        tl.TextColor3 = col3 or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
        tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        tl.Text = tostring(textStr)
        tl.Parent = bb

        TweenService:Create(bb, TweenInfo.new(1.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 7.5, 0)
        }):Play()
        task.delay(1.15, function() pcall(function() bb:Destroy() end) end)
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_ApplyDamage(targetPlr, dmgAmount, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        local dmg = tonumber(dmgAmount) or 25
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then
            if UI.ShowNotification then
                UI.ShowNotification("B1rkt Koruma Kalkani", "B1rkt uzerinde hasar/komut kullanma izniniz yok!", "error")
            end
            return
        end
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("DAMAGE", p.Name, tostring(dmg), "")
        end
        if p.Character then
            local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.Health = math.max(0, hum.Health - dmg)
            end
            Engine.Topk3k_ShowFloatingCombatText(p.Character, "-" .. tostring(dmg) .. " HP", Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68))
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_ApplyHeal(targetPlr, healAmount, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        local heal = tonumber(healAmount) or 100
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("HEAL", p.Name, tostring(heal), "")
        end
        if p.Character then
            local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.Health = math.min(hum.MaxHealth, hum.Health + heal)
            end
            Engine.Topk3k_ShowFloatingCombatText(p.Character, "+" .. tostring(heal) .. " HP", Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94))
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_GiveCustomGear(gearType)
        local gType = string.upper(tostring(gearType or "SWORD"))
        local bp = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if not bp then return end

        if gType == "TROWEL" then
            local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
            tool.Name = "T0PK3K P2P Trowel"
            tool.RequiresHandle = true
            local handle = Instance.new("Part")
            handle.Name = "Handle"
            handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1.2, 3.2)
            handle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(194, 65, 12)
            handle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
            handle.Parent = tool
            tool.Activated:Connect(function()
                local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not hrp then return end
                local wallPos = (hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, -9)).Position
                local col = Color3.fromHSV(math.random(), 0.75, 0.95)
                Engine.Topk3k_SpawnSyncedBlock(wallPos, Vector3.new(12, 7, 2.5), col, "Brick", true)
            end)
            tool.Parent = bp
            return
        elseif gType == "BTOOLS" then
            local delTool = Instance.new("Tool")
            delTool.Name = "T0PK3K P2P Hammer (Sil)"
            delTool.RequiresHandle = true
            local h1 = Instance.new("Part")
            h1.Name = "Handle"
            h1.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 3.4, 1.2)
            h1.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38)
            h1.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            h1.Parent = delTool
            delTool.Activated:Connect(function()
                local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
                if mouse and mouse.Target then
                    Engine.Topk3k_DeleteWorkspacePart(mouse.Target, true)
                end
            end)
            delTool.Parent = bp

            local cloneTool = Instance.new("Tool")
            cloneTool.Name = "T0PK3K P2P Clone (Blok Ekle)"
            cloneTool.RequiresHandle = true
            local h2 = Instance.new("Part")
            h2.Name = "Handle"
            h2.Size = Vector3.new(1.2, 3.4, 1.2)
            h2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235)
            h2.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            h2.Parent = cloneTool
            cloneTool.Activated:Connect(function()
                local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
                if mouse and mouse.Hit then
                    Engine.Topk3k_SpawnSyncedBlock(mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), Vector3.new(6, 6, 6), Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235), "Neon", true)
                end
            end)
            cloneTool.Parent = bp
            return
        end

        local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
        tool.Name = "T0PK3K P2P " .. gType
        tool.RequiresHandle = true

        local handle = Instance.new("Part")
        handle.Name = "Handle"
        handle.Size = (gType == "SWORD" or gType == "BANHAMMER" or gType == "LIGHTNINGSTAFF") and Vector3.new(0.8, 5.2, 1.2) or Vector3.new(1.2, 1.6, 3.4)
        handle.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        handle.Color = (gType == "BANHAMMER") and Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11)
            or (gType == "LASERGUN" or gType == "FREEZERAY") and Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
            or (gType == "NUKELAUNCHER" or gType == "ROCKET" or gType == "FLAMETHROWER") and Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
            or Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)
        handle.Parent = tool

        tool.Activated:Connect(function()
            local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
            local hitPos = (mouse and mouse.Hit and mouse.Hit.Position) or Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin()
            if gType == "NUKELAUNCHER" then
                Engine.Topk3k_TriggerNuke(hitPos, true)
                return
            end
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("GEAR_FX", gType, Engine.FormatVec3(hitPos), "")
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                    local hrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp and (hrp.Position - hitPos).Magnitude < 24 then
                        if gType == "BANHAMMER" then
                            Engine.Topk3k_ApplyDamage(plr, 100, true)
                            Engine.RunTopk3kCommandP2P("fling " .. plr.Name)
                        elseif gType == "FREEZERAY" then
                            Engine.RunTopk3kCommandP2P("freeze " .. plr.Name)
                        else
                            Engine.Topk3k_ApplyDamage(plr, 35, true)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        tool.Parent = bp
    end

    -- ====================================================================================
    -- TAM P2P GELEN T0PK3K PAKET DISPATCHER (HER AKSİYON KARŞI TARAFTA BİREBİR ÇALIŞIR!)
    -- ====================================================================================
    function Engine.ExecuteTopk3kPacketAction(senderPlr, rawAction, targetName, rawValue)
        local subAction = string.gsub(tostring(rawAction or ""), "^TOPK3K_", "")
        local parts = string.split(tostring(rawValue or ""), "|")
        local arg1 = parts[1] or ""
        local arg2 = parts[2] or ""
        local arg3 = parts[3] or ""

        -- B1rkt izin senkronizasyonu
        if subAction == "B1RKT_PERM" then
            if Engine.IsB1rktOwner(senderPlr) then
                TableDB.B1rktAllowedUsers = TableDB.B1rktAllowedUsers or {}
                TableDB.B1rktAllowedUsers[targetName] = (arg1 == "ALLOW") and true or nil
                SyncTablePersistence()
            end
            return
        elseif subAction == "B1RKT_GLOBAL_PERM" then
            if Engine.IsB1rktOwner(senderPlr) then
                TableDB.B1rktAllowAllToTargetMe = (arg1 == "ALLOW")
                SyncTablePersistence()
            end
            return
        end

        -- B1rkt Koruma Kalkanı Kontrolü
        local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(tostring(targetName or ""))
        if targetPlr and not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(senderPlr, targetPlr) then
            return
        end
        if (targetName == "ALL" or targetName == "") and Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer) and not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(senderPlr, LocalPlayer) then
            -- B1rkt izin vermedikçe diğer oyuncuların yıkım/ses/efekt paketleri B1rkt'i etkilemez!
            return
        end

        State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
        State.CurrentP2PSender = senderPlr

        pcall(function()
            if subAction == "SOUND" then
                local lpFlag, modeStr = string.match(arg2, "^([01]):(.*)$")
                local isLoop = (lpFlag == "1") or (arg2 == "1")
                Engine.Topk3k_PlayCustomSound(targetName, tonumber(arg1) or 1, tonumber(arg3) or 10, isLoop, modeStr or "NORMAL", false)
            elseif subAction == "STOP_SOUNDS" then
                Engine.Topk3k_StopAllSounds(false)
            elseif subAction == "SKYBOX" then
                Engine.Topk3k_ApplySkybox(targetName, arg1 == "SPIN", false)
            elseif subAction == "DECAL_SPAM" then
                Engine.Topk3k_DecalSpamMap(targetName, arg1 == "FLASH", false)
            elseif subAction == "PARTICLE_SPAM" then
                Engine.Topk3k_ParticleSpamMap(targetName, false)
            elseif subAction == "BILLBOARD_SPAM" then
                Engine.Topk3k_BillboardSpamMap(targetName, arg1, false)
            elseif subAction == "CLEAR_DECALS" then
                Engine.Topk3k_ClearDecalAndSky(false)
            elseif subAction == "TOTAL_CHAOS" then
                Engine.Topk3k_TotalChaosMode(false)
            elseif subAction == "CLEARNIL" then
                Engine.Topk3k_ClearNil(false)
            elseif subAction == "CLEAR_EXECUTED" then
                Engine.Topk3k_ClearExecutedScripts(false)
            elseif subAction == "DISASTER" then
                if targetName == "NUKE" then Engine.Topk3k_TriggerNuke(arg1, false)
                elseif targetName == "666" then Engine.Topk3k_Trigger666Nightmare(false)
                elseif targetName == "BLACKHOLE" then Engine.Topk3k_TriggerBlackHole(arg1, false)
                elseif targetName == "TSUNAMI" then Engine.Topk3k_TriggerTsunami(false)
                elseif targetName == "VOLCANO" then Engine.Topk3k_TriggerVolcano(arg1, false)
                elseif targetName == "ACIDRAIN" then Engine.Topk3k_TriggerAcidRain(false)
                elseif targetName == "ALIEN" then Engine.Topk3k_TriggerAlienInvasion(false)
                elseif targetName == "ZOMBIES" then Engine.Topk3k_TriggerZombieApocalypse(tonumber(arg1) or 6, false)
                end
            elseif subAction == "MAP_MOD" then
                if targetName == "UNANCHOR" then Engine.Topk3k_UnanchorMap(false)
                elseif targetName == "ANCHOR" then Engine.Topk3k_AnchorMap(false)
                elseif targetName == "COLORSPAM" then Engine.Topk3k_ColorSpamMap(false)
                elseif targetName == "NEONMAP" then Engine.Topk3k_NeonMaterialMap(false)
                end
            elseif subAction == "SPAWN_BLOCK" then
                Engine.Topk3k_SpawnSyncedBlock(targetName, arg1, arg2, arg3, false)
            elseif subAction == "DELETE_BLOCK" then
                Engine.Topk3k_DeleteWorkspacePart(targetName, false)
            elseif subAction == "RESTORE_BLOCKS" then
                Engine.Topk3k_RestoreDeletedBlocks(false)
            elseif subAction == "SPAWN_PAD" then
                Engine.Topk3k_SpawnInteractivePad(targetName, arg1, false)
            elseif subAction == "STRUCTURE" then
                Engine.Topk3k_SpawnStructure(targetName, arg1, false)
            elseif subAction == "VEHICLE" then
                Engine.Topk3k_SpawnVehicle(targetName, arg1, false)
            elseif subAction == "SEMIGOD" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_SetSemiGod(targetPlr, arg1 == "1", false)
            elseif subAction == "LOOPGOD" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_SetLoopGod(targetPlr, arg1 == "1", false)
            elseif subAction == "LEVITATE" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_SetLevitate(targetPlr, arg1 == "1", false)
            elseif subAction == "HIGHJUMP" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_SetHighJump(targetPlr, arg1 == "1", false)
            elseif subAction == "NOGRAV" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_SetNoGrav(targetPlr, arg1 == "1", false)
            elseif subAction == "NAKED" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_SetNaked(targetPlr, false)
            elseif subAction == "NEUTRAL" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_SetNeutral(targetPlr, false)
            elseif subAction == "TEAMCOLOR" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_SetTeamColor(targetPlr, arg1, false)
            elseif subAction == "APPEARANCE" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_ApplyAppearance(targetPlr, arg1, false)
            elseif subAction == "ORB" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_ToggleOrb(targetPlr, arg1 == "1", false)
            elseif subAction == "FEDORA" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_GiveFedora(targetPlr, false)
            elseif subAction == "RAINBOWNAME" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_ToggleRainbowName(targetPlr, arg1 == "1", false)
            elseif subAction == "FACEDECAL" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_ApplyFaceDecal(targetPlr, arg1, false)
            elseif subAction == "BOSSFORM" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_ActivateBossForm(targetPlr, arg1, false)
            elseif subAction == "DAMAGE" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_ApplyDamage(targetPlr, tonumber(arg1) or 25, false)
            elseif subAction == "HEAL" and targetPlr then
                Engine.Topk3k_ApplyHeal(targetPlr, tonumber(arg1) or 100, false)
            elseif subAction == "GEAR_FX" then
                local fxPos = Engine.ParseVec3(arg1)
                if fxPos then
                    local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
                    local blast = Instance.new("Part")
                    blast.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                    blast.Size = Vector3.new(6, 6, 6)
                    blast.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                    blast.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
                    blast.Anchored = true
                    blast.CanCollide = false
                    blast.Position = fxPos
                    blast.Parent = wf
                    TweenService:Create(blast, TweenInfo.new(0.45), { Size = Vector3.new(18, 18, 18), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
                    task.delay(0.5, function() pcall(function() blast:Destroy() end) end)
                end
            end
        end)

        State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
        State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
    end
end)

-- [10.5] TAM P2P GELEN SINYAL & EVRENSEL KOMUT DINLEYICI
SafeRunModule("Universal_P2P_Listener", function()
    local reverseOpcodes = {
        ["01"] = "HANDSHAKE", ["02"] = "KICK", ["03"] = "BAN", ["04"] = "FREEZE", ["05"] = "THAW",
        ["06"] = "JAIL", ["07"] = "UNJAIL", ["08"] = "KILL", ["09"] = "BRING", ["10"] = "FLING",
        ["11"] = "SETRANK", ["12"] = "GLOBAL_ANNOUNCE", ["13"] = "WARN_MODAL", ["14"] = "FORCE_CHAT",
        ["15"] = "BLIND", ["16"] = "UNBLIND", ["17"] = "CONFUSE", ["18"] = "UNCONFUSE",
        ["19"] = "RAGDOLL", ["20"] = "UNRAGDOLL", ["21"] = "SKYFLING", ["22"] = "VOIDFLING",
        ["23"] = "ORBITFLING", ["24"] = "GIANT", ["25"] = "TINY", ["26"] = "NORMALSCALE",
        ["27"] = "RAINBOW", ["28"] = "UNRAINBOW", ["29"] = "DISCO", ["30"] = "UNDISCO",
        ["31"] = "SEIZURE", ["32"] = "UNSEIZURE", ["33"] = "GLITCH", ["34"] = "UNGLITCH",
        ["35"] = "SINK", ["36"] = "UNSINK", ["37"] = "ELEVATE", ["38"] = "EARTHQUAKE",
        ["39"] = "TORNADO", ["40"] = "METEOR", ["41"] = "SHOCKWAVE", ["42"] = "PREFIX_SYNC",
        ["43"] = "FULL_SYNC"
    }

    local function RegisterDiscoveredPeer(sender, lastSignalName)
        if not sender then return 1 end
        if sender.Name ~= ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME and (not TableDB.RanksByUsername[sender.Name] or TableDB.RanksByUsername[sender.Name] <= 1) then
            if not (TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername and TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername[sender.Name]) then
                TableDB.RanksByUsername[sender.Name] = 9
            end
        end
        local senderRank = ResolvePlayerRankLevel(sender)
        local isFirstDiscovery = (State.ActivePeers[sender.Name] == nil)
        State.ActivePeers[sender.Name] = {
            RankLevel = senderRank,
            PersonalPrefix = ResolvePersonalPrefix(sender.Name),
            LastSignal = lastSignalName or "HANDSHAKE",
            Effects = TableDB.ActiveEffectsByUsername[sender.Name] or {}
        }
        UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(sender)
        if isFirstDiscovery and sender ~= LocalPlayer then
            print(string.format("[BERK'S ADMIN FE v5.0 · P2P] Yeni Script Kullanicisi (Peer) Baglandi: %s (Tier %d)", sender.Name, senderRank))
            if not State.HandshakedPeers[sender.Name] then
                State.HandshakedPeers[sender.Name] = true
                task.delay(0.15, function()
                    BroadcastAnimateBridgePacket("HANDSHAKE", "ALL", tostring(State.LocalRankLevel))
                end)
            end
        end
        return senderRank
    end

    local function HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(sender, opcode, targetSlotOrUid, speedParam)
        if not sender or sender == LocalPlayer then return end
        local actionName = reverseOpcodes[opcode] or "HANDSHAKE"
        local senderRank = RegisterDiscoveredPeer(sender, actionName)

        if actionName == "HANDSHAKE" or actionName == "FULL_SYNC" then
            if sender.Name ~= ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME and speedParam and speedParam >= 1 and speedParam <= 10 then
                TableDB.RanksByUsername[sender.Name] = math.clamp(math.floor(speedParam), 1, 10)
                UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(sender)
            end
            return
        end

        local affectedPlayers = {}
        local slotNum = tonumber(targetSlotOrUid) or 0
        if slotNum >= 0 and slotNum <= 99 then
            affectedPlayers = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, slotNum)
        else
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p.UserId == slotNum then
                    table.insert(affectedPlayers, p)
                end
            end
        end
        if #affectedPlayers == 0 then
            affectedPlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
        end

        print(string.format("[BERK'S ADMIN FE v5.0 · P2P] %s -> Opcode: %s (%d hedef oyuncu)", sender.Name, actionName, #affectedPlayers))

        State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
        State.CurrentP2PSender = sender

        local isLocalAffected = false
        for _, tPlr in ipairs(affectedPlayers) do
            if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(sender, tPlr) then
                if tPlr == LocalPlayer and UI.SendNotification then
                    UI.SendNotification(
                        "B1RKT KORUMA KALKANI",
                        string.format("%s üzerinizde %s denedi (İzinsiz · Engellendi!)", sender.Name, actionName),
                        Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11),
                        2.5
                    )
                end
            else
                if tPlr == LocalPlayer then
                    isLocalAffected = true
                end
                if actionName == "SETRANK" then
                    local newLvl = math.clamp(math.floor(speedParam or 1), 0, 10)
                    if tPlr.Name ~= ROOT_OWNER_USERNAME then
                        TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername = TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername or {}
                        TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername[tPlr.Name] = newLvl
                        TableDB.RanksByUsername[tPlr.Name] = newLvl
                    end
                    UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(tPlr)
                elseif actionName == "FLING" or actionName == "SKYFLING" or actionName == "VOIDFLING" or actionName == "ORBITFLING" then
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "FLUNG", true)
                    if tPlr.Character and tPlr ~= LocalPlayer then
                        Engine.ApplyPhysicalFlingToCharacter(tPlr.Character)
                    end
                elseif actionName == "FREEZE" then
                    Engine.SetPlayerFrozenState(tPlr, true)
                elseif actionName == "THAW" then
                    Engine.SetPlayerFrozenState(tPlr, false)
                elseif actionName == "JAIL" then
                    Engine.CreateNeonJailAroundPlayer(tPlr, true)
                elseif actionName == "UNJAIL" then
                    Engine.CreateNeonJailAroundPlayer(tPlr, false)
                elseif actionName == "GIANT" and tPlr.Character then
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "GIANT", true)
                    Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(tPlr.Character, 3.0)
                elseif actionName == "TINY" and tPlr.Character then
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "TINY", true)
                    Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(tPlr.Character, 0.4)
                elseif actionName == "NORMALSCALE" and tPlr.Character then
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "GIANT", false)
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "TINY", false)
                    Engine.ApplyCharacterScaleFactor(tPlr.Character, 1.0)
                elseif actionName == "RAINBOW" then
                    State.RainbowPlayers[tPlr.Name] = true
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "RAINBOW", true)
                elseif actionName == "UNRAINBOW" then
                    State.RainbowPlayers[tPlr.Name] = nil
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "RAINBOW", false)
                elseif actionName == "DISCO" then
                    State.DiscoMode = true
                elseif actionName == "UNDISCO" then
                    State.DiscoMode = false
                elseif actionName == "SEIZURE" then
                    State.SeizurePlayers[tPlr.Name] = true
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "SEIZURE", true)
                elseif actionName == "UNSEIZURE" then
                    State.SeizurePlayers[tPlr.Name] = nil
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "SEIZURE", false)
                elseif actionName == "GLITCH" then
                    State.GlitchPlayers[tPlr.Name] = true
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "GLITCH", true)
                elseif actionName == "UNGLITCH" then
                    State.GlitchPlayers[tPlr.Name] = nil
                    RecordPlayerP2PEffect(tPlr.Name, "GLITCH", false)
                elseif actionName == "SINK" then
                    Engine.SetP2PSinkPlayer(tPlr, true)
                elseif actionName == "UNSINK" then
                    Engine.SetP2PSinkPlayer(tPlr, false)
                elseif actionName == "ELEVATE" then
                    Engine.ElevateTargetViaP2P(tPlr, tonumber(speedParam) or 35)
                elseif actionName == "TORNADO" then
                    Engine.StartP2PTornadoVortex(tPlr)
                elseif actionName == "METEOR" then
                    Engine.SpawnP2PMeteorStrike(tPlr)
                elseif actionName == "SHOCKWAVE" then
                    Engine.EmitP2PShockwavePulse(tonumber(speedParam) or 65)
                end
            end
        end

        if isLocalAffected and Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(sender, LocalPlayer) then
            local isProtectedRootOwner = (Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer) and not Engine.IsB1rktOwner(sender))
            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

            if actionName == "KICK" and not isProtectedRootOwner then
                PlayUiSound("error")
                LocalPlayer:Kick(string.format("[Berk's Admin P2P · %s tarafindan atildiniz]", sender.Name))
            elseif actionName == "BAN" and not isProtectedRootOwner then
                TableDB.BannedUsers[LocalPlayer.Name] = "Banned by " .. sender.Name
                SyncTablePersistence()
                LocalPlayer:Kick(string.format("[Berk's Admin P2P · %s tarafindan YASAKLANDINIZ]", sender.Name))
            elseif actionName == "FREEZE" and myHrp then
                myHrp.Anchored = true
                if UI.SendNotification then UI.SendNotification("P2P DONDURULDUNUZ", sender.Name .. " sizi dondurdu!", Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)) end
            elseif actionName == "THAW" and myHrp then
                myHrp.Anchored = false
                if UI.SendNotification then UI.SendNotification("P2P COZULDUNUZ", sender.Name .. " buz kilidinizi acti.", Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128)) end
            elseif actionName == "KILL" and myHum and not isProtectedRootOwner then
                myHum.Health = 0
                if UI.SendNotification then UI.SendNotification("P2P KILL", sender.Name .. " sizi oldurdu!", Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)) end
            elseif actionName == "BRING" and myHrp and sender.Character then
                local senderHrp = sender.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if senderHrp then
                    myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    myHrp.CFrame = senderHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3.5)
                    if UI.SendNotification then UI.SendNotification("P2P BRING", sender.Name .. " sizi yanina cekti!", Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)) end
                end
            elseif (actionName == "FLING" or actionName == "SKYFLING" or actionName == "VOIDFLING" or actionName == "ORBITFLING") and myChar and not isProtectedRootOwner then
                PlayUiSound("fling")
                local vec = actionName == "VOIDFLING" and Vector3.new(0, -45000, 0) or Vector3.new(18000, 48000, -18000)
                Engine.ApplyPhysicalFlingToCharacter(myChar, vec, 99999)
                if UI.SendNotification then UI.SendNotification("P2P FLING!", sender.Name .. " sizi firlatti!", Color3.fromRGB(244, 63, 94)) end
            elseif actionName == "BLIND" then
                Engine.SetPlayerBlindEffect(LocalPlayer, true)
            elseif actionName == "UNBLIND" then
                Engine.SetPlayerBlindEffect(LocalPlayer, false)
            elseif actionName == "CONFUSE" then
                Engine.SetPlayerConfusedControls(LocalPlayer, true)
            elseif actionName == "UNCONFUSE" then
                Engine.SetPlayerConfusedControls(LocalPlayer, false)
            elseif actionName == "RAGDOLL" then
                Engine.SetPlayerRagdollState(LocalPlayer, true)
            elseif actionName == "UNRAGDOLL" then
                Engine.SetPlayerRagdollState(LocalPlayer, false)
            elseif actionName == "WARN_MODAL" and UI.SendNotification then
                PlayUiSound("error")
                UI.SendNotification("MODERATOR UYARISI (" .. sender.Name .. ")", tostring(speedParam or "Lutfen kurallara uyun!"), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), 6)
            elseif actionName == "GLOBAL_ANNOUNCE" and UI.SendNotification then
                PlayUiSound("rank")
                UI.SendNotification("SUNUCU DUYURUSU (" .. sender.Name .. ")", tostring(speedParam or "Berk's Admin P2P Duyurusu"), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), 6)
            elseif actionName == "SETRANK" and not isProtectedRootOwner then
                local newLvl = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(speedParam) or 1), 0, 10)
                TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername = TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername or {}
                TableDB.ExplicitRanksByUsername[LocalPlayer.Name] = newLvl
                TableDB.RanksByUsername[LocalPlayer.Name] = newLvl
                State.LocalRankLevel = newLvl
                SyncTablePersistence()
                UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(LocalPlayer)
                if UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay then UI.RefreshTopBarRankDisplay() end
                PlayUiSound("rank")
                if UI.SendNotification then
                    UI.SendNotification("YETKINIZ GUNCELLENDI", string.format("%s yetkinizi Tier %d (%s) yapti!", sender.Name, newLvl, GetTierData(newLvl).Name), GetTierData(newLvl).Color)
                end
            end
        end

        State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
        State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
    end

    function Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(sender, cmdIndex, targetSlot, numericArg, customArgsTable)
        if not sender or sender == LocalPlayer then return end
        local resolvedCmd = CommandList[cmdIndex]
        if not resolvedCmd then return end
        RegisterDiscoveredPeer(sender, resolvedCmd.Name)

        local targets = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, targetSlot)
        if #targets == 0 then
            targets = { sender }
        end

        print(string.format("[BERK'S ADMIN FE v5.0 · P2P KOMUT] %s -> ;%s (Hedef: %d oyuncu)", sender.Name, resolvedCmd.Name, #targets))

        State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
        State.CurrentP2PSender = sender

        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local isPermissionSyncCmd = (resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktallow" or resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktdeny" or resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktallowall" or resolvedCmd.Name == "b1rktdenyall")
        for _, targetPlr in ipairs(targets) do
            local allowedOnB1rkt = Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(sender, targetPlr)
            if isPermissionSyncCmd and Engine.IsB1rktOwner(sender) then
                allowedOnB1rkt = true
            end
            if not allowedOnB1rkt then
                if targetPlr == LocalPlayer and UI.SendNotification then
                    UI.SendNotification(
                        "B1RKT ÖZEL KORUMA KALKANI",
                        string.format("%s üzerinizde ;%s denedi fakat izin vermediğiniz için engellendi!", sender.Name, resolvedCmd.Name),
                        Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11),
                        3
                    )
                end
            else
                local tChar = targetPlr and targetPlr.Character
                local tHrp = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local tHum = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local secondArgVal = numericArg and tostring(numericArg) or nil
                if numericArg and numericArg >= 9901 and numericArg <= 9995 then
                    local secPlrs = Engine.ResolvePlayersFromTargetSlot(sender, numericArg - 9900)
                    if secPlrs and secPlrs[1] then
                        secondArgVal = secPlrs[1].Name
                    end
                end
                local synthArgs = customArgsTable or {
                    [1] = (numericArg and numericArg <= 9900 and tostring(numericArg)) or (targetPlr and targetPlr.Name or "me"),
                    [2] = secondArgVal
                }
                pcall(function()
                    resolvedCmd.Action(targetPlr, synthArgs, tHrp, tHum, cam)
                end)
                if targetPlr == LocalPlayer and UI.SendNotification then
                    UI.SendNotification(
                        "P2P · " .. string.upper(resolvedCmd.Name),
                        string.format("%s sizin uzerinizde ;%s calistirdi!", sender.Name, resolvedCmd.Name),
                        GetTierData(ResolvePlayerRankLevel(sender)).Color,
                        2.5
                    )
                end
            end
        end

        State.PendingPeerNumericArg[sender.Name] = nil
        State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
        State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
    end

    function Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, speedVal)
        if not plr or plr == LocalPlayer then return end
        if type(speedVal) ~= "number" or speedVal < 8.0 or speedVal > 115.0 then return end

        local packetInt = math.floor(((speedVal - 8.0) * 1024) + 0.5)
        if packetInt < 100 or packetInt > 100000 then return end

        local dedupKey = plr.Name .. "_" .. tostring(packetInt)
        local now = tick()
        if State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey] and (now - State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey]) < 0.22 then
            return
        end
        State.RecentP2PPackets[dedupKey] = now

        if packetInt >= 80000 and packetInt <= 89999 then
            State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name] = packetInt - 80000
            return
        end

        local cmdCode = math.floor(packetInt / 100)
        local targetSlot = packetInt % 100

        if cmdCode >= 701 and cmdCode <= 743 then
            local opcodeStr = string.format("%02d", cmdCode - 700)
            local paramVal = State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name]
            State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name] = nil
            HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(plr, opcodeStr, targetSlot, paramVal)
        elseif cmdCode >= 1 and cmdCode <= #CommandList then
            local paramVal = State.PendingPeerNumericArg[plr.Name]
            Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(plr, cmdCode, targetSlot, paramVal, nil)
        end
    end

    local function HookPlayerAnimateBridge(plr)
        local function onCharAdded(char)
            task.defer(function()
                UpdatePlayerOverheadP2PBadge(plr)
            end)
            local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
            if not hum then return end
            local animator = hum:WaitForChild("Animator", 10)
            if not animator then return end

            animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
                if not track then return end
                local anim = track.Animation
                local animId = tostring(anim and anim.AnimationId or "")
                local prefixStr = "rbxassetid://9900"
                if string.sub(animId, 1, #prefixStr) == prefixStr then
                    local payload = string.sub(animId, #prefixStr + 1)
                    local opcode = string.sub(payload, 1, 2)
                    local targetUidStr = string.sub(payload, 3)
                    HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(plr, opcode, targetUidStr, track.Speed)
                    return
                end

                if track.Speed >= 8.0 then
                    Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, track.Speed)
                else
                    local conn
                    conn = track:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Speed"):Connect(function()
                        if track.Speed >= 8.0 then
                            if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
                            Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, track.Speed)
                        end
                    end)
                    task.delay(0.35, function()
                        if conn then conn:Disconnect(); conn = nil end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end

        if plr.Character then
            task.spawn(onCharAdded, plr.Character)
        end
        plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharAdded)

        -- Chat Uzerinden P2P Komut Dinleyici (;komut veya kisisel prefix ile yazilan komutlari yakalar)
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            plr.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
                local peerPfx = ResolvePersonalPrefix(plr.Name)
                local defPfx = TableDB.DefaultPrefix or ";"
                local clean = nil
                if string.sub(msg, 1, #peerPfx) == peerPfx then
                    clean = string.sub(msg, #peerPfx + 1)
                elseif string.sub(msg, 1, #defPfx) == defPfx then
                    clean = string.sub(msg, #defPfx + 1)
                elseif string.sub(msg, 1, 1) == ";" or string.sub(msg, 1, 1) == "!" then
                    clean = string.sub(msg, 2)
                end
                if not clean then return end
                clean = string.gsub(clean, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
                if clean == "" then return end

                local parts = string.split(clean, " ")
                local cmdName = string.lower(parts[1] or "")
                table.remove(parts, 1)
                local resolvedCmd = CommandRegistry[cmdName]
                if not resolvedCmd then
                    for _, c in ipairs(CommandList) do
                        for _, alias in ipairs(c.Aliases) do
                            if string.lower(alias) == cmdName then
                                resolvedCmd = c
                                break
                            end
                        end
                        if resolvedCmd then break end
                    end
                end
                if resolvedCmd and resolvedCmd.CmdIndex then
                    local slot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(parts[1] or "me")
                    if resolvedCmd.Name == "uncontrol" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unfollow" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unorbit" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unloopgoto" or resolvedCmd.Name == "unbackpack" then
                        slot = 0
                    elseif parts[1] == nil or string.lower(parts[1]) == "me" or string.lower(parts[1]) == "ben" then
                        slot = 98
                    end
                    Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(plr, resolvedCmd.CmdIndex, slot, tonumber(parts[2] or parts[1]), parts)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    -- Paylasimli Bellek / Studio Bus Kaydi
    _G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners = _G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners or {}
    _G.BerksAdmin_P2PSharedListeners[LocalPlayer.Name] = function(senderPlr, packetType, a, b, c)
        if not senderPlr or senderPlr == LocalPlayer then return end
        if packetType == "OPCODE" then
            HandleIncomingAnimateBridgePacket(senderPlr, a, b, c)
        elseif packetType == "CMD" then
            local slot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(b or "me")
            if b == nil or string.lower(tostring(b)) == "me" then slot = 98 end
            if string.lower(tostring(b)) == "all" then slot = 0 end
            Engine.ExecuteIncomingUniversalP2PCommand(senderPlr, a, slot, tonumber(c and (c[2] or c[1])), c)
        end
    end

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        HookPlayerAnimateBridge(plr)
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(HookPlayerAnimateBridge)
end)

    local function MakeDraggable(dragHandle, targetFrame)
        local dragging = false
        local dragInput = nil
        local dragStart = Vector3.zero
        local startPos = UDim2.new()

        dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = targetFrame.Position
                input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                        dragging = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)

        dragHandle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragInput = input
            end
        end)

        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input == dragInput and dragging then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                targetFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale,
                    startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale,
                    startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end
        end)
    end

        function UI.ShowCmdHoldTooltip(cmd)
            if not cmd then
                CmdHoldTooltip.Visible = false
                return
            end
            local argsStr = (State.Language == "EN" and cmd.ArgsEn) and cmd.ArgsEn or (cmd.Args or "")
            local descStr = (State.Language == "EN" and cmd.DescriptionEn) and cmd.DescriptionEn or (cmd.Description or "")
            local aliasStr = (#cmd.Aliases > 0) and (" (" .. table.concat(cmd.Aliases, ", ") .. ")") or ""
            local tData = GetTierData(cmd.MinTier)
            ttTitle.Text = State.Prefix .. cmd.Name .. (#argsStr > 0 and (" " .. argsStr) or "")
            ttTier.Text = string.format("Tier %d (%s)%s", cmd.MinTier, tData.Name, aliasStr)
            ttDesc.Text = descStr
            CmdHoldTooltip.Visible = true
        end
    end

    -- TIKLANMAMISKEN KENDI KENDINE SAG ALTA KUCULME (AUTO-SHRINK) FONKSIYONU
    function UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(shrunk)
        if not State.MenuOpen then return end
        State.DockAutoShrunk = shrunk
        local targetSize = shrunk and UDim2.new(0, 232, 0, 46) or UDim2.new(0, 232, 0, 195)
        local targetPos = shrunk and UDim2.new(1, -242, 1, -54) or UDim2.new(1, -242, 1, -205)
        TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = targetSize,
            Position = targetPos
        }):Play()
    end

    function UI.RefreshCommandListUI(filterText)
        CmdTextBox.PlaceholderText = UI.Tr(
            string.format("Komut Barı (%s)", State.Prefix),
            string.format("Command Bar (%s)", State.Prefix)
        )
        for _, child in ipairs(CmdsScroll:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("TextButton") then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end

        local rawFilter = filterText or ""
        if string.sub(rawFilter, 1, #State.Prefix) == State.Prefix then
            rawFilter = string.sub(rawFilter, #State.Prefix + 1)
        elseif string.sub(rawFilter, 1, 1) == ";" then
            rawFilter = string.sub(rawFilter, 2)
        end
        local q = string.lower(string.gsub(rawFilter, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1"))
        local firstWord = string.split(q, " ")[1] or ""
        local visibleCount = 0

        for idx, cmd in ipairs(CommandList) do
            local descToSearch = (State.Language == "EN" and cmd.DescriptionEn) and cmd.DescriptionEn or cmd.Description
            local match = (firstWord == "")
                or string.find(string.lower(cmd.Name), firstWord, 1, true) ~= nil
                or string.find(string.lower(descToSearch), firstWord, 1, true) ~= nil

            if not match then
                for _, al in ipairs(cmd.Aliases) do
                    if string.find(string.lower(al), firstWord, 1, true) then
                        match = true
                        break
                    end
                end
            end

            if match then
                visibleCount = visibleCount + 1
                local unlocked = (State.LocalRankLevel >= cmd.MinTier)
                local rowBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                rowBtn.Name = "CmdRow_" .. cmd.Name
                rowBtn.LayoutOrder = idx
                rowBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 19)
                rowBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 43)
                rowBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
                rowBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                rowBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                rowBtn.TextSize = 11
                rowBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                rowBtn.TextColor3 = unlocked and Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245) or Color3.fromRGB(145, 145, 150)

                local aliasText = #cmd.Aliases > 0 and (" / " .. table.concat(cmd.Aliases, " / ")) or ""
                local dispArgs = (State.Language == "EN" and cmd.ArgsEn) and cmd.ArgsEn or cmd.Args
                local argsText = (dispArgs and #dispArgs > 0) and (" " .. dispArgs) or ""
                local lockSuffix = unlocked and "" or string.format(UI.Tr(" [Kilit T%d]", " [Lock T%d]"), cmd.MinTier)
                rowBtn.Text = "  " .. cmd.Name .. aliasText .. argsText .. lockSuffix
                rowBtn.Parent = CmdsScroll

                local isHolding = false
                local holdTriggered = false

                rowBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
                    UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(false)
                    isHolding = true
                    holdTriggered = false
                    task.delay(0.35, function()
                        if isHolding then
                            holdTriggered = true
                            PlayUiSound("tab")
                            UI.ShowCmdHoldTooltip(cmd)
                        end
                    end)
                end)

                rowBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
                    isHolding = false
                    if holdTriggered then
                        task.delay(1.6, function()
                            if UI.CmdHoldTooltip then UI.CmdHoldTooltip.Visible = false end
                        end)
                    end
                end)

                rowBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    isHolding = false
                    if UI.CmdHoldTooltip then
                        UI.CmdHoldTooltip.Visible = false
                    end
                end)

                rowBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if holdTriggered then
                        holdTriggered = false
                        return
                    end
                    UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(false)
                    PlayUiSound("click")
                    local typed = CmdTextBox.Text
                    local typedArgs = string.split(typed, " ")
                    if #typedArgs >= 2 and UI.ExecuteCommandString then
                        UI.ExecuteCommandString(cmd.Name .. " " .. table.concat(typedArgs, " ", 2))
                    elseif UI.ExecuteCommandString then
                        UI.ExecuteCommandString(cmd.Name .. " " .. State.SelectedTargetMode)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        CmdsScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, math.max(150, visibleCount * 20 + 8))
    end

        SubHalloweenTag.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(253, 186, 116)
        SubHalloweenTag.Text = "HALLOWEEN EDITION // P2P ANIMATE // 528+ CMDS"
        SubHalloweenTag.ZIndex = 85
        SubHalloweenTag.Parent = CenterHolder

        function UI.TriggerHalloweenIntro()
            FullIntroOverlay.Visible = true
            FullIntroOverlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28

            -- Ekranimizi biraz bugulandir (Lighting BlurEffect)
            local oldBlur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("BerksHalloweenBlur")
            if oldBlur then oldBlur:Destroy() end
            local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
            blur.Name = "BerksHalloweenBlur"
            blur.Size = 0
            blur.Parent = Lighting
            TweenService:Create(blur, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = 15 }):Play()

            -- Yukaridan Bal Kabagi Yagmuru (18 Adet Procedural Pumpkin)
            for i = 1, 18 do
                task.spawn(function()
                    local pmp = DrawProceduralIcon(FullIntroOverlay, "pumpkin", Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22))
                    local sz = math.random(22, 38)
                    pmp.Size = UDim2.new(0, sz, 0, sz)
                    local startX = math.random(4, 94) / 100
                    pmp.Position = UDim2.new(startX, 0, -0.12, 0)
                    pmp.Rotation = math.random(-25, 25)
                    pmp.ZIndex = 84
                    local fallDur = 1.25 + (math.random(0, 80) / 100)
                    TweenService:Create(pmp, TweenInfo.new(fallDur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
                        Position = UDim2.new(startX + (math.random(-6, 6) / 100), 0, 1.12, 0),
                        Rotation = pmp.Rotation + math.random(-140, 140)
                    }):Play()
                    task.delay(fallDur + 0.1, function()
                        if pmp and pmp.Parent then pmp:Destroy() end
                    end)
                end)
            end

            task.delay(2.2, function()
                TweenService:Create(blur, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Size = 0 }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(FullIntroOverlay, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1
                }):Play()
                task.delay(0.6, function()
                    if blur and blur.Parent then blur:Destroy() end
                    FullIntroOverlay.Visible = false
                end)
            end)
        end
    end

        local function RefreshBanKickModalView()
            local isBan = (State.BanKickMenuMode == "BAN")
            bkStroke.Color = isBan and Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68) or Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11)
            bkTitle.TextColor3 = bkStroke.Color
            bkTitle.Text = isBan
                and UI.Tr("KAPSAMLI BAN MENÜSÜ (;banmenu)", "COMPREHENSIVE BAN MENU (;banmenu)")
                or UI.Tr("KAPSAMLI KICK MENÜSÜ (;kickmenu)", "COMPREHENSIVE KICK MENU (;kickmenu)")
            tabBanBtn.BackgroundColor3 = isBan and Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 50)
            tabKickBtn.BackgroundColor3 = (not isBan) and Color3.fromRGB(217, 119, 6) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 50)
            targetSelectBtn.Text = UI.Tr("Hedef Oyuncu: ", "Target Player: ") .. selectedTargetName .. UI.Tr(" (Değiştir)", " (Cycle)")

            permToggleBtn.Visible = isBan
            durationBtn.Visible = isBan
            kickNoPermBanner.Visible = not isBan
            unbanBtn.Visible = isBan
            executeBtn.Size = isBan and UDim2.new(0.65, -8, 0, 32) or UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 32)
            executeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = isBan and Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38) or Color3.fromRGB(217, 119, 6)

            if isBan then
                permToggleBtn.Text = isPermBan
                    and UI.Tr("Perm Ban mı?: EVET (KALICI PERM)", "Permanent Ban?: YES (PERM BAN)")
                    or UI.Tr("Perm Ban mı?: HAYIR (SÜRELİ BAN)", "Permanent Ban?: NO (TIMED BAN)")
                permToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = isPermBan and Color3.fromRGB(153, 27, 27) or Color3.fromRGB(30, 64, 175)
                local durStr = isPermBan and UI.Tr("Sınırsız (PERM)", "Unlimited (PERM)") or durationOptions[durationIdx]
                durationBtn.Text = UI.Tr("Ban Süresi: ", "Ban Duration: ") .. durStr
                executeBtn.Text = UI.Tr("BAN UYGULA (P2P)", "APPLY BAN (P2P)")
            else
                kickNoPermBanner.Text = UI.Tr(
                    "BİLGİ: Kick işleminde Perm / Süre olmaz.\nHedef oyuncu belirttiğiniz sebeple anlık atılır.",
                    "INFO: Kick has no Perm / Duration option.\nTarget player is kicked immediately with reason."
                )
                executeBtn.Text = UI.Tr("KICK UYGULA (ANLIK AT)", "APPLY KICK (INSTANT)")
            end
        end

        tabBanBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            PlayUiSound("tab")
            State.BanKickMenuMode = "BAN"
            RefreshBanKickModalView()
        end)

        tabKickBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            PlayUiSound("tab")
            State.BanKickMenuMode = "KICK"
            RefreshBanKickModalView()
        end)

        targetSelectBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            PlayUiSound("click")
            local list = Players:GetPlayers()
            if #list > 0 then
                local curIdx = 1
                for i, p in ipairs(list) do
                    if p.Name == selectedTargetName then
                        curIdx = i
                        break
                    end
                end
                local nextPlr = list[(curIdx % #list) + 1]
                if nextPlr then
                    selectedTargetName = nextPlr.Name
                end
            end
            RefreshBanKickModalView()
        end)

        permToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            PlayUiSound("click")
            isPermBan = not isPermBan
            if isPermBan then
                durationIdx = 6
            elseif durationIdx == 6 then
                durationIdx = 2
            end
            RefreshBanKickModalView()
        end)

        durationBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            PlayUiSound("click")
            durationIdx = (durationIdx % #durationOptions) + 1
            isPermBan = (durationIdx == 6)
            RefreshBanKickModalView()
        end)

        executeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            PlayUiSound("command")
            local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(selectedTargetName) or LocalPlayer
            local reasonTxt = (#reasonBox.Text > 0) and reasonBox.Text or "Admin Kararı"
            if State.BanKickMenuMode == "BAN" then
                local durTxt = isPermBan and "PERM (Sınırsız)" or durationOptions[durationIdx]
                local fullReason = string.format("[%s] Sebep: %s", durTxt, reasonTxt)
                TableDB.BanDetailsByUsername[selectedTargetName] = {
                    IsPerm = isPermBan,
                    Duration = durTxt,
                    Reason = reasonTxt,
                    BannedBy = LocalPlayer.Name
                }
                Engine.ExecuteTablePersistentBan(targetPlr, fullReason)
                if UI.SendNotification then
                    UI.SendNotification(
                        UI.Tr("BAN UYGULANDI", "BAN EXECUTED"),
                        string.format("%s -> %s (%s)", selectedTargetName, durTxt, reasonTxt),
                        Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
                        3.5
                    )
                end
            else
                Engine.ExecuteAdminKick(targetPlr, reasonTxt)
                if UI.SendNotification then
                    UI.SendNotification(
                        UI.Tr("KICK UYGULANDI", "KICK EXECUTED"),
                        string.format("%s (%s)", selectedTargetName, reasonTxt),
                        Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11),
                        3.5
                    )
                end
            end
        end)

        unbanBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            PlayUiSound("click")
            TableDB.BanDetailsByUsername[selectedTargetName] = nil
            TableDB.BannedUsers[selectedTargetName] = nil
            SyncTablePersistence()
            if UI.SendNotification then
                UI.SendNotification(
                    UI.Tr("BAN KALDIRILDI", "USER UNBANNED"),
                    selectedTargetName .. UI.Tr(" yasağı kaldırıldı.", " has been unbanned."),
                    Color3.fromRGB(74, 222, 128),
                    3
                )
            end
        end)

        bkClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            PlayUiSound("drawerClose")
            State.BanKickMenuOpen = false
            BanKickFrame.Visible = false
        end)

        function UI.OpenBanKickModal(mode, targetPlr)
            State.BanKickMenuMode = (mode == "KICK") and "KICK" or "BAN"
            if typeof(targetPlr) == "Instance" and targetPlr:IsA("Player") then
                selectedTargetName = targetPlr.Name
            elseif type(targetPlr) == "string" and #targetPlr > 0 then
                selectedTargetName = targetPlr
            end
            State.BanKickMenuOpen = true
            BanKickFrame.Visible = true
            PlayUiSound("drawerOpen")
            RefreshBanKickModalView()
        end
        UI.RefreshBanKickModalView = RefreshBanKickModalView
    end

    -- [11.8] SOL UST SIMGEYE TIKLAYINCA ACILAN SUNUCU RANKLARI, SCRIPT TARIHI VE GUNCELLIK DURUMU MENUSU
    do
