    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local pos = input.Position
            local mfPos = MainFrame.AbsolutePosition
            local mfSize = MainFrame.AbsoluteSize
            local insideDock = (pos.X >= mfPos.X and pos.X <= mfPos.X + mfSize.X and pos.Y >= mfPos.Y and pos.Y <= mfPos.Y + mfSize.Y)
            if insideDock then
                if State.DockAutoShrunk then
                    UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(false)
                end
            else
                if State.MenuOpen and not State.DockAutoShrunk and not CmdTextBox:IsFocused() and not State.SettingsPaneOpen then
                    UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(true)
                end
                if UI.CmdHoldTooltip then
                    UI.CmdHoldTooltip.Visible = false
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    -- [12] KOMUT CALISTIRICI MOTOR & ARAMA KANCALARI
    function UI.ExecuteCommandString(rawInput)
        local activePfx = ResolvePersonalPrefix(LocalPlayer.Name)
        local clean = rawInput or ""
        if string.sub(clean, 1, #activePfx) == activePfx then
            clean = string.sub(clean, #activePfx + 1)
        elseif string.sub(clean, 1, 1) == ";" then
            clean = string.sub(clean, 2)
        end
        clean = string.gsub(clean, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if clean == "" then return end

        local parts = string.split(clean, " ")
        local cmdName = string.lower(parts[1] or "")
        table.remove(parts, 1)
        local args = parts

        local resolvedCmd = CommandRegistry[cmdName]
        if not resolvedCmd then
            for _, c in ipairs(CommandList) do
                for _, alias in ipairs(c.Aliases) do
                    if string.lower(alias) == cmdName then
                        resolvedCmd = c
                        break
                    end
                end
                if resolvedCmd then break end
            end
        end

        if not resolvedCmd then
            PlayUiSound("error")
            UI.SendNotification(
                UI.Tr("BİLİNMEYEN KOMUT", "UNKNOWN COMMAND"),
                string.format(UI.Tr("'%s' komutu bulunamadı.", "Command '%s' not found."), cmdName),
                Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
            )
            return
        end

        if State.LocalRankLevel < resolvedCmd.MinTier then
            local reqTier = GetTierData(resolvedCmd.MinTier)
            PlayUiSound("error")
            UI.SendNotification(
                UI.Tr("YETKİ KİLİTLİ", "RANK LOCKED"),
                string.format(UI.Tr("'%s' için %s (Tier %d) yetkisi gerekiyor.", "'%s' requires %s (Tier %d)."), resolvedCmd.Name, reqTier.Name, resolvedCmd.MinTier),
                Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
            )
            return
        end

        PlayUiSound("command")
        local rawSelector = args[1] or State.SelectedTargetMode or "me"
        if args[1] == nil then
            local cmdArgSpec = string.lower(tostring(resolvedCmd.Args or ""))
            if cmdArgSpec == "" or (not string.find(cmdArgSpec, "oyuncu") and not string.find(cmdArgSpec, "hedef")) then
                rawSelector = "me"
            end
        elseif tonumber(args[1]) ~= nil then
            rawSelector = "me"
        end
        local targets = ResolveTargetPlayers(rawSelector)
        if #targets == 0 then
            if args[1] and tonumber(args[1]) == nil then
                local cmdArgSpec = string.lower(tostring(resolvedCmd.Args or ""))
                if string.find(cmdArgSpec, "<oyuncu") or string.find(cmdArgSpec, "<hedef") then
                    PlayUiSound("error")
                    UI.SendNotification(
                        UI.Tr("OYUNCU BULUNAMADI", "PLAYER NOT FOUND"),
                        string.format(UI.Tr("'%s' adinda bir oyuncu sunucuda bulunamadi.", "Player '%s' not found in server."), tostring(args[1])),
                        Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
                    )
                    return
                end
            end
            targets = { LocalPlayer }
            rawSelector = "me"
        end

        local filteredTargets = {}
        local blockedB1rkt = false
        for _, targetPlr in ipairs(targets) do
            if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(LocalPlayer, targetPlr) then
                blockedB1rkt = true
            else
                table.insert(filteredTargets, targetPlr)
            end
        end
        if blockedB1rkt then
            PlayUiSound("error")
            UI.SendNotification(
                UI.Tr("B1RKT KORUMA KALKANI", "B1RKT PROTECTION SHIELD"),
                UI.Tr("Kurucu B1rkt kendisine komut kullanmanıza izin vermedi!", "Founder B1rkt has not permitted you to use commands on him!"),
                Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68),
                3.5
            )
            if #filteredTargets == 0 then
                return
            end
        end
        targets = filteredTargets

        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        print(string.format("[BERK'S ADMIN FE v5.0 · KOMUT] ;%s calistirildi | Hedef: %s (%d oyuncu)", resolvedCmd.Name, tostring(rawSelector), #targets))

        State.IsInsideCommandExecution = true
        for _, targetPlr in ipairs(targets) do
            local tChar = targetPlr and targetPlr.Character
            local tHrp = (tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) or myHrp
            local tHum = (tChar and tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) or myHum
            pcall(function()
                resolvedCmd.Action(targetPlr, args, tHrp, tHum, cam)
            end)
        end
        State.IsInsideCommandExecution = false

        -- TAM P2P YAYINI: Sunucuda scripti kullanan diger tum oyunculara komutu aninda ilet!
        Engine.BroadcastUniversalP2PCommand(resolvedCmd, args, targets, rawSelector)

        UI.SendNotification(
            string.upper(resolvedCmd.Name) .. UI.Tr(" ÇALIŞTIRILDI", " EXECUTED"),
            string.format(UI.Tr("Hedef: %s (%d oyuncu · P2P Senkron)", "Target: %s (%d players · P2P Synced)"), rawSelector, #targets),
            GetTierData(State.LocalRankLevel).Color,
            2.5
        )

        if not State.KeepMenuOpen then
            UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(true)
        end
    end

    CmdTextBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
        UI.SetDockAutoShrunk(false)
        if State.SettingsPaneOpen then
            UI.ToggleSettingsGearDrawer()
        end
        UI.RefreshCommandListUI(CmdTextBox.Text)
    end)

    CmdTextBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
        if enterPressed and #CmdTextBox.Text > 0 then
            local txt = CmdTextBox.Text
            CmdTextBox.Text = ""
            UI.RefreshCommandListUI("")
            UI.ExecuteCommandString(txt)
        end
    end)

    LocalPlayer.Chatted:Connect(function(msg)
        local pfx = ResolvePersonalPrefix(LocalPlayer.Name)
        if string.sub(msg, 1, #pfx) == pfx then
            UI.ExecuteCommandString(msg)
        end
    end)
end)

-- [13] CANLI FIZIK VE EFEKT DONGULERI (Infinite Yield Fly, Dinamik AirWalk/AirFly, Hollow Jail, HD Admin)
UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if State.ControllingTarget and State.ControllingTarget.Parent == Players then
        if myHum then
            myHum.Jump = true
            myHum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
        local jumpCmd = CommandRegistry["jump"]
        if jumpCmd and jumpCmd.CmdIndex then
            local slot = Engine.ResolveTargetSlotIndex(State.ControllingTarget.Name)
            Engine.PlayEncodedP2PCarrierTrack((jumpCmd.CmdIndex * 100) + slot, 3)
        end
    end
    if State.InfJump and myHum then
        myHum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end
    if State.FlyJump and myHrp then
        myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 52, myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
    end
    if State.AirWalk and myHrp then
        State.AirWalkY = State.AirWalkY + 1.8
    end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myHrp = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera

    -- [13.0] KESINTISIZ 60 FPS P2P ANIMASYON KANALI TARAYICI (AnimationPlayed kacsa bile %100 yakalar!)
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            local pHum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local pAnim = pHum and pHum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
            if pAnim then
                for _, trk in ipairs(pAnim:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                    if trk.Speed >= 8.0 and trk.Speed <= 115.0 then
                        Engine.ProcessDecodedTrackSpeed(plr, trk.Speed)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- [13.05] GERCEK ZAMANLI 60 FPS P2P KARAKTER ELE GECIRME (;control / ;uncontrol) MOTORU
    if State.ControllingTarget then
        if State.ControllingTarget.Parent ~= Players or not State.ControllingTarget.Character then
            State.ControllingTarget = nil
            State.ControlSavedCFrame = nil
        else
            local targetHum = State.ControllingTarget.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if targetHum and cam and cam.CameraSubject ~= targetHum then
                cam.CameraSubject = targetHum
            end
            -- Kendi karakterimizi sabit tutarken MoveDirection replikasyonunun durmamasi icin Anchored = false birakip CFrame kilitliyoruz:
            if myHrp and State.ControlSavedCFrame then
                myHrp.Anchored = false
                myHrp.CFrame = State.ControlSavedCFrame
                myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0.01, 0)
            end
            if targetHum and myHum then
                pcall(function()
                    targetHum:Move(myHum.MoveDirection, false)
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    if State.PossessedByController then
        if State.PossessedByController.Parent ~= Players or not State.PossessedByController.Character then
            State.PossessedByController = nil
        elseif myHum and myHrp then
            local ctrlChar = State.PossessedByController.Character
            local ctrlHum = ctrlChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if ctrlHum then
                myHrp.Anchored = false
                myHum.PlatformStand = false
                myHum:Move(ctrlHum.MoveDirection, false)
                if ctrlHum.Jump or ctrlHum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                    myHum.Jump = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- [13.1] GERCEK INFINITE YIELD MOBIL THUMBSTICK & PC WASD 3D BODYGYRO/BODYVELOCITY FLY
    if State.Flying and myHrp and myHum and cam then
        local bg = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyGyro")
        local bv = myHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksAdmin_FlyVelocity")
        if not bg then
            bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            bg.Name = "BerksAdmin_FlyGyro"
            bg.P = 90000
            bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bg.Parent = myHrp
        end
        if not bv then
            bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            bv.Name = "BerksAdmin_FlyVelocity"
            bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            bv.Parent = myHrp
        end

        if not State.VehicleFlying and not myHum.SeatPart then
            myHum.PlatformStand = true
        end

        local camCF = cam.CFrame
        local flatLook = Vector3.new(camCF.LookVector.X, 0, camCF.LookVector.Z)
        if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            flatLook = flatLook.Unit
        else
            flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
        end
        local flatRight = Vector3.new(camCF.RightVector.X, 0, camCF.RightVector.Z)
        if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.001 then
            flatRight = flatRight.Unit
        else
            flatRight = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
        end

        local moveDir = myHum.MoveDirection
        local forwardAmount = flatLook:Dot(moveDir)
        local rightAmount = flatRight:Dot(moveDir)

        local verticalAmount = 0
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            verticalAmount = verticalAmount + 1
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            verticalAmount = verticalAmount - 1
        end

        local flyVec = (camCF.LookVector * forwardAmount) + (camCF.RightVector * rightAmount) + Vector3.new(0, verticalAmount, 0)
        if flyVec.Magnitude > 0.01 then
            bv.Velocity = flyVec.Unit * (State.FlySpeed or 65)
        else
            bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        bg.CFrame = camCF
    end

    -- [13.2] CFRAME FLY (Anti-Cheat Uyumlu CFrame Ucus)
    if State.CFFly and myHrp and myHum and cam then
        myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        if myHum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
            local camCF = cam.CFrame
            local flatLook = Vector3.new(camCF.LookVector.X, 0, camCF.LookVector.Z)
            if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
            local flatRight = Vector3.new(camCF.RightVector.X, 0, camCF.RightVector.Z)
            if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.001 then flatRight = flatRight.Unit end
            local fDot = flatLook:Dot(myHum.MoveDirection)
            local rDot = flatRight:Dot(myHum.MoveDirection)
            local dir3D = (camCF.LookVector * fDot) + (camCF.RightVector * rDot)
            if dir3D.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                myHrp.CFrame = myHrp.CFrame + (dir3D.Unit * (State.CFFlySpeed or 55) * (dt or 0.016))
            end
        end
    end

    -- [13.3] DINAMIK AIRWALK VE AIRFLY PLATFORMU (HER KAREDE BIZIMLE HAREKET EDER!)
    if State.AirWalk and myHrp and myHum then
        local airPart = Workspace:FindFirstChild("BerksAirWalkPart")
        if not airPart then
            airPart = Instance.new("Part")
            airPart.Name = "BerksAirWalkPart"
            airPart.Size = Vector3.new(9, 0.7, 9)
            airPart.Anchored = true
            airPart.CanCollide = true
            airPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            airPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
            airPart.Transparency = 0.45
            airPart.Parent = Workspace
            local cyl = Instance.new("CylinderMesh")
            cyl.Parent = airPart
        end

        if State.AirFly and cam and myHum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
            State.AirWalkY = State.AirWalkY + (cam.CFrame.LookVector.Y * (State.AirFlySpeed or 45) * (dt or 0.016))
            local footOffset = (myHum.HipHeight or 2) + (myHrp.Size.Y / 2) + 0.4
            myHrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(myHrp.Position.X, State.AirWalkY + footOffset, myHrp.Position.Z) * (myHrp.CFrame - myHrp.CFrame.Position)
        end

        airPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(myHrp.Position.X, State.AirWalkY, myHrp.Position.Z)
    end

    -- [13.4] ICI BOS 3D JAIL KORUMA DONGUSU (Hapsedilen oyuncuyu iceride tutar, disari atmaz!)
    for jailedName, centerPos in pairs(State.JailedPlayers) do
        local jPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(jailedName)
        local jChar = jPlr and jPlr.Character
        local jHrp = jChar and jChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if jHrp and centerPos then
            local offset = jHrp.Position - centerPos
            if math.abs(offset.X) > 3.9 or math.abs(offset.Z) > 3.9 or offset.Y < -3.5 or offset.Y > 5.2 then
                jHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                jHrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(centerPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
            end
        end
    end

    -- [13.5] NOCLIP, CFWALK, SPIDER, GLIDE, BUNNYHOP
    if State.Noclip and myChar then
        for _, part in ipairs(myChar:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    if State.CFWalk and myHrp and myHum and myHum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
        myHrp.CFrame = myHrp.CFrame + (myHum.MoveDirection * (State.CFWalkMultiplier or 2) * 0.35)
    end

    if State.GlideMode and myHrp and myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y < -12 then
        myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, -10, myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
    end

    if State.BunnyHop and myHum and myHum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
        myHum.Jump = true
    end

    if State.LoopWalkSpeed and myHum then
        myHum.WalkSpeed = State.LoopWalkSpeed
    end

    if State.LoopJumpPower and myHum then
        myHum.UseJumpPower = true
        myHum.JumpPower = State.LoopJumpPower
    end

    -- [13.6] ORBIT, FOLLOW, LOOPGOTO VE BACKPACK TAKIBI
    if State.OrbitTarget and State.OrbitTarget.Character and myHrp then
        local tHrp = State.OrbitTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tHrp then
            local angle = tick() * (State.OrbitSpeed or 2.5)
            local rad = State.OrbitRadius or 8
            local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * rad, 0, math.sin(angle) * rad)
            myHrp.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(tHrp.Position + offset, tHrp.Position)
        end
    end

    if State.FollowTarget and State.FollowTarget.Character and myHum then
        local tHrp = State.FollowTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tHrp then
            myHum:MoveTo(tHrp.Position)
        end
    end

    if State.LoopGotoTarget and State.LoopGotoTarget.Character and myHrp then
        local tHrp = State.LoopGotoTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tHrp then
            myHrp.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
        end
    end

    if State.BackpackTarget and State.BackpackTarget.Character and myHrp then
        local tHrp = State.BackpackTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tHrp then
            if myHum then myHum.Sit = true end
            myHrp.CFrame = tHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 1.4)
            myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end

    -- [13.7] COK DETAYLI ARASTIRILMIS HD ADMIN / HOMELANDER CIFT GOZ RAYCAST LAZER SISTEMI
    for plrName, active in pairs(State.LaserEyesPlayers) do
        if active then
            local p = Players:FindFirstChild(plrName)
            local char = p and p.Character
            local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head then
                local rigName = "BerksLaserRig_" .. plrName
                local rig = Workspace:FindFirstChild(rigName)
                if not rig then
                    rig = Instance.new("Model")
                    rig.Name = rigName
                    rig.Parent = Workspace
                end

                local leftOrigin = (head.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.26, 0.16, -0.55)).Position
                local rightOrigin = (head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.26, 0.16, -0.55)).Position

                -- Hedef nokta: LocalPlayer ise Mouse/Kamera yonu, diger oyuncuysa Baktigi Yon
                local aimTargetPos = (head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -140)).Position
                if p == LocalPlayer then
                    local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
                    if mouse and mouse.Hit then
                        aimTargetPos = mouse.Hit.Position
                    elseif cam then
                        aimTargetPos = cam.CFrame.Position + (cam.CFrame.LookVector * 160)
                    end
                end

                local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
                rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, rig }
                rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

                local dirVec = (aimTargetPos - head.Position)
                if dirVec.Magnitude < 1 then dirVec = head.CFrame.LookVector * 120 end
                local rayResult = Workspace:Raycast(head.Position, dirVec.Unit * 180, rayParams)
                local hitPos = rayResult and rayResult.Position or (head.Position + dirVec.Unit * 120)

                local function updateLaserSegment(segName, startPos, endPos, radius, col, trans)
                    local seg = rig:FindFirstChild(segName)
                    if not seg then
                        seg = Instance.new("Part")
                        seg.Name = segName
                        seg.Anchored = true
                        seg.CanCollide = false
                        seg.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                        seg.Parent = rig
                    end
                    local dist = (endPos - startPos).Magnitude
                    seg.Size = Vector3.new(radius, radius, dist)
                    seg.Color = col
                    seg.Transparency = trans
                    seg.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(startPos, endPos) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -dist / 2)
                end

                -- Sol ve Sag Gozden Hedefe Birlestirilen Cift Katmanli Lazer Isinlari (Dis Kirmizi Neon + Ic Beyaz-Sari Cekirdek)
                updateLaserSegment("LeftOuter", leftOrigin, hitPos, 0.38, Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), 0.28)
                updateLaserSegment("LeftCore", leftOrigin, hitPos, 0.15, Color3.fromRGB(254, 249, 195), 0)
                updateLaserSegment("RightOuter", rightOrigin, hitPos, 0.38, Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68), 0.28)
                updateLaserSegment("RightCore", rightOrigin, hitPos, 0.15, Color3.fromRGB(254, 249, 195), 0)

                -- Carpma Noktasinda 3D Erime / Patlama Kuresi (Impact Orb)
                local impactOrb = rig:FindFirstChild("ImpactOrb")
                if not impactOrb then
                    impactOrb = Instance.new("Part")
                    impactOrb.Name = "ImpactOrb"
                    impactOrb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
                    impactOrb.Anchored = true
                    impactOrb.CanCollide = false
                    impactOrb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                    impactOrb.Color = Color3.fromRGB(251, 146, 60)
                    impactOrb.Parent = rig
                    local pl = Instance.new("PointLight", impactOrb)
                    pl.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                    pl.Brightness = 4.5
                    pl.Range = 16
                end
                local pulseSz = 1.6 + math.sin(tick() * 35) * 0.45
                impactOrb.Size = Vector3.new(pulseSz, pulseSz, pulseSz)
                impactOrb.Position = hitPos

                -- Lazerin carptigi nesneyi yak, komurlestir ve savur!
                if rayResult and rayResult.Instance then
                    local hitInst = rayResult.Instance
                    local hitChar = hitInst.Parent
                    local hitHum = hitChar and hitChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local hitHrp = hitChar and hitChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hitHum and hitHrp and hitChar ~= char then
                        hitHum:TakeDamage(2.5)
                        hitHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dirVec.Unit * 55 + Vector3.new(0, 18, 0)
                        if not hitHrp:FindFirstChild("BerksLaserFire") then
                            local f = Instance.new("Fire")
                            f.Name = "BerksLaserFire"
                            f.Size = 7
                            f.Parent = hitHrp
                            task.delay(2.5, function() if f and f.Parent then f:Destroy() end end)
                        end
                    elseif not hitInst.Anchored then
                        hitInst.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dirVec.Unit * 65
                        hitInst.Color = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 28)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for plrName, active in pairs(State.SeizurePlayers) do
        if active then
            local p = Players:FindFirstChild(plrName)
            local h = p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if h then
                h.CFrame = h.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.random(-25, 25)), math.rad(math.random(-25, 25)), math.rad(math.random(-25, 25)))
            end
        end
    end

    for plrName, active in pairs(State.GlitchPlayers) do
        if active then
            local p = Players:FindFirstChild(plrName)
            local h = p and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if h and math.random(1, 3) == 1 then
                h.CFrame = h.CFrame + Vector3.new(math.random(-3, 3), 0, math.random(-3, 3))
            end
        end
    end

    if (State.WalkFling or State.TouchFling) and myHrp then
        local pwr = State.WalkFling and State.WalkFlingPower or State.TouchFlingPower
        local origVel = myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = origVel * pwr + Vector3.new(0, pwr, 0)
        RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
        if myHrp and myHrp.Parent then
            myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = origVel
        end
    end

    if State.DiscoMode then
        local hue = (tick() * 0.45) % 1
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.85, 1)
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromHSV((hue + 0.3) % 1, 0.85, 1)
    end

    for plrName, active in pairs(State.RainbowPlayers) do
        if active then
            local p = Players:FindFirstChild(plrName)
            if p and p.Character then
                local col = Color3.fromHSV((tick() * 0.6) % 1, 0.85, 1)
                for _, part in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        part.Color = col
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if State.LoopGod and myHum then
        myHum.MaxHealth = math.huge
        myHum.Health = math.huge
    elseif State.SemiGod and myHum then
        if myHum.MaxHealth < 5000 then myHum.MaxHealth = 5000 end
        if myHum.Health < myHum.MaxHealth then
            myHum.Health = math.min(myHum.MaxHealth, myHum.Health + 15)
        end
    end

    if State.LevitateMode and myHrp then
        myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
            myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,
            2.2 + math.sin(tick() * 3.5) * 2.5,
            myHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z
        )
    end

    if State.NoGravMode and myHrp then
        local bf = myHrp:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_NoGravForce")
        if not bf then
            bf = Instance.new("BodyForce")
            bf.Name = "Topk3k_NoGravForce"
            bf.Parent = myHrp
        end
        bf.Force = Vector3.new(0, (myHrp.AssemblyMass or 15) * Workspace.Gravity * 0.96, 0)
    elseif myHrp and myHrp:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_NoGravForce") then
        myHrp.Topk3k_NoGravForce:Destroy()
    end
end)

    TkMain.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 63, 148)
    TkMain.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 38, 96)
    TkMain.BorderSizePixel = 2
    TkMain.Active = true
    TkMain.Visible = true
    TkMain.ZIndex = 80
    TkMain.Parent = ScreenGui
    UI.Topk3kMainFrame = TkMain

    local TkTopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    TkTopBar.Name = "TopBar"
    TkTopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
    TkTopBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    TkTopBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 76, 168)
    TkTopBar.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 48, 114)
    TkTopBar.BorderSizePixel = 1
    TkTopBar.ZIndex = 81
    TkTopBar.Parent = TkMain

    local TkTitleMain = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    TkTitleMain.Size = UDim2.new(0, 125, 1, 0)
    TkTitleMain.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
    TkTitleMain.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    TkTitleSub.Text = "TOPK3K SHOWCASE ( BEST SERVER SIDE )"
    TkTitleSub.ZIndex = 82

    TkOrangeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 3)
    TkOrangeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(214, 93, 14)
    TkOrangeBtn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 55, 8)
    TkOrangeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 1

            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = TkMain.Position
                input.Changed:Connect(function()
                    if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                        dragging = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
        TkTopBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragInput = input
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input == dragInput and dragging and dragStart and startPos then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                TkMain.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end
        end)
    end)()

    -- SOL SEKME SUTUNU (14 SEKME)
    local TkLeftNav = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    TkLeftNav.Name = "LeftTabs"

    TkLeftNav.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 30)

    TkLeftNav.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 410)
    TkLeftNav.ZIndex = 81

    local TkNavList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")

    local tabButtons = {}
    local tabPages = {}
    UI.Topk3kTabPages = tabPages

    local function SwitchTopk3kTab(tabName)
        for name, page in pairs(tabPages) do
            page.Visible = (name == tabName)
        end
        for name, btn in pairs(tabButtons) do
            if name == tabName then
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(72, 118, 214)
            elseif name == "B1rkt Özel" then
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 83, 9)
            else
                btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 86, 178)
            end
        end
    end
    UI.SwitchTopk3kTab = SwitchTopk3kTab

    for idx, tName in ipairs(tabNames) do
        local tBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        tBtn.Name = "TabBtn_" .. tName
        tBtn.LayoutOrder = idx
        tBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 26)
        tBtn.BackgroundColor3 = (tName == "LocalPlayer") and Color3.fromRGB(72, 118, 214)
            or (tName == "B1rkt Özel" and Color3.fromRGB(180, 83, 9) or Color3.fromRGB(48, 86, 178))
        tBtn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 52, 120)
        tBtn.BorderSizePixel = 1
        tBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
        tBtn.TextSize = 15
        tBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 255)
        tBtn.Text = tName
        tBtn.ZIndex = 82
        tBtn.Parent = TkLeftNav
        tabButtons[tName] = tBtn

        local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
        page.Name = "Page_" .. tName
        page.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -8)
        page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
        page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        page.BorderSizePixel = 0
        page.ScrollBarThickness = 5
        page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 720)
        page.Visible = (tName == "LocalPlayer")
        page.ZIndex = 82
        page.Parent = TkRightHolder
        tabPages[tName] = page

        tBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            PlayUiSound("click")
            SwitchTopk3kTab(tName)
        end)
    end

    local function AddFullButton(page, yPos, labelText, onClick, customColor)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 22)
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, yPos)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = customColor or Color3.fromRGB(54, 92, 184)
        btn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 58, 132)
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 1
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
        btn.TextSize = 15
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 255)
        btn.Text = labelText
        btn.ZIndex = 83
        btn.Parent = page
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            PlayUiSound("click")
            onClick(btn)
        end)
        return yPos + 25
    end
    UI.TkAddFullButton = AddFullButton

    local function AddLabelInputRow(page, yPos, labelText, defaultVal, onSubmit)
        local lblBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        lblBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.36, -6, 0, 22)
        lblBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, yPos)
        lblBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(54, 92, 184)
        lblBtn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 58, 132)
        lblBtn.BorderSizePixel = 1
        lblBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
        lblBtn.TextSize = 15
        lblBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 255)
        lblBtn.Text = labelText
        lblBtn.ZIndex = 83
        lblBtn.Parent = page

        local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
        box.Size = UDim2.new(0.64, -7, 0, 22)
        box.Position = UDim2.new(0.36, 2, 0, yPos)
        box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(44, 78, 164)
        box.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 58, 132)
        box.BorderSizePixel = 1
        box.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
        box.TextSize = 15
        box.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        box.Text = defaultVal
        box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
        box.ZIndex = 83
        box.Parent = page

        lblBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            PlayUiSound("click")
            onSubmit(box.Text)
        end)
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
            if enter then
                onSubmit(box.Text)
            end
        end)
        return yPos + 25
    end

-- ========================================================================================
-- [10.4I] T0PK3K 5.0 ADVANCED SERVER-SIDE SHOWCASE: TROLL SUITE, WEATHER, DOMINUS/VALK,
--         BANLAND DIMENSION, ROLLER COASTER, FERRIS WHEEL, STADIUM & CLONE ARMY (100% P2P)
-- ========================================================================================
SafeRunModule("T0PK3K_5.0_Advanced_Showcase_Engine", function()
    local function MakeSyncPart(parent, name, size, cf, col, mat, trans, canCollide, shape)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = name or "Topk3k_AdvPart"
        if shape then p.Shape = shape end
        p.Size = size or Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)
        p.CFrame = cf or CFrame.new(0, 10, 0)
        p.Color = col or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        p.Transparency = trans or 0
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = (canCollide == nil) and true or canCollide
        p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        p.Parent = parent
        Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(p)
        return p
    end

    -- 1. RAINING TACOS (3D TACO YAGMURU + SES — TAM P2P)
    function Engine.Topk3k_RainingTacos(enable, syncP2P)
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ADV_SHOWCASE", "RAINING_TACOS", enable and "1" or "0", "")
        end
        State.Topk3kRainingTacos = (enable == true)
        if not enable then
            Engine.Topk3k_StopAllSounds(false)
            return
        end
        Engine.Topk3k_PlayCustomSound("142376088", 1.0, 9, true, "NORMAL", false)
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()

        task.spawn(function()
            while State.Topk3kRainingTacos do
                local center = Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin()
                for i = 1, 2 do
                    local dropPos = center + Vector3.new(math.random(-85, 85), 95, math.random(-85, 85))
                    local taco = Instance.new("Part")
                    taco.Name = "Topk3k_3DTaco"
                    taco.Size = Vector3.new(3.2, 1.8, 1.4)
                    taco.Color = Color3.fromRGB(234, 179, 8)
                    taco.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                    taco.Anchored = false
                    taco.CanCollide = true
                    taco.Position = dropPos
                    taco.Parent = wf
                    Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(taco)

                    local lettuce = Instance.new("Part")
                    lettuce.Size = Vector3.new(2.8, 0.6, 1.5)
                    lettuce.Color = Color3.fromRGB(34, 197, 94)
                    lettuce.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
                    lettuce.CanCollide = false
                    lettuce.CFrame = taco.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.8, 0)
                    lettuce.Parent = taco
                    local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                    w.Part0 = taco
                    w.Part1 = lettuce
                    w.Parent = lettuce

                    task.delay(6, function() pcall(function() taco:Destroy() end) end)
                end
                task.wait(0.22)
            end
        end)
        if UI.ShowNotification then
            UI.ShowNotification("T0PK3K Raining Tacos", "3D Taco Yagmuru ve Muzigi P2P ile baslatildi!", "success")
        end
    end

    -- 2. THOMAS THE TANK ENGINE DONUSUMU (TAM P2P)
    function Engine.Topk3k_ThomasTheTankEngine(targetPlr, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ADV_SHOWCASE", "THOMAS_TRAIN", p.Name, "")
        end
        local char = p.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not char or not hrp then return end

        local old = char:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_ThomasRig")
        if old then old:Destroy() end

        local rig = Instance.new("Model")
        rig.Name = "Topk3k_ThomasRig"
        rig.Parent = char

        local function weldPart(name, sz, col, mat, offsetCF)
            local pt = Instance.new("Part")
            pt.Name = name
            pt.Size = sz
            pt.Color = col
            pt.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            pt.CanCollide = false
            pt.Massless = true
            pt.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * offsetCF
            pt.Parent = rig
            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            w.Part0 = hrp
            w.Part1 = pt
            w.Parent = pt
            return pt
        end

        weldPart("Boiler", Vector3.new(5.5, 5.5, 11), Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, 0.5, -1))
        weldPart("Cab", Vector3.new(6, 7.5, 5), Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 5))
        weldPart("RedBase", Vector3.new(6.4, 1.2, 16), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, -2.2, 1.5))
        local funnel = weldPart("Funnel", Vector3.new(1.6, 3.2, 1.6), Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42), Enum.Material.Metal, CFrame.new(0, 4.2, -4.5))
        local facePlate = weldPart("FacePlate", Vector3.new(4.2, 4.2, 0.6), Color3.fromRGB(203, 213, 225), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, CFrame.new(0, 0.6, -6.6))
        local dec = Instance.new("Decal")
        dec.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
        dec.Texture = "rbxassetid://1365169983"
        dec.Parent = facePlate

        local smoke = Instance.new("Smoke")
        smoke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
        smoke.Size = 8
        smoke.RiseVelocity = 14
        smoke.Parent = funnel

        if hum then
            hum.WalkSpeed = 58
        end
    end

    function Engine.Topk3k_NyanCatSkyRider(targetPlr, syncP2P)

                task.wait(0.08)
            end
        end)
    end

    -- 4. 3D DOMINUS KOLEKSIYONU & VALKYRIE TACI (TAM P2P)
    function Engine.Topk3k_EquipDominus(targetPlr, domType, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        local dType = string.upper(tostring(domType or "EMPYREUS"))
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ADV_SHOWCASE", "DOMINUS", p.Name, dType)
        end
        local char = p.Character
        local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not char or not head or not hrp then return end

        local old = char:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_DominusRig")
        if old then old:Destroy() end

        local hoodCol = Color3.fromRGB(240, 244, 248)
        local wingCol = Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)
        if dType == "INFERNUS" then
            hoodCol = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 28)
            wingCol = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68)
        elseif dType == "FRIGIDUS" then
            hoodCol = Color3.fromRGB(186, 230, 253)
            wingCol = Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233)
        elseif dType == "AUREUS" then
            hoodCol = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
            wingCol = Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11)
        elseif dType == "ASTRA" then
            hoodCol = Color3.fromRGB(30, 27, 75)
            wingCol = Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247)
        end

        local rig = Instance.new("Model")
        rig.Name = "Topk3k_DominusRig"
        rig.Parent = char

        local hood = Instance.new("Part")
        hood.Name = "DominusHood"
        hood.Size = Vector3.new(2.4, 2.4, 2.4)
        hood.Color = hoodCol
        hood.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        hood.CanCollide = false
        hood.Massless = true
        hood.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.2, 0)
        hood.Parent = rig
        local wh = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        wh.Part0 = head
        wh.Part1 = hood
        wh.Parent = hood

        for side = -1, 1, 2 do
            for f = 1, 3 do
                local feather = Instance.new("Part")
                feather.Name = "DominusFeather"
                feather.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 5.2 - f * 0.7, 1.4)
                feather.Color = wingCol
                feather.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                feather.CanCollide = false
                feather.Massless = true
                feather.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(side * (1.8 + f * 0.7), 1.4 - f * 0.3, 1.2) * CFrame.Angles(0, side * 0.35, side * (0.28 * f))
                feather.Parent = rig
                local wf = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                wf.Part0 = hrp
                wf.Part1 = feather
                wf.Parent = feather
            end
        end
    end

    -- 5. BANLAND HAPISHANE BOYUTU (Y = +850 GOKYUZU OBSIDYEN HUCRESI — TAM P2P)
    function Engine.Topk3k_BanlandPrisonDimension(targetPlr, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then
            if UI.ShowNotification then
                UI.ShowNotification("B1rkt Koruma Kalkani", "B1rkt Banland boyutuna gonderilemez!", "error")
            end
            return
        end
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ADV_SHOWCASE", "BANLAND_SEND", p.Name, "")
        end
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        local banOrigin = Vector3.new(0, 850, 0)

        if not wf:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_BanlandDimension") then
            local bModel = Instance.new("Model")
            bModel.Name = "Topk3k_BanlandDimension"
            bModel.Parent = wf
            Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(bModel)

            MakeSyncPart(bModel, "BanlandFloor", Vector3.new(44, 3, 44), CFrame.new(banOrigin), Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20), Enum.Material.Slate, 0, true)
            MakeSyncPart(bModel, "BanlandRoof", Vector3.new(44, 3, 44), CFrame.new(banOrigin + Vector3.new(0, 26, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20), Enum.Material.Slate, 0, true)
            for i = -20, 20, 4 do
                MakeSyncPart(bModel, "BarN_" .. i, Vector3.new(1, 24, 1), CFrame.new(banOrigin + Vector3.new(i, 13, -21)), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, true)
                MakeSyncPart(bModel, "BarS_" .. i, Vector3.new(1, 24, 1), CFrame.new(banOrigin + Vector3.new(i, 13, 21)), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, true)
                MakeSyncPart(bModel, "BarW_" .. i, Vector3.new(1, 24, 1), CFrame.new(banOrigin + Vector3.new(-21, 13, i)), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, true)
                MakeSyncPart(bModel, "BarE_" .. i, Vector3.new(1, 24, 1), CFrame.new(banOrigin + Vector3.new(21, 13, i)), Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, true)

        if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            p.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(banOrigin + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
        end
    end

    -- 6. 3D LUNAPARK ROLLER COASTER, DÖNME DOLAP (FERRIS WHEEL), FUTBOL STADYUMU & BOKS RİNGİ (TAM P2P)
    function Engine.Topk3k_BuildAmusementStructure(parkType, posVec, syncP2P)
        local pType = string.upper(tostring(parkType or "FERRISWHEEL"))
        local center = Engine.ParseVec3(posVec) or Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin()
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ADV_SHOWCASE", "PARK_" .. pType, Engine.FormatVec3(center), "")
        end
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = "Topk3k_Park_" .. pType
        model.Parent = wf
        Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(model)

        if pType == "FERRISWHEEL" then
            MakeSyncPart(model, "BasePlatform", Vector3.new(36, 2, 24), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59), Enum.Material.Metal, 0, true)
            MakeSyncPart(model, "SupportL", Vector3.new(2, 42, 4), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(-6, 18, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Metal, 0, true)
            MakeSyncPart(model, "SupportR", Vector3.new(2, 42, 4), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(6, 18, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Metal, 0, true)
            local hubPos = center + Vector3.new(0, 38, 0)
            local spokes = {}
            for i = 1, 8 do
                local gond = MakeSyncPart(model, "Gondola_" .. i, Vector3.new(8, 5, 6), CFrame.new(hubPos), Color3.fromHSV(i / 8, 0.85, 1), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.1, true)
                table.insert(spokes, { Gondola = gond, Index = i })
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                local ang = 0
                while model.Parent do
                    ang = ang + 0.025
                    for _, sp in ipairs(spokes) do
                        if sp.Gondola.Parent then
                            local a = ang + (sp.Index / 8) * math.pi * 2
                            sp.Gondola.CFrame = CFrame.new(hubPos + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(a) * 28, math.cos(a) * 28))
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait(0.03)
                end
            end)

        elseif pType == "ROLLERCOASTER" then
            local trackPts = {}
            for i = 1, 36 do
                local a = (i / 36) * math.pi * 2
                local pt = center + Vector3.new(math.cos(a) * 52, 8 + math.sin(a * 3) * 14 + 14, math.sin(a) * 52)
                table.insert(trackPts, pt)
            end
            for i = 1, #trackPts do
                local p1 = trackPts[i]
                local p2 = trackPts[(i % #trackPts) + 1]
                local mid = (p1 + p2) * 0.5
                local dist = (p2 - p1).Magnitude
                MakeSyncPart(model, "TrackSeg_" .. i, Vector3.new(5, 1.2, dist + 0.6), CFrame.new(mid, p2), Color3.fromHSV(i / #trackPts, 0.85, 1), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, true)
            end
            local cart = MakeSyncPart(model, "CoasterCart", Vector3.new(6, 3.5, 8), CFrame.new(trackPts[1] + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21), Enum.Material.Metal, 0, true)
            task.spawn(function()
                local idx = 1
                while model.Parent and cart.Parent do
                    local p1 = trackPts[idx]
                    local p2 = trackPts[(idx % #trackPts) + 1]
                    for s = 0, 1, 0.25 do
                        if not cart.Parent then break end
                        local cur = p1:Lerp(p2, s)
                        cart.CFrame = CFrame.new(cur + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0), p2 + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                        task.wait(0.03)
                    end
                    idx = (idx % #trackPts) + 1
                end
            end)

        elseif pType == "STADIUM" then
            MakeSyncPart(model, "Pitch", Vector3.new(72, 1.5, 110), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, -2, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(22, 163, 74), Enum.Material.Grass, 0, true)
            MakeSyncPart(model, "MidLine", Vector3.new(72, 1.6, 1), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, -1.9, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, false)
            MakeSyncPart(model, "GoalNorth", Vector3.new(22, 10, 2), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 3, -53)), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.35, true)
            MakeSyncPart(model, "GoalSouth", Vector3.new(22, 10, 2), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 3, 53)), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.35, true)
            local ball = Instance.new("Part")
            ball.Name = "SoccerBall"
            ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
            ball.Size = Vector3.new(5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
            ball.Color = Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252)
            ball.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            ball.Anchored = false
            ball.CanCollide = true
            ball.Position = center + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
            ball.Parent = model

        elseif pType == "BOXINGRING" then
            MakeSyncPart(model, "RingCanvas", Vector3.new(34, 3, 34), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235), Enum.Material.Fabric, 0, true)
            local posts = {
                Vector3.new(-15.5, 4, -15.5),
                Vector3.new(15.5, 4, -15.5),
                Vector3.new(-15.5, 4, 15.5),
                Vector3.new(15.5, 4, 15.5)
            }
            for i, pOff in ipairs(posts) do
                MakeSyncPart(model, "CornerPost_" .. i, Vector3.new(1.5, 8, 1.5), CFrame.new(center + pOff), (i % 2 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38) or Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.Metal, 0, true)
            end
            for h = 1, 3 do
                local ry = h * 1.6 + 0.5
                MakeSyncPart(model, "RopeN_" .. h, Vector3.new(31, 0.35, 0.35), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, ry, -15.5)), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, true)
                MakeSyncPart(model, "RopeS_" .. h, Vector3.new(31, 0.35, 0.35), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, ry, 15.5)), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, true)
                MakeSyncPart(model, "RopeW_" .. h, Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 31), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(-15.5, ry, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, true)
                MakeSyncPart(model, "RopeE_" .. h, Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 31), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(15.5, ry, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, true)
            end
        end
    end

    -- 7. 3D KLON ORDUSU (CLONE BATTALION — TAM P2P)
    function Engine.Topk3k_SpawnCloneArmy(targetPlr, count, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        local num = math.clamp(tonumber(count) or 8, 1, 12)
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ADV_SHOWCASE", "CLONE_ARMY", p.Name, tostring(num))
        end
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        local char = p.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not char or not hrp then return end

        local old = wf:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_CloneBattalion_" .. p.Name)
        if old then old:Destroy() end

        local squad = Instance.new("Model")
        squad.Name = "Topk3k_CloneBattalion_" .. p.Name
        squad.Parent = wf
        Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(squad)

        local soldiers = {}
        for i = 1, num do
            local sTorso = MakeSyncPart(squad, "CloneTorso_" .. i, Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), hrp.CFrame, Color3.fromRGB(37, 99, 235), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0, false)
            local sHead = MakeSyncPart(squad, "CloneHead_" .. i, Vector3.new(2, 1, 1), hrp.CFrame, Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 48), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0, false)
            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 24)
            bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
            bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
            bb.Parent = sHead
            local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            tl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            tl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
            tl.TextSize = 13
            tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
            tl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
            tl.Text = p.Name .. " Guard #" .. i
            tl.Parent = bb
            table.insert(soldiers, { Torso = sTorso, Head = sHead, Index = i })
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            local t0 = os.clock()
            while squad.Parent and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and os.clock() - t0 < 30 do
                local curHrp = p.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                for _, s in ipairs(soldiers) do
                    local row = math.floor((s.Index - 1) / 4) + 1
                    local col = ((s.Index - 1) % 4) - 1.5
                    local targetCF = curHrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(col * 4.5, 0, row * 4.5)
                    s.Torso.CFrame = targetCF
                    s.Head.CFrame = targetCF * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
                end
                task.wait(0.03)
            end
            pcall(function() squad:Destroy() end)
        end)
    end

    -- Hook into ExecuteTopk3kPacketAction for ADV_SHOWCASE opcodes
    local prevDispatcher = Engine.ExecuteTopk3kPacketAction
    function Engine.ExecuteTopk3kPacketAction(senderPlr, rawAction, targetName, rawValue)
        local subAction = string.gsub(tostring(rawAction or ""), "^TOPK3K_", "")
        if subAction == "ADV_SHOWCASE" then
            local parts = string.split(tostring(rawValue or ""), "|")
            local arg1 = parts[1] or ""
            local arg2 = parts[2] or ""
            local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(arg1)
            if targetPlr and not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(senderPlr, targetPlr) then
                return
            end
            if Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer) and not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(senderPlr, LocalPlayer) then
                return
            end
            State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
            State.CurrentP2PSender = senderPlr
            pcall(function()
                if targetName == "RAINING_TACOS" then
                    Engine.Topk3k_RainingTacos(arg1 == "1", false)
                elseif targetName == "THOMAS_TRAIN" and targetPlr then
                    Engine.Topk3k_ThomasTheTankEngine(targetPlr, false)
                elseif targetName == "NYAN_CAT" and targetPlr then
                    Engine.Topk3k_NyanCatSkyRider(targetPlr, false)
                elseif targetName == "DOMINUS" and targetPlr then
                    Engine.Topk3k_EquipDominus(targetPlr, arg2, false)
                elseif targetName == "BANLAND_SEND" and targetPlr then
                    Engine.Topk3k_BanlandPrisonDimension(targetPlr, false)
                elseif string.sub(targetName, 1, 5) == "PARK_" then
                    Engine.Topk3k_BuildAmusementStructure(string.sub(targetName, 6), arg1, false)
                elseif targetName == "CLONE_ARMY" and targetPlr then
                    Engine.Topk3k_SpawnCloneArmy(targetPlr, tonumber(arg2) or 8, false)
                end
            end)
            State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
            State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
            return
        end
        if prevDispatcher then
            prevDispatcher(senderPlr, rawAction, targetName, rawValue)
        end
    end

            y = UI.TkAddSplitButtons(pDestr, y, "3D Raining Tacos Baslat (P2P)", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_RainingTacos(true, true)
            end, "Raining Tacos Durdur", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_RainingTacos(false, true)
            end)
            y = UI.TkAddFullButton(pDestr, y, "Secili Hedefi Banland Boyutuna Gonder (Y=+850 · P2P)", function()
                for _, tp in ipairs(ResolveTargetPlayers(State.Topk3kSelectedTarget or "others")) do
                    Engine.Topk3k_BanlandPrisonDimension(tp, true)
                end
            end, Color3.fromRGB(145, 19, 19))
            pDestr.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y + 16)
        end
    end)
end)

-- ========================================================================================
-- [10.4J] T0PK3K 5.0 ULTIMATE P2P ABILITIES: ORBITAL LASER CANNON, DOMAIN EXPANSION,
--         GASTER BARRAGE, WEATHER ENGINE (THUNDERSTORM/BLIZZARD/ECLIPSE) & ROYAL CROWN
-- ========================================================================================
SafeRunModule("T0PK3K_5.0_Ultimate_Abilities_Engine", function()
    local function CreateUltPart(parent, name, size, cf, col, mat, trans, canCollide, shape)
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = name or "Topk3k_UltPart"
        if shape then p.Shape = shape end
        p.Size = size or Vector3.new(4, 4, 4)
        p.CFrame = cf or CFrame.new(0, 10, 0)
        p.Color = col or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.Neon
        p.Transparency = trans or 0
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CanCollide = (canCollide == nil) and false or canCollide
        p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
        p.Parent = parent
        Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(p)
        return p
    end

    -- 1. ORBITAL SATELLITE LASER CANNON (UYDU LAZER TOPU — TAM P2P)
    function Engine.Topk3k_OrbitalLaserStrike(posVec, syncP2P)
        local center = Engine.ParseVec3(posVec) or Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin()
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ULTIMATE", "ORBITAL_LASER", Engine.FormatVec3(center), "")
        end
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        Engine.Topk3k_PlayCustomSound("9114224721", 1.35, 10, false, "REVERB", false)

        task.spawn(function()
            local targetCircle = CreateUltPart(wf, "OrbitalTargetRing", Vector3.new(1, 36, 36), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.25, false, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
            TweenService:Create(targetCircle, TweenInfo.new(1.2), { Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 8, 8), Color = Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68) }):Play()
            task.wait(1.2)

            Engine.Topk3k_PlayCustomSound("138186576", 0.7, 10, false, "BASS", false)
            local beam = CreateUltPart(wf, "OrbitalBeamCore", Vector3.new(500, 18, 18), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 250, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(224, 242, 254), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.05, false, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
            local outerBeam = CreateUltPart(wf, "OrbitalBeamOuter", Vector3.new(500, 34, 34), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 250, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.45, false, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
            local shock = CreateUltPart(wf, "OrbitalShock", Vector3.new(16, 16, 16), CFrame.new(center), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.15, false, Enum.PartType.Ball)

            TweenService:Create(shock, TweenInfo.new(2.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Size = Vector3.new(150, 150, 150),
                Transparency = 1
            }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(beam, TweenInfo.new(2.4), { Size = Vector3.new(500, 1, 1), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(outerBeam, TweenInfo.new(2.4), { Size = Vector3.new(500, 2, 2), Transparency = 1 }):Play()

            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, plr) and plr.Character then
                    local hrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp and (hrp.Position - center).Magnitude < 85 then
                        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-90, 90), 160, math.random(-90, 90))
                        Engine.Topk3k_ApplyDamage(plr, 55, false)
                    end
                end
            end

            task.delay(2.5, function()
                pcall(function() targetCircle:Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() beam:Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() outerBeam:Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() shock:Destroy() end)
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- 2. 3D DOMAIN EXPANSION (INFINITE VOID & MALEVOLENT SHRINE — TAM P2P)
    function Engine.Topk3k_DomainExpansion(domainType, posVec, syncP2P)
        local dType = string.upper(tostring(domainType or "VOID"))
        local center = Engine.ParseVec3(posVec) or Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin()
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ULTIMATE", "DOMAIN_" .. dType, Engine.FormatVec3(center), "")
        end
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        local old = wf:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_DomainExpansion")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        if dType == "OFF" then return end

        local model = Instance.new("Model")
        model.Name = "Topk3k_DomainExpansion"
        model.Parent = wf
        Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(model)

        local domeCol = (dType == "SHRINE") and Color3.fromRGB(127, 29, 29) or Color3.fromRGB(15, 23, 42)
        local accentCol = (dType == "SHRINE") and Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68) or Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248)

        local shell = CreateUltPart(model, "DomainShell", Vector3.new(8, 8, 8), CFrame.new(center), domeCol, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0.12, false, Enum.PartType.Ball)
        TweenService:Create(shell, TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = Vector3.new(135, 135, 135)
        }):Play()

        CreateUltPart(model, "DomainFloor", Vector3.new(130, 1.5, 130), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, -3, 0)), accentCol, Enum.Material.Glass, 0.35, true)

        if dType == "SHRINE" then
            CreateUltPart(model, "ShrineBase", Vector3.new(28, 6, 28), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 27), Enum.Material.Slate, 0, true)
            CreateUltPart(model, "ShrinePillarL", Vector3.new(3, 22, 3), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(-10, 14, -8)), Color3.fromRGB(185, 28, 28), Enum.Material.Wood, 0, true)
            CreateUltPart(model, "ShrinePillarR", Vector3.new(3, 22, 3), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(10, 14, -8)), Color3.fromRGB(185, 28, 28), Enum.Material.Wood, 0, true)
            CreateUltPart(model, "ShrineRoof", Vector3.new(36, 4, 32), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(0, 26, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20), Enum.Material.Slate, 0, true)
            Engine.Topk3k_PlayScarySong139332710701596(0.85, 10, false, "RITUAL", false)
        else
            for i = 1, 24 do
                local starPos = center + Vector3.new(math.random(-50, 50), math.random(4, 52), math.random(-50, 50))
                CreateUltPart(model, "VoidStar_" .. i, Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 2.2), CFrame.new(starPos), (i % 2 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248) or Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, false, Enum.PartType.Ball)
            end
        end

        task.delay(22, function()
            if model and model.Parent then
                pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
            end
        end)
    end

    -- 3. GASTER BLASTER 8'LI HALKASI (SANS ULTIMATE — TAM P2P)
    function Engine.Topk3k_SummonGasterBarrage(targetPlr, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ULTIMATE", "GASTER_BARRAGE", p.Name, "")
        end
        local char = p.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end

        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        local center = hrp.Position
        local group = Instance.new("Model")
        group.Name = "Topk3k_GasterRing"
        group.Parent = wf
        Engine.RegisterTopk3kObject(group)

        Engine.Topk3k_PlayCustomSound("1845554017", 1.0, 9, false, "NORMAL", false)

        task.spawn(function()
            local blasters = {}
            for i = 1, 8 do
                local ang = (i / 8) * math.pi * 2
                local bPos = center + Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * 26, 6, math.sin(ang) * 26)
                local cf = CFrame.new(bPos, center + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
                local skull = CreateUltPart(group, "BlasterSkull_" .. i, Vector3.new(4.5, 4.5, 6), cf, Color3.fromRGB(248, 250, 252), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, false)
                table.insert(blasters, { Skull = skull, CF = cf })
            end
            task.wait(0.75)
            for _, b in ipairs(blasters) do
                local ray = CreateUltPart(group, "GasterRay", Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 52), b.CF * CFrame.new(0, 0, -26), Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.05, false)
                TweenService:Create(ray, TweenInfo.new(0.9), { Transparency = 1, Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 52) }):Play()
            end
            if p ~= LocalPlayer or not State.GodMode then
                Engine.Topk3k_ApplyDamage(p, 45, false)
            end
            task.wait(1.1)
            pcall(function() group:Destroy() end)
        end)
    end

    -- 4. HAVA DURUMU & ATMOSFER MOTORU (THUNDERSTORM, BLIZZARD, SOLAR ECLIPSE, BLOODMOON — TAM P2P)
    function Engine.Topk3k_SetWeatherPreset(weatherType, syncP2P)
        local wType = string.upper(tostring(weatherType or "THUNDERSTORM"))
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ULTIMATE", "WEATHER_" .. wType, "", "")
        end
        local wf = Engine.GetTopk3kWorldFolder()
        State.Topk3kCurrentWeather = wType

        if wType == "CLEAR" then
            Lighting.ClockTime = 14
            Lighting.Brightness = 2
            Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
            Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
            return
        elseif wType == "THUNDERSTORM" then
            Lighting.ClockTime = 19.5
            Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59)
            Lighting.FogEnd = 380
            task.spawn(function()
                for strike = 1, 14 do
                    if State.Topk3kCurrentWeather ~= "THUNDERSTORM" then break end
                    local center = Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin()
                    local sPos = center + Vector3.new(math.random(-90, 90), 0, math.random(-90, 90))
                    local bolt = CreateUltPart(wf, "LightningBolt", Vector3.new(2.2, 180, 2.2), CFrame.new(sPos + Vector3.new(0, 90, 0)), Color3.fromRGB(254, 240, 138), Enum.Material.Neon, 0, false)
                    Lighting.Brightness = 6
                    task.wait(0.08)
                    Lighting.Brightness = 1
                    TweenService:Create(bolt, TweenInfo.new(0.45), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
                    task.delay(0.5, function() pcall(function() bolt:Destroy() end) end)
                    task.wait(1.1)
                end
            end)
        elseif wType == "BLIZZARD" then
            Lighting.ClockTime = 16
            Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(186, 230, 253)
            Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(224, 242, 254)
            Lighting.FogEnd = 220
            task.spawn(function()
                for wave = 1, 35 do
                    if State.Topk3kCurrentWeather ~= "BLIZZARD" then break end
                    local center = Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin()
                    for s = 1, 4 do
                        local flake = CreateUltPart(wf, "Snowflake", Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), CFrame.new(center + Vector3.new(math.random(-85, 85), 75, math.random(-85, 85))), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.1, false, Enum.PartType.Ball)
                        TweenService:Create(flake, TweenInfo.new(2.2), { Position = flake.Position - Vector3.new(12, 78, 0), Transparency = 1 }):Play()
                        task.delay(2.3, function() pcall(function() flake:Destroy() end) end)
                    end
                    task.wait(0.2)
                end
            end)
        elseif wType == "ECLIPSE" then
            Lighting.ClockTime = 18.2
            Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(60, 25, 10)
            Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(35, 15, 5)
            Lighting.FogEnd = 450
            local center = Engine.Topk3k_GetCenterOrigin() + Vector3.new(0, 185, -140)
            local sunCore = CreateUltPart(wf, "EclipseCore", Vector3.new(54, 54, 54), CFrame.new(center), Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 8), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, 0, false, Enum.PartType.Ball)
            local corona = CreateUltPart(wf, "EclipseCorona", Vector3.new(64, 64, 64), CFrame.new(center), Color3.fromRGB(245, 158, 11), Enum.Material.Neon, 0.3, false, Enum.PartType.Ball)
            task.delay(35, function()
                pcall(function() sunCore:Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() corona:Destroy() end)
            end)
        end
    end

    -- 5. B1RKT KRALIYET ALTIN TACI (8 KOSELI DONEN TAC — TAM P2P)
    function Engine.Topk3k_GiveB1rktRoyalCrown(targetPlr, syncP2P)
        local p = targetPlr or LocalPlayer
        if not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(State.CurrentP2PSender or LocalPlayer, p) then return end
        if syncP2P ~= false and not State.IsExecutingFromP2P then
            Engine.BroadcastTopk3kP2P("ULTIMATE", "ROYAL_CROWN", p.Name, "")
        end
        local head = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end
        local old = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Topk3k_RoyalCrown")
        if old then old:Destroy() end

        local crown = Instance.new("Model")
        crown.Name = "Topk3k_RoyalCrown"
        crown.Parent = p.Character

        local base = Instance.new("Part")
        base.Name = "CrownRing"
        base.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
        base.Size = Vector3.new(0.6, 2.3, 2.3)
        base.Color = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
        base.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        base.CanCollide = false
        base.Massless = true
        base.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.05, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
        base.Parent = crown
        local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        w.Part0 = head
        w.Part1 = base
        w.Parent = base

        for i = 1, 8 do
            local ang = (i / 8) * math.pi * 2
            local spike = Instance.new("Part")
            spike.Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.9, 0.35)
            spike.Color = (i % 2 == 0) and Color3.fromRGB(239, 68, 68) or Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)
            spike.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            spike.CanCollide = false
            spike.Massless = true
            spike.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.cos(ang) * 0.95, 1.55, math.sin(ang) * 0.95)
            spike.Parent = crown
            local ws = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            ws.Part0 = head
            ws.Part1 = spike
            ws.Parent = spike
        end
    end

    -- Chain into ExecuteTopk3kPacketAction
    local prevUltDispatcher = Engine.ExecuteTopk3kPacketAction
    function Engine.ExecuteTopk3kPacketAction(senderPlr, rawAction, targetName, rawValue)
        local subAction = string.gsub(tostring(rawAction or ""), "^TOPK3K_", "")
        if subAction == "ULTIMATE" then
            local parts = string.split(tostring(rawValue or ""), "|")
            local arg1 = parts[1] or ""
            local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(arg1)
            if targetPlr and not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(senderPlr, targetPlr) then
                return
            end
            if Engine.IsB1rktOwner(LocalPlayer) and not Engine.CanSenderTargetB1rkt(senderPlr, LocalPlayer) then
                return
            end
            State.IsExecutingFromP2P = true
            State.CurrentP2PSender = senderPlr
            pcall(function()
                if targetName == "ORBITAL_LASER" then
                    Engine.Topk3k_OrbitalLaserStrike(arg1, false)
                elseif string.sub(targetName, 1, 7) == "DOMAIN_" then
                    Engine.Topk3k_DomainExpansion(string.sub(targetName, 8), arg1, false)
                elseif targetName == "GASTER_BARRAGE" and targetPlr then
                    Engine.Topk3k_SummonGasterBarrage(targetPlr, false)
                elseif string.sub(targetName, 1, 8) == "WEATHER_" then
                    Engine.Topk3k_SetWeatherPreset(string.sub(targetName, 9), false)
                elseif targetName == "ROYAL_CROWN" and targetPlr then
                    Engine.Topk3k_GiveB1rktRoyalCrown(targetPlr, false)
                end
            end)
            State.CurrentP2PSender = nil
            State.IsExecutingFromP2P = false
            return
        end
        if prevUltDispatcher then
            prevUltDispatcher(senderPlr, rawAction, targetName, rawValue)
        end
    end

    -- Add UI buttons for Ultimate Abilities into T0PK3K 5.0 tabs
    task.defer(function()
        if not UI.Topk3kTabPages or not UI.TkAddSplitButtons or not UI.TkAddFullButton then return end
        local pDestr = UI.Topk3kTabPages["Destruction"]
        local pScripts = UI.Topk3kTabPages["Scripts"]
        local pServer = UI.Topk3kTabPages["Server"]
        local pLocal = UI.Topk3kTabPages["LocalPlayer"]
        if pDestr then
            local y = pDestr.CanvasSize.Y.Offset - 10
            y = UI.TkAddFullButton(pDestr, y, "⚡ Orbital Satellite Laser Cannon (Uydu Lazeri · P2P)", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_OrbitalLaserStrike(nil, true)
            end, Color3.fromRGB(14, 116, 190))
            y = UI.TkAddSplitButtons(pDestr, y, "Domain: Infinite Void (P2P)", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_DomainExpansion("VOID", nil, true)
            end, "Domain: Malevolent Shrine", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_DomainExpansion("SHRINE", nil, true)
            end)
            pDestr.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y + 16)
        end
        if pScripts then
            local y = pScripts.CanvasSize.Y.Offset - 10
            y = UI.TkAddSplitButtons(pScripts, y, "Sans 8x Gaster Barrage (P2P)", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_SummonGasterBarrage(LocalPlayer, true)
            end, "B1rkt Kraliyet Altin Taci", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_GiveB1rktRoyalCrown(LocalPlayer, true)
            end)
            pScripts.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y + 16)
        end
        if pServer then
            local y = pServer.CanvasSize.Y.Offset - 10
            y = UI.TkAddSplitButtons(pServer, y, "Firtina & Yildirim (P2P)", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_SetWeatherPreset("THUNDERSTORM", true)
            end, "Tipi & Kar Yagisi (Blizzard)", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_SetWeatherPreset("BLIZZARD", true)
            end)
            y = UI.TkAddSplitButtons(pServer, y, "Gunes Tutulmasi (Eclipse)", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_SetWeatherPreset("ECLIPSE", true)
            end, "Havayi Temizle (Clear)", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_SetWeatherPreset("CLEAR", true)
            end)
            pServer.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y + 16)
        end
        if pLocal then
            local y = pLocal.CanvasSize.Y.Offset - 10
            y = UI.TkAddFullButton(pLocal, y, "👑 B1rkt Kraliyet Altin Taci Kusan (P2P)", function()
                Engine.Topk3k_GiveB1rktRoyalCrown(LocalPlayer, true)
            end, Color3.fromRGB(180, 83, 9))
            pLocal.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y + 16)
        end
    end)
end)
